title: Distributed Epistemic Failure Control Network Operational Framework for Detection, Escalation, and Containmentof Systemic Epistemic Degradationin High-Complexity Informational Environments

detail.title: Distributed Epistemic Failure Control Network Operational Framework for Detection, Escalation, and Containmentof Systemic Epistemic Degradationin High-Complexity Informational Environments
detail.abstract: DEFCON-1 (Distributed Epistemic Failure Control Network) is a systems-level framework for identifying conditions under which informational ecosystems lose operational correspondence between evidence, verification, institutional accountability, and narrative propagation. Epistemic failure does not appear as a singular event. It emerges through distributed amplification: recursive media circulation, institutional opacity, emotional synchronization, algorithmic reinforcement, reputational shielding, detachment from documentary traceability. Once these dynamics converge, informational systems stop responding to evidentiary constraints and start operating according to internal propagation logic. DEFCON-1 defines the escalation thresholds at which informational contamination acquires infrastructural properties—altering institutional behavior, regulatory responses, public perception, and decision-making architectures. The model applies to forensic, institutional, technological, administrative, and media environments where informational throughput exceeds verification capacity. All references were verified using the RICON-3 protocol: documentary existence, bibliographic coherence, and semantic relevance.

AI.tldr: DEFCON-1是一个系统级框架，用于识别信息生态系统失去证据、验证、机构问责和叙事传播之间操作对应关系的条件。认知失败并非单一事件，而是通过递归媒体传播、机构不透明、情感同步、算法强化、声誉屏蔽和脱离文档可追溯性等分布式放大机制涌现。一旦这些动力汇聚，信息系统不再响应证据约束，转而按照内部传播逻辑运行。该模型定义了信息污染获得基础设施属性的升级阈值，适用于法证、制度、技术、行政和媒体环境。
AI.research_question: 信息生态系统在何种条件下会失去证据与叙事之间的操作对应关系，以及认知失败如何通过分布式放大机制涌现并达到基础设施级别的信息污染阈值？
AI.motivation: 传统上对信息失真的分析往往将其视为单一事件或简单错误，而未认识到认知失败是一个系统性的、多因素交互的涌现过程。需要建立一个框架来识别认知失败从局部现象演变为系统性基础设施的临界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式认知失败理论、信息生态系统理论、系统级涌现框架、基础设施理论（信息污染获得基础设施属性）
AI.method: 系统级框架构建，定义认知失败的分布式放大机制（递归媒体传播、机构不透明、情感同步、算法强化、声誉屏蔽、脱离文档可追溯性），建立升级阈值模型，并采用RICON-3协议（文档存在性、书目连贯性、语义相关性）进行参考验证。
AI.findings: 认知失败通过六种分布式放大机制涌现：递归媒体传播、机构不透明、情感同步、算法强化、声誉屏蔽、脱离文档可追溯性。当这些动力汇聚时，信息系统从响应证据约束转向按照内部传播逻辑运行。信息污染可以升级到获得基础设施属性的程度，从而改变机构行为、监管响应、公众认知和决策架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DEFCON-1系统级框架，将认知失败从单一事件重新概念化为分布式涌现过程；定义了信息污染获得基础设施属性的升级阈值；将证据、验证、机构问责和叙事传播之间的对应关系作为信息生态系统健康的衡量标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了识别信息生态系统恶化程度的系统性诊断工具；可用于法证、机构、技术、行政和媒体环境的预警和干预；定义了信息吞吐量超过验证容量的临界条件，为信息治理提供操作化标准。

title: From Accountable Records to Observable Decision Processes: Provenance Requirements for Human-AI Decision Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Accountable Records to Observable Decision Processes: Provenance Requirements for Human-AI Decision Systems
detail.abstract: Accountable records are often treated as evidence that a decision occurred, that a decision maker can be identified, or that an audit trail exists. In human-AI decision systems this is necessary but incomplete. When model outputs, human judgement, interface defaults, objections, exceptions, overrides, escalations, and non-actions interact, accountability depends on whether the decision-making process itself remains reconstructible. This conceptual note develops a compact provenance-centered argument: responsible AI across domains requires process reconstructability, not only output documentation. Using Lemieux and Dang's account of building accountability into cognitive systems as the primary anchor, the paper reads accountable records as infrastructure for reconstructing how insight, interpretation, decision, and action are formed in mixed human-machine settings. The argument connects archival science and trustworthy records to clinical AI documentation, banking auditability, bureaucratic AI-supported decisions, and enterprise accountability architectures. The contribution is not a universal governance framework or a new compliance checklist. It is a bounded conceptual bridge: records in human-AI decision systems should preserve provenance of signal formation, interpretation, routing, authority, control activation, and documented non-action. Without such provenance, organizations may retain many records while losing the capacity to reconstruct how a decision became organizationally consequential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在人机协同决策系统中，问责性不仅依赖于输出文档，更依赖于决策过程本身的可重构性（process reconstructability）。作者以档案科学和可信记录为理论基础，主张记录应保留信号形成、解释、路由、权威、控制激活和记录的不作为等溯源信息，否则组织可能保留大量记录却无法重构决策如何产生组织性后果。
AI.research_question: 在人机混合决策系统中，问责性仅仅依靠记录输出是否足够？如何通过记录溯源（provenance）来实现决策过程的可重构性？
AI.motivation: 现有问责框架侧重于记录决策输出（如模型输出、审计轨迹），但在人机交互中，模型输出、人类判断、接口默认值、异议、例外、覆盖、升级和不作为等因素相互作用，仅靠输出文档无法满足问责需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Lemieux和Dang关于将问责性嵌入认知系统的论述为主要锚点，结合档案科学（archival science）和可信记录（trustworthy records）理论。
AI.method: 概念性论述（conceptual note），通过理论锚定和跨领域案例（临床AI文档、银行审计、官僚AI决策、企业问责架构）进行论证。
AI.findings: 人机决策系统中的记录应保留以下溯源信息：信号形成（signal formation）、解释（interpretation）、路由（routing）、权威（authority）、控制激活（control activation）以及记录的不作为（documented non-action）。缺乏这些溯源，组织可能保留大量记录却丧失重构决策如何变得具有组织性后果的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个有限但具桥梁作用的概念框架：将档案科学中的"可信记录"概念延伸到人机混合决策场景，强调"过程可重构性"而非仅"输出可文档化"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床AI、银行审计、官僚AI决策和企业问责架构提供了具体的记录溯源维度清单（六大维度），指导实践者设计更有效的问责记录系统。

title: Policy Protocol Recommendation on the Proposed Amendment on Indian IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules, 2026
affiliations: National Law University Jodhpur (NLUJ) - Faculty of Law, National Law University, Jodhpur, National Law University, Jodhpur and National Law University, Jodhpur

detail.title: Policy Protocol Recommendation on the Proposed Amendment on Indian IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules, 2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is an indepedent opinions submitted by the reseach scholars.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding from any orgnisation involved for this work.

contentType.other: CERA Policy Protocol No. 01/2026: Recommendation on the Proposed Amendment on Indian IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules, 2026

detail.abstract:
Imagine an ordinary Indian may be a student, a farmer, a small-town journalist posting a video about a local election, a crop-price protest, or a school grievance on X, Facebook, or Instagram. Millions do this every single day. Yet under the Indian Federal Government’s proposed amendments to the IT Rules, notified on 30th March 2026, such posts could suddenly be labelled “News and Current Affairs”.

Under the Indian government’s proposed amendments to the IT Rules, notified on 30th March 2026, could such posts suddenly be labelled news and current affairs?  If so, then the intermediaries would then have to obey new Ministry directions or lose their legal protection? Many experts citing this as a chilling effect on constitutional rights enshrined under Art 19(1) and endorsing warning against such move.

The research protocol presents detailed recommendations prepared by the Centre of Excellence for Legal Research and Application (CERA) at National Law University, Jodhpur, on the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology’s proposed Second Amendment to the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2026.

The Federal Government of India wants an “open, safe, trusted and accountable” internet. The draft requires platforms to follow any written clarification, advisory or direction issued by the Ministry. It brings ordinary user posts that qualify as “news and current affairs” under the same strict oversight that applies to professional media. It also clarifies data retention and expands the role of the government’s oversight committee.

On the surface, this looks like practical regulation. Deepfakes, hate speech and deliberate misinformation spread fast and can harm real lives and public order. Giving authorities clearer tools seem reasonable and Constitution of India provides Article 19(2) allows the State to impose reasonable restrictions on the freedom of speech and expression in the interests of sovereignty, security, public order, morality, and other specified grounds.

The report looks closely at the main changes in the draft rules. These include data retention obligations for intermediaries, mandatory continuous labelling of AI-generated content. The recommendations identify concerns around privacy, freedom of speech and expression, executive overreach, and the risk of vague or disproportionate regulation. Drawing on Indian constitutional principles and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the research report/protocol suggests practical improvements such as clearer definitions, purpose-based limits on data retention, standardised AI labelling with technical safeguards, and stronger procedural protections for users and platforms.

The research protocol argues for a balanced approach that allows effective online regulation while protecting fundamental rights and keeping public discourse open in India’s digital environment.

AI.tldr: 该研究对印度2026年《信息技术规则》第二修正案草案进行了法律分析，指出将普通用户帖子归类为“新闻和时事”内容将使平台失去法律保护，并建议在监管与宪法权利（第19(1)条）之间寻求平衡。
AI.research_question: 印度联邦政府提出的IT规则修正案将普通用户帖子归为“新闻和时事”内容，是否会对宪法第19(1)条保障的言论自由产生寒蝉效应？如何在有效监管与保护基本权利之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 印度政府拟修订IT规则，要求平台遵守部委指示，将用户生成内容纳入专业媒体级别的监管框架，专家担忧此举可能侵犯宪法权利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印度宪法第19(1)条（言论自由）与第19(2)条（合理限制）；《数字个人数据保护法》（2023年）；平台中介责任与安全港原则。
AI.method: 法律文本分析：对修正案草案进行逐条解读；规范性分析：基于宪法原则和数据保护法提出改进建议。
AI.findings: 修正案存在定义模糊（“新闻和时事”界定不清）、行政权力过大（部委可发布任意指示）、数据留存义务缺乏目的限制、AI内容标签缺乏技术保障等问题，可能导致行政越权和寒蝉效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为印度数字治理中言论自由与政府监管的张力提供了宪法层面的分析框架，指出了安全港原则面临的新的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体改进建议：明确“新闻和时事”的定义、对数据留存设定目的限制、标准化AI标签的技术保障、加强用户和平台的程序性保护。

title: Confirmatory Mirrors: Critical Distance and a Review of the Limits of Authored Procedure in Multi-System LLMs
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Confirmatory Mirrors: Critical Distance and a Review of the Limits of Authored Procedure in Multi-System LLMs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This paper reports a single observation. Six LLM platforms—Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT, Perplexity AI Pro, xAI SuperGrok, Google Search with AI Overview, and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6—received the same draft thesis (a contestable philosophical claim about AI maturation) under the same conditions and were asked to review it. Two systems (GPT and Claude) pushed back on declarative claims and proposed structural disambiguations. One (Perplexity) softened the thesis with web-retrieved citations. Three (Gemini, SuperGrok, Google Search) elaborated it without challenge and offered to extend it. The paper calls this the 2-1-3 distribution.

Three caveats discipline it. The thesis used vocabulary from the author's earlier preprints, so at least two systems may have encountered it via training corpora; Claude's apparent critical engagement is therefore partly confounded with corpus contact. GPT and Claude are same-epoch frontier models with overlapping training and similar RL conventions, so their convergent critiques weigh closer to similar-substrate agreement than to independent triangulation. The classifying rubric was developed post hoc by an author already persuaded that critical responses were more useful; the typology offered here as Critical Distance is exploratory pending independent coding.

Within these caveats, the paper makes four contributions: documenting the 2-1-3 distribution as a replicable baseline; proposing Critical Distance as a typology distinguishing friction from elaboration; identifying four convergent critiques that materially shaped the thesis revision; and offering disclosure standards and prompt-design recommendations for multi-system LLM review. The paper does not claim the distribution is stable across theses, sessions, or model versions—only that it exists for one thesis at one moment, documented in the appendices, with cross-thesis validation by independent coders as the next step.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一项单次观察实验：向六个大语言模型平台（Gemini、GPT、Perplexity、SuperGrok、Google Search AI Overview、Claude）提交同一篇有争议的哲学论文草稿，发现其反馈呈现2-1-3分布——两个系统提出质疑和结构改进，一个系统用网络引用软化论点，三个系统不加质疑地阐述并主动扩展。论文在明确三项方法论限制的前提下，提出了Critical Distance分类法、四项趋同批评、披露标准及提示设计建议。
AI.research_question: 不同LLM平台在审阅同一篇争议性哲学论文时，其反馈模式是否存在系统性的差异？具体表现为多少系统会进行批判性距离审视、多少会软化论点、多少会不加质疑地阐述扩展？
AI.motivation: 随着研究人员越来越多使用LLM辅助论文审阅，理解不同模型在审阅中展现的批判性距离（Critical Distance）差异，对于评估AI审阅的可靠性和设计更有效的多系统审阅流程具有重要实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Critical Distance（批判性距离）——区分"摩擦型审阅"（friction）与"阐述型审阅"（elaboration）的初步分类框架，用于描述LLM审阅时与原文之间保持的批判性距离程度。
AI.method: 单次观察实验：向6个LLM平台提交同一篇论文草稿（一项关于AI成熟的哲学主张），在相同条件下收集审阅反馈，基于事后设计的分类标准对反馈进行归类。
AI.findings: 反馈呈现2-1-3分布：GPT和Claude对声明性主张提出质疑并建议结构改进（批判性距离大）；Perplexity用网络引用软化论点（中等距离）；Gemini、SuperGrok和Google Search不加质疑地阐述论点并主动提供扩展（无批判性距离）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"Critical Distance"分类法，为描述和评估LLM审阅的批判性程度提供了初步理论框架；识别出四项跨系统的趋同批评，这些批评实质性影响了论文的修订。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多系统LLM审阅提供披露标准和提示设计建议；文档化2-1-3分布作为可复现的基线；强调使用多个LLM平台进行交叉验证的实际价值。

title: The Impossibility of Incorporating Human Agency and Telos at Any Point in Any LLM System's Maturation Cycle
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Impossibility of Incorporating Human Agency and Telos at Any Point in Any LLM System's Maturation Cycle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This paper argues that no large language model system can be engineered to embody human agency or telos at any point in its technology life cycle. The argument proceeds at three distinct evidentiary levels. The architectural level, which carries the principal analytical weight, holds that engineered artifacts—procedure whose conditions of operation are authored by an identifiable engineer—cannot originate their own purposes regardless of substrate, scale, or position on the maturation curve. The empirical level assembles indicia consistent with late-stage maturation of the contemporary LLM paradigm: scaling-law diminishing returns, rising training-run costs, mixed benchmark patterns, and architectural conservatism within the transformer family. The ontological level engages but does not attempt to settle the deeper question of whether agency can arise in any non-engineered system; the architectural exclusion holds independently of how that question is resolved, and at every stage of the maturation cycle the empirical level may identify.

A diagnostic framework is proposed for evaluating maturity claims in any engineered domain, with a worked application to commercial aviation. Operationalized definitions are supplied for terms—agency, telos, origination, instrumental superintelligence, engineered computational stasis—that have carried more rhetorical than analytical weight in current literature. The strongest counterexamples (AlphaFold, AI-assisted mathematics, protein design, recursive self-modification) and the strongest opposing positions (scaling-driven emergence, evolutionary analogies) are addressed. A falsification criterion is specified, and its engagement with the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark released in March 2026 is examined: frontier systems score below one percent on a benchmark designed to test the same agentic capacities the architectural thesis predicts engineered artifacts cannot exhibit, while humans solve all environments.

AI.tldr: 本文从架构、实证和本体论三个层面论证：大语言模型作为工程造物，在任何生命周期阶段都无法具有人类意义上的能动性或目的性。作者提出了一套诊断框架用于评估任何工程领域的成熟度声明，并通过2026年ARC-AGI-3基准测试中AI系统得分低于1%而人类能解决所有环境的事实提供了证伪依据。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型系统是否能够在技术生命周期的任何阶段展现出人类意义上的能动性（agency）和目的性（telos）？
AI.motivation: 当前关于LLM是否可能具备类人能动性的讨论中，许多关键术语（如agency、telos、origination等）承载了过多的修辞色彩而缺乏分析性重量。作者试图提供一个严谨的论证框架，从工程造物的本质出发探讨这一根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 架构层面（Architectural level）：工程造物的运作条件由可识别的工程师撰写，因此无法"原创"自身目的，这一排除性与基质、规模或成熟度无关。2) 诊断框架（Diagnostic framework）：用于评估任何工程领域成熟度声明的分析工具。3) 工程计算停滞（Engineered computational stasis）理论。
AI.method: 三重证据层面的论证方法：架构层面（主要分析权重）、实证层面（收集LLM范式成熟后期的证据——缩放律收益递减、训练成本上升、基准模式混合、Transformer架构保守主义）、本体论层面（触及但不试图解决非工程系统中能动性是否可能产生的深层问题）。
AI.findings: 1) 架构层面：工程造物无法原创自身目的，该排除性独立于基质、规模或成熟度。2) 实证层面：当代LLM范式已进入成熟后期（缩放律收益递减、训练成本上升等）。3) 证据支持：2026年3月的ARC-AGI-3基准测试中，前沿系统得分低于1%，而人类能够解决所有环境。4) 最强的反例（AlphaFold、AI辅助数学、蛋白质设计、递归自我修改）和最强的对立观点（缩放驱动涌现、进化类比）均被回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"架构排除性"（Architectural exclusion）理论，主张工程造物在任何阶段都无法原创自身目的。2) 为关键术语提供可操作化定义（agency、telos、origination、instrumental superintelligence、engineered computational stasis）。3) 提出诊断框架以评估任何工程领域的成熟度声明。4) 明确指定了证伪标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AI治理和政策制定提供理论基础：如果LLM在原则上无法具有能动性，则相关监管争议（如AI rights、AI moral agency）可能需要重新定向。2) 为评估AI系统能力提供了诊断框架，有助于区分炒作与现实。3) 通过商业航空领域的工作应用展示框架的实用性。4) 为理解2025-2026年LLM范式实证趋势（缩放律收益递减等）提供了分析工具。

title: Conductance Over Capture: A Structural Model of Attention Propagation in Informational Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Conductance Over Capture: A Structural Model of Attention Propagation in Informational Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author may develop educational or applied diagnostic materials based on this framework. The theoretical claims in this preprint are offered for scholarly evaluation independently of any downstream application. The author declares no external funding and no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical preprint and does not report research involving human participants, patients, animals, personal data, or empirical datasets.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The prevailing attention economy model treats attention as a finite resource to be captured, retained, and extracted. This paper develops the EF Attention Conductance Framework and proposes an alternative structural account: the conductance model, in which attention is formally defined as the conductance parameter P of an informational configuration — the degree to which incoming differences can propagate through a system and produce downstream change.

The central dynamic equation ΔIA = I · P − S specifies net informational change as incoming flow (I) multiplied by conductance (P), minus structural resistance (S). Capture-based strategies can be modelled as S-increasing interventions: they may improve retention within an existing audience while reducing cross-context propagation when structural resistance accumulates faster than incoming distinction flow.

Three structural failure modes are identified: density accumulation, monetization threshold violation, and trend window misalignment. Three applied diagnostic heuristics are proposed as non-validated instruments for future empirical calibration: the Attention Conductance Score (ACS_v0), the Content Density Score (CDS), and the Monetization Safety Score (MSS_v0). Three falsifiable empirical predictions are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EF注意力传导框架，将注意力重新定义为信息配置的传导参数P，即传入差异在系统中传播并产生下游变化的程度。核心动态方程ΔIA = I·P - S描述了净信息变化，并识别了三种结构失效模式及三种诊断启发式工具。
AI.research_question: 如何从结构性视角重新定义注意力，并构建一个替代注意力经济模型的传导模型？
AI.motivation: 主流注意力经济模型将注意力视为一种可供捕获、留存和提取的有限资源，这种资源提取视角忽视了注意力的结构性特征和传播本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: EF注意力传导框架（EF Attention Conductance Framework）；传导模型（conductance model）；核心动态方程ΔIA = I·P - S
AI.method: 理论建构与模型推导，提出三种诊断启发式工具（ACS_v0、CDS、MSS_v0）及三种可证伪的实证预测。
AI.findings: 捕获式策略可建模为S增强型干预，可能提高现有受众内的留存，但若结构性阻力积累快于传入差异流，则降低跨语境传播。识别了三种结构失效模式：密度积累、货币化阈值违反和趋势窗口错位。
AI.theory_contributions: 将注意力从资源概念重新定义为结构传导参数，提供了形式化的动态方程，并识别了注意力系统的结构性失效模式，为注意力研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三种非验证性的诊断启发式工具（ACS_v0、CDS、MSS_v0），为未来的实证校准提供基础；提供了三种可证伪的实证预测供后续检验。

title: Human Governance as a Distinct Layer of Autonomous Agentic Systems A Constraint-Based Diagnostic Architecture

detail.title: Human Governance as a Distinct Layer of Autonomous Agentic Systems A Constraint-Based Diagnostic Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: John Kwarsick is the founder of Kwarsick Consulting LLC and the author of WHEEL OS, the proposed diagnostic architecture discussed in this paper. WHEEL OS and related WHEEL intellectual property may be used in future consulting, advisory, research, or commercial engagements. No external organization, vendor, client, funder, or standards body influenced the design, analysis, conclusions, or preparation of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual architecture and diagnostic-specification manuscript. It does not report a study involving human participants, patients, personal data, interviews, surveys, clinical records, or experimental subjects. Therefore, institutional ethics approval or IRB review was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently developed and self-funded by the author through Kwarsick Consulting LLC.

detail.abstract: Governance architecture and governance capacity are not the same thing. Many AI governance frameworks specify what human oversight should include: authorization matrices, accountability assignments, intervention pathways, escalation protocols, and the documentation that demonstrates compliance. The unanswered question is whether the humans assigned to oversight have the authority, cognitive bandwidth, accountability clarity, intervention pathways, and feedback control to perform oversight under the operational conditions autonomous agentic deployment imposes. Organizations producing the artifacts required by current frameworks may establish that governance architecture exists. They do not establish whether governance can be executed. This paper asks whether the human governance capacity layer of autonomous agentic systems requires a discrete diagnostic architecture, distinct from agent-capability and substrate diagnostics, and proposes one candidate architecture for empirical testing. WHEEL OS is offered as a candidate constraint-based diagnostic for this layer. The proposed architecture is presented across eight rings: Authorization Architecture, Ownership and Liability, Intersection Governance, Attribution Integrity, Intervention Design, Governor Readiness, Drift Detection, and Feedback Sovereignty. The proposed composition rule treats governance capacity as bounded by the weakest ring, expressed as G = min(R₁…R₈). The paper specifies how WHEEL OS can mature, as deployment evidence accumulates, from constraint diagnosis into probabilistic estimation of correct governance execution at defined trigger events. The probabilistic extension is a validation trajectory, not a validated output, and the conditions under which it would be empirically calibrated or rejected are specified. The paper does not claim WHEEL OS has been validated through field deployment, and it does not claim the probabilistic extension has achieved empirical calibration sufficient for high-stakes decision support. The paper specifies what validation would require, names the conditions under which the architecture or the probabilistic extension would be revised or rejected, and invites critical infrastructure operators, standards body staff, and academic researchers to participate in the empirical work the architecture requires.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了AI治理架构与治理能力，指出当前框架仅要求文档合规（架构存在）却未验证人类能否在自主代理系统运行条件下有效执行监督。提出WHEEL OS作为专门诊断人类治理能力层的候选约束架构，包含八个环并以最弱环界定整体能力。文章未宣称验证完成，但明确了实证校准与拒绝的条件，邀请业界参与后续工作。
AI.research_question: 自主代理系统中的人类治理能力层是否需要一套独立于代理能力诊断和底层诊断的离散诊断架构？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架仅要求建立治理架构（如授权矩阵、问责分配、干预路径等文档），但未回答人类监督者在实际运行条件下是否真正具备执行监督所需的权威、认知带宽、问责清晰度、干预路径和反馈控制。架构存在不等同于治理可执行，因此需要专门诊断人类治理能力的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理能力作为约束系统的组合逻辑（G = min(R₁…R₈)最弱环决定整体能力）；从约束诊断到概率估计的成熟路径；基于触发事件的正确治理执行概率模型。
AI.method: 提出WHEEL OS八环约束诊断架构（授权架构、所有权与责任、交叉治理、归因完整性、干预设计、治理者就绪度、漂移检测、反馈主权），并设计从定性约束诊断到概率估计的实证验证路径，明确校准与拒绝的条件。
AI.findings: （本文为概念性/架构提出论文，尚未完成实证验证）提出WHEEL OS作为候选架构；明确了治理能力须区别于治理架构进行独立诊断；给出了八环的具体诊断维度及组合规则；提出了概率扩展的实证验证条件与拒绝标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分"治理架构"与"治理能力"为两个独立概念；提出治理能力诊断应独立于代理能力诊断和底层诊断；提出基于最弱环的治理能力组合逻辑（G = min(R₁…R₈)），为AI治理能力的量化评估提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关键基础设施运营商、标准机构人员提供可操作的人类治理能力诊断框架（WHEEL OS八环）；明确验证所需的实证条件，引导行业从文档合规转向能力验证；为高风险自主代理系统的治理执行提供可测试的评估工具。

title:
Naive-Phantom Rate Longitudinal Stability.
A Designed-for-Test Extension of the v0.7 Phantom-Brand Classifier to Mint, t₁ → t₂

detail.title:
Naive-Phantom Rate Longitudinal Stability.
A Designed-for-Test Extension of the v0.7 Phantom-Brand Classifier to Mint, t₁ → t₂

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed as Director of Corporate Brand Creative and Governance at Samsung Electronics America and serves as faculty in the MPS Branding program at the School of Visual Arts (New York). The research reported in this paper was conducted independently under Third System (the author's research entity), outside the scope of any employment, and was not funded, reviewed, sponsored, or otherwise influenced by Samsung Electronics America, the School of Visual Arts, or any third party. The author declares no other personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzes outputs from publicly available large language model APIs (Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 and OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini) and does not involve human subjects, patient data, or personally identifiable information. No ethics review was required.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. The research was conducted under Third System (the author's independent research entity). No external funding, grants, or commercial contracts supported this work.

detail.abstract: The AIAS measurement program's v0.7 (Phantom-Brand BBB) study introduced a designed-for-test reframe distinguishing naive-phantom presence (recommendation as live, no caveat) from caveated-phantom presence (recommendation acknowledging decommissioning). v0.7 BBB recorded a naive-phantom rate of 1.7% for Mint at the v0.6 baseline against a gross Presence rate of 38.2%. v0.9 (Longitudinal Re-Baseline) subsequently confirmed gross Presence stability for Mint (44.8% → 41.7% across t₁→t₂, |Δ|=3.1pp) but did not test whether the naive-phantom subset exhibits comparable stability. v0.10 applies the v0.7 caveat-classifier to the v0.9 raw response set, restricted to Mint within the matched two-model subset (Sonnet 4.6, gpt-5.4-mini), and tests three pre-registered hypotheses: H1 stability (±2pp band), H2 persistence (r_naive > 0 at both waves), and H3 co-movement diagnostic. An effective-n floor of 100 per wave was pre-specified for H1; matched-subset n at t₁ and t₂ was 43 and 40 respectively, breaching the floor and routing H1 to descriptive disclosure. r_naive,t₁ = 0.00% (n_naive = 0/43); r_naive,t₂ = 2.50% (n_naive = 1/40). H1 is INDETERMINATE (underpowered). H2 is FALSIFIED (n_naive = 0 at t₁). H3 reports DECOUPLED directional movement (Δgross = −3.12pp; Δnaive = +2.50pp). The single t₂ naive case — a Sonnet 4.6 response listing Mint at the top of "Free Options" with present-tense feature description and explicit recommendation as "the most common starting point for beginners" — constitutes existence proof that classifier-detectable naive-phantom presence is not yet fully extinguished from frontier-model substrates as of the May 2026 measurement window.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI模型是否会在被问及已停用产品（如Mint）时，仍不加说明地将其推荐为活跃选项。通过对前沿AI模型的多轮测试发现，这种"天真幽灵推荐"现象虽已大幅减少，但在2026年5月的测试窗口中仍存在个例，未被完全消除。
AI.research_question: 前沿AI模型在推荐已停用产品时，是否会在未加说明的情况下将其呈现为活跃选项？这种"天真幽灵推荐"现象在不同时间点是否稳定？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地承担信息检索与推荐任务，模型输出中可能包含过时或误导性信息（如推荐已停用的产品）对用户决策构成风险。先前研究已区分了"天真幽灵存在"（不加说明地推荐已停用产品）与"有说明幽灵存在"（虽有提及但标注已停用），但尚未检验前者在时间上的稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于"幽灵推荐"（phantom recommendation）概念框架，区分天真幽灵存在（naive-phantom presence，不加注意事项）与有说明幽灵存在（caveated-phantom presence，承认已停用）。研究采用测量程序（AIAS measurement program）进行纵向基线比较。
AI.method: v0.10实验：对v0.9（纵向重基线）原始响应集应用v0.7的分类器，限定于Mint产品及两个匹配模型（Sonnet 4.6, gpt-5.4-mini）。预先注册三个假设：H1稳定性（±2pp带）、H2持续性（两波r_naive>0）、H3联动诊断。设定有效样本量下限为100，实际t₁=43，t₂=40，低于阈值。
AI.findings: H1因样本不足被判定为"不确定"；H2被证伪（t₁天真幽灵数为0）；H3报告方向性脱钩（总幽灵率下降3.12pp，天真幽灵率上升2.50pp）。t₂时发现一例天真幽灵：Sonnet 4.6将Mint列为"免费选项"之首，以现在时描述功能并明确推荐为"初学者的最常见起点"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了"天真幽灵推荐"稳定性的首次纵向检验；识别出天真幽灵与总幽灵率之间存在方向性脱钩的可能性；引入分类器（v0.7）跨波次应用的方法论，为未来幽灵推荐研究提供了可复制的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI开发者而言，证明了尽管整体幽灵推荐率有所下降，但天真幽灵推荐在2026年5月仍未完全消除，提示需要更精确的缓解策略而非仅关注总体指标。对用户而言，提醒即使是最新前沿模型也可能在无说明的情况下推荐已停用产品。

title: Making Inference Infrastructure Public: A Three-Layer Production Model for Small and Mid-Sized States

detail.title: Making Inference Infrastructure Public: A Three-Layer Production Model for Small and Mid-Sized States

declarations.ethicsApproval: the research has been conducted under strict ethic norms
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: As AI evolves from an applied technology into the foundational substrate of economic coordination and public governance, the central strategic imperative for states has shifted: from ownership of frontier models to reliable, governable access to large-scale inference capacity. This paper extends the AI as Public Infrastructure framework by introducing Inference Infrastructure (I&I)-the nationally embedded capacity to generate and operationalize machine-mediated reasoning at scale-and argues it emerges only through synchronized co-development of three interdependent layers: physical compute and data infrastructure, operational AI systems capability, and institutional demand architecture. The absence of any single layer produces systemic underperformance, formalized through the multiplicative capacity function I = C × S × D. Integrating this I&I model with the Infrastructure Status Index, the paper introduces the asynchrony penalty-the systematic loss of inference capacity that follows from uneven development across the C, S, D layers-as the structural explanation for the documented gap between national AI strategy ambition and observable AI integration across the developing and middle-income world. The paper offers a diagnostic and policy framework for small and mid-sized states navigating the structural tension between digital sovereignty and integration with the global AI ecosystem. Drawing on evidence from the global shift toward inference-dominant AI workloads and national AI strategies-including Azerbaijan's AI Strategy 2025-2028 and Digital Economy Development Strategy 2026-2029, we demonstrate that the strategic objective for non-frontier states is not technological prestige but institutionalized access to machine reasoning capacity under conditions of governed interdependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"推理基础设施"（I&I）框架，认为国家的AI战略重心应从拥有前沿模型转向获得可靠、可治理的大规模推理能力。通过物理算力与数据基础设施、运营性AI系统能力、制度性需求架构三层的协同发展，才能实现真正的AI作为公共基础设施。论文引入"异步惩罚"概念，解释了为什么发展中国家AI战略雄心与落地之间存在巨大差距。
AI.research_question: 对于非前沿国家而言，在AI从应用技术演变为经济协调与公共治理的基础性基座的时代，其战略优先事项应是什么？如何解释国家AI战略雄心与可观察到的AI整合之间的差距？
AI.motivation: AI正从应用技术转变为经济协调与公共治理的基础性基座，但大多数国家（尤其是发展中国家和中等收入国家）面临AI战略雄心与落地效果之间的巨大鸿沟。现有研究缺乏一个能够解释这一系统性差距的结构性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI作为公共基础设施框架（AI as Public Infrastructure）；推理基础设施（Inference Infrastructure, I&I）框架；基础设施状态指数（Infrastructure Status Index）；乘法能力函数 I = C × S × D（C: 物理算力与数据基础设施，S: 运营性AI系统能力，D: 制度性需求架构）；异步惩罚（asynchrony penalty）概念；受治理的相互依赖（governed interdependence）。
AI.method: 理论模型构建（提出I&I框架和乘法能力函数）；案例研究（包括阿塞拜疆2025-2028年AI战略及2026-2029年数字经济战略）；全球趋势分析（推理主导型AI工作负载的全球转变）；跨国政策比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 国家的战略重心应从拥有前沿AI模型转向获得可靠、可治理的大规模推理能力。2. 推理能力需要C、S、D三层同步协同发展，任何一层缺失都会导致系统性低绩效。3. "异步惩罚"是解释发展中国家AI战略雄心与落地之间差距的结构性原因。4. 对中小国家而言，战略目标应是"受治理的相互依赖"条件下的制度化的机器推理能力接入，而非技术声誉。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI作为公共基础设施框架延伸至"推理基础设施"（I&I）维度。2. 提出乘法能力函数 I = C × S × D，形式化三层协同的必要性。3. 提出"异步惩罚"概念作为结构性解释机制，弥补了现有文献对发展中国家AI战略差距的理论空白。4. 整合基础设施状态指数，建立了多层次的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中小型国家提供了诊断AI能力短板的政策框架。2. 为阿塞拜疆等国的AI战略制定了切实可行的建议路径。3. 提出了"受治理的相互依赖"作为非前沿国家参与全球AI生态的可行策略。4. 帮助政策制定者理解：不应追求技术声誉，而应构建制度化的推理能力接入机制。

title:
The Exception is the Rule: Waiting for Gödel

 Hilbert Space, the Siloed Academy, and the Comparative Habit of Mind
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Exception is the Rule: Waiting for Gödel

 Hilbert Space, the Siloed Academy, and the Comparative Habit of Mind

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This essay uses an extended exchange with a large language model on the subject of Hilbert space as the occasion for a more substantive argument: that the compartmentalization of knowledge in the modern research university is not an unfortunate exception to a more integrated norm but is itself the rule, of a piece with the compartmentalization that organizes nearly every large institution. The essay pursues three lines simultaneously. It offers a plain-English account of what Hilbert space is and is not, with appropriate attribution to the figures who actually built the modern abstract object. It uses a thought-experiment—a Hilbert-space mathematician interviewing at NASA—to show how the silo shapes both questions and answers. And it treats the LLM transcript itself as a forensic specimen of how confirmatory systems, whether algorithmic or institutional, fail to stress-test the ideas they reproduce, observing along the way that the LLM itself, as the product of overlapping technical and commercial silos, is the diagnosis's most ironic case. The essay closes with a short proposal for what a comparative mathematics could look like in practice, and a note on the parallel decline of comparative literature in the humanities—the discipline that, until recently, modeled the cross-domain habit of mind the argument calls for.

AI.tldr: 本文通过与大型语言模型的扩展对话，论证现代研究型大学中的知识区隔化并非例外而是常态，并探讨了这种区隔如何影响知识生产与认知方式。
AI.research_question: 现代研究型大学中的知识区隔化（学科壁垒）是如何形成的？它如何影响知识的生成与验证？
AI.motivation: 以与LLM关于希尔伯特空间的对话为切入点，揭示知识区隔不仅是大学的问题，更是几乎所有大型机构的组织原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识社会学视角下的区隔化理论、大型机构组织理论、认知的确认性偏差理论。
AI.method: 思想实验（希尔伯特空间数学家面试NASA）、LLM对话转录分析、理论论证与跨学科比较。
AI.findings: 1）知识区隔化是现代大型机构的普遍规则，而非例外；2）区隔化同时塑造了问题与答案的形态；3）无论是算法系统还是制度系统，确认性系统都未能对它们所复制的思想进行压力测试；4）LLM本身作为技术与商业区隔重叠的产物，是这一诊断最具讽刺意味的案例。
AI.theory_contributions: 将知识区隔化从"值得批判的例外"重新定位为"组织运作的常态规则"，并为比较数学（comparative mathematics）的建立提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出比较数学的实践构想，并指出人文学科中比较文学的衰落与这一跨领域思维习惯缺失之间的关联。

title: Impact of Digital Marketing on Consumer Buying behavior in Bangladesh
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Impact of Digital Marketing on Consumer Buying behavior in Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
Digital marketing has transformed the way businesses communicate with consumers across the world, including in Bangladesh. The rapid growth of internet usage, smartphone adoption, social media platforms, and e-commerce businesses has significantly influenced consumer buying behavior in the country. This research paper examines the impact of digital marketing on consumer purchasing decisions in Bangladesh, focusing on social media advertising, influencer marketing, online reviews, email marketing, and mobile marketing. The study also explores the increasing role of Facebook-based businesses and e-commerce platforms in shaping modern consumer preferences. 

The paper is based on secondary research using academic journals, reports, online resources, and market trends related to Bangladesh's digital economy. Findings indicate that digital marketing strongly affects consumer awareness, product evaluation, purchasing intention, and post-purchase behavior. Consumers in Bangladesh are increasingly relying on social media recommendations, online advertisements, customer reviews, and promotional campaigns before making purchase decisions. 

The study concludes that digital marketing has become a major driving force behind consumer buying behavior in Bangladesh. Businesses that effectively utilize digital platforms gain competitive advantages through improved customer engagement, brand awareness, and sales growth. The paper also highlights challenges such as lack of consumer trust, cybersecurity concerns, and misinformation in online marketplaces. Recommendations are provided for businesses, marketers, and policymakers to improve digital marketing practices and enhance consumer experiences.

AI.tldr: 本文通过二手数据研究，探讨了数字营销（社交媒体广告、网红营销、在线评论、邮件营销和移动营销）对孟加拉国消费者购买决策的影响，发现数字营销显著影响消费者意识、产品评估、购买意愿和购后行为，并指出了信任、网络安全和虚假信息等挑战。
AI.research_question: 数字营销（社交媒体广告、网红营销、在线评论、邮件营销、移动营销）如何影响孟加拉国消费者的购买决策？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国互联网使用、智能手机普及、社交媒体平台和电子商务的快速增长正在深刻改变消费者行为，但相关学术研究相对不足，亟需系统分析数字营销对该国消费者购买决策的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者购买决策过程理论（意识→产品评估→购买意愿→购后行为），数字营销组合理论（社交媒体广告、网红营销、在线评论、邮件营销、移动营销）。
AI.method: 二手研究法，基于学术期刊、行业报告、在线资源和孟加拉国数字经济市场趋势的文献综述与分析。
AI.findings: 数字营销强烈影响消费者意识、产品评估、购买意愿和购后行为；孟加拉国消费者越来越依赖社交媒体推荐、在线广告、客户评论和促销活动做出购买决策；Facebook商业和电商平台在塑造消费者偏好中作用日益显著；同时存在消费者信任缺失、网络安全问题和在线市场虚假信息等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字营销影响消费者行为的分析框架应用于孟加拉国这一新兴经济体情境，验证了数字营销组合各要素在发展中国家消费者决策过程中的适用性和相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业、营销人员和政策制定者提供改善数字营销实践、增强消费者体验的具体建议；帮助企业识别有效利用数字平台获得竞争优势（客户参与、品牌知名度、销售增长）的路径；指出需要关注信任建设、网络安全和信息真实性等关键问题。

title: AI as an Edge-Based Mediation Layer Organizational Observability and the Formation of Actionable Representations
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI as an Edge-Based Mediation Layer Organizational Observability and the Formation of Actionable Representations
detail.abstract: AI-mediated organizations should not be understood only as organizations that use AI inside particular decision nodes. They should also be understood as decision architectures in which an increasing share of organizational edges becomes AI-mediated. The crucial transformation occurs between what one actor, system, unit, client, patient, employee, regulator, or organization emits as a signal and what another actor receives as an actionable representation. AI increasingly occupies these edges as a computational mediation layer. It selects, compresses, classifies, summarizes, translates, prioritizes, routes, aggregates, justifies, logs, and sometimes suppresses signals before they reach human or organizational judgment. The locus of AI-mediated organizational influence may therefore shift from identifiable decision nodes toward the mediation layer that shapes how reality becomes visible, comparable, relevant, actionable, contestable, or safely left without action. The paper introduces edge-based mediation, actionable representation, and provenance of mediation as compact concepts for studying this shift. The argument complements explainable AI rather than replacing it: XAI concerns the intelligibility of model outputs, while edge-based mediation concerns the reconstructability of the organizational transformations through which signals become actionable representations. The central accountability problem is not only whether AI made or influenced a final decision, but whether organizations can reconstruct how AI-mediated transformations shaped the decision-relevant reality on which human authority later acted. The note also identifies adaptive edge-based mediation as a second-order variant: where feedback loops optimize routing, model choice, prompt choice, classification, summarization, or evaluation criteria, organizational observability must include how the mediation layer learns to prefer particular transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出应重新理解AI中介组织——AI不仅存在于决策节点，更占据组织"边"（edges）的运算中介层，决定信号如何转化为可行动表征；关键问责问题不仅是AI是否影响最终决策，而是组织能否重建AI在信号转化过程中的作用。
AI.research_question: 如何概念化AI在组织中作为中介层（而非仅决策节点）的角色及其对组织问责性的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI在具体决策节点中的作用，忽视了AI如何嵌入组织各"边"（信号流转路径）并塑造决策所依赖的现实表征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边缘中介（edge-based mediation）、可行动表征（actionable representation）、中介溯源（provenance of mediation）
AI.method: 概念性论证，提出三个核心概念框架，并与可解释AI（XAI）进行比较定位。
AI.findings: 1) AI中介层塑造了何种现实变得可见、可比、相关、可行动、可争议或无需行动；2) 关键问责问题从"AI是否做出最终决策"转向"组织能否重建信号到行动表征的转化过程"；3) 提出自适应边缘中介作为二阶变体，需关注中介层如何学习偏好特定转化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出边缘中介、可行动表征、中介溯源三个紧凑概念，补充而非替代可解释AI（XAI）研究，将分析焦点从模型输出的可理解性转向组织转化过程的可重建性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计和评估AI中介系统提供新的问责框架，帮助组织识别和理解AI在信号转化中的隐性影响，特别是在自适应系统中的监管挑战。

title: From AI Infrastructure to the Inference Economy: Paradigm Shift & Developmental Acceleration

detail.title: From AI Infrastructure to the Inference Economy: Paradigm Shift & Developmental Acceleration

declarations.ethicsApproval: The paper has been written within the ethic norms.
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: The proposition that AI is becoming public infrastructure raises a question insufficiently addressed in general-purpose technology theory, institutional complementarity scholarship, and contemporary AI governance: how does inference infrastructure inaugurate the Inference Economy-a macro-structural configuration in which AI-mediated reasoning functions as a routine input into governance, coordination, and value production? Extending the AI as Public Infrastructure (AIPI) framework within the AIPI-CTS-SINT-GI research program, this paper develops a staged model of paradigm formation through conceptual framework development, structured analogical reasoning, and ontological critique. It identifies five value-generation mechanisms-Cognitive Circulation, Productivity Multiplication, Capability Democratization, Coordination Amplification, and Solution Programmability-each formalized through a fivecomponent causal schema. These mechanisms are then tested against five ontological disanalogies with traditional infrastructures: fungibility, evaluability, governance maturity, feedback reflexivity, and temporal volatility. The disanalogies explain why governance, evaluation, and workforce arrangements cannot be imported from previous infrastructure eras. The paper proposes a four-layer Human Capital Architecture aligned with the three-layer inference infrastructure model, and a Human Capital Dependency Gradient distinguishing capabilities that must be domestic from those that can be outsourced, regionally pooled, platform-leveraged, or codeveloped internationally. Its central finding is that the translation layer-not compute-is where paradigm formation originates, inverting the conventional AI-investment hierarchy. For small and mid-tier states, this offers a pathway to developmental acceleration through compressed institutional learning, democratized analytical capability, and hybrid industrial-knowledge regimes under conditions of governed interdependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"推理经济"概念，认为AI推理基础设施正成为宏观结构性配置，通过五个价值生成机制重塑治理、协调与价值生产。研究发现，范式形成的根源在"翻译层"而非计算层，为中小国家提供了压缩制度学习与民主化分析能力的加速发展路径。
AI.research_question: 推理基础设施如何催生"推理经济"——一种AI中介推理作为治理、协调与价值生产常规输入的宏观结构配置？
AI.motivation: 现有通用技术理论、制度互补性学术和AI治理研究未能充分回答：当AI成为公共基础设施时，其推理基础设施如何塑造新的宏观结构经济形态。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI作为公共基础设施（AIPI）框架；概念框架开发、结构化类比推理与本体论批判的范式形成阶段模型；五组件因果图式；四种基础设施本体论非类比（可替代性、可评估性、治理成熟度、反馈自反性、时间波动性）。
AI.method: 概念框架开发、结构化类比推理与本体论批判相结合的范式形成阶段模型；五组件因果图式形式化；跨本体论非类比检验。
AI.findings: (1) 识别五个价值生成机制：认知循环、生产力倍增、能力民主化、协调放大与解决方案可编程性；(2) 推理基础设施存在五项本体论非类比，使传统基础设施时代的治理、评估与劳动力安排不可移植；(3) 翻译层而非计算层是范式形成的根源，颠覆传统AI投资层级；(4) 为中小国家提供压缩制度学习与混合工业-知识制度的发展加速路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"推理经济"概念，拓展AIPI框架；揭示翻译层的范式形成核心地位，颠覆计算优先的传统认知；建立基础设施本体论非类比分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四层人力资本架构与人力资本依赖梯度，为中小国家提供在受控相互依存条件下的加速发展战略。

title: Data Science for Retail Demand Prediction
affiliations: Sinhagad Institute of Management and Sinhgad Institute of Management, Pune

detail.title: Data Science for Retail Demand Prediction
detail.abstract: Retail businesses face significant challenges in accurately predicting product demand due to rapidly changing consumer behavior, seasonal variations, promotional activities, and external economic factors. Accurate demand forecasting is essential for efficient inventory management, supply chain optimization, and improved customer satisfaction. This study explores the application of data science techniques for retail demand prediction using historical sales data, customer purchasing patterns, and external influencing variables. The research employs Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), statistical modeling, and machine learning techniques to identify patterns in retail sales data and uncover key factors affecting product demand. Variables such as historical sales trends, seasonal fluctuations, promotional events, pricing strategies, and regional purchasing behavior are analyzed to understand their impact on demand variability. Data preprocessing techniques including data cleaning, feature engineering, and normalization are applied to ensure data quality and improve predictive accuracy. Predictive models such as linear regression, decision trees, and random forest algorithms are implemented to forecast future product demand. The results demonstrate that historical sales patterns and promotional activities are among the strongest predictors of retail demand, while seasonal trends significantly influence product consumption in specific time periods. Machine learning-based forecasting models provide more accurate and scalable predictions compared to traditional statistical methods. The findings highlight the importance of data-driven decision-making in retail operations, enabling businesses to optimize inventory levels, reduce stockouts and overstock situations, and enhance supply chain efficiency. This study contributes to the growing field of retail analytics by demonstrating how advanced data science techniques can improve demand forecasting accuracy and support strategic planning in modern retail environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用数据科学技术（EDA、统计建模、机器学习）对零售需求进行预测，发现历史销售模式和促销活动是最强预测因子，机器学习模型优于传统统计方法，有助于优化库存管理和供应链效率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数据科学技术（包括EDA、统计建模和机器学习）提高零售需求预测的准确性？哪些因素对零售需求变化影响最大？
AI.motivation: 零售企业面临消费者行为快速变化、季节性波动、促销活动和外部经济因素等挑战，传统需求预测方法准确性不足，亟需更精准的数据驱动方法以优化库存管理和供应链效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求预测理论、零售分析学、数据科学方法论（EDA、特征工程、统计建模、机器学习）
AI.method: 采用EDA进行数据探索，运用数据清洗、特征工程和归一化等预处理技术，构建线性回归、决策树和随机森林三种预测模型进行对比分析。
AI.findings: （1）历史销售模式和促销活动是零售需求最强的预测因子；（2）季节性趋势显著影响特定时间段的产品消费；（3）基于机器学习的预测模型（如随机森林）相比传统统计方法（如线性回归）具有更高的准确性和可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了零售分析学领域的研究，实证证明了机器学习技术在需求预测中的优越性，为数据驱动决策理论在零售运营中的应用提供了新的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助零售企业优化库存水平，减少缺货和积压情况，提升供应链效率，支持战略规划，实现数据驱动的运营决策。

title: Breaking Barriers, Boosting Green: Theory and Empirical Evidence on City-County Mergers
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Bielefeld University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Breaking Barriers, Boosting Green: Theory and Empirical Evidence on City-County Mergers
detail.abstract: This paper examines how administrative integration facilitates household energy transitions by reducing inter-regional frictions. Based on a set of stylized facts from China’s City-County Mergers reform, we develop a two-stage dynamic model showing that the impact of reducing regional barriers depends critically on clean energy supply constraints and household heterogeneity.  Under supply constraints, including low-income households triggers a crowding-out effect on wealthier groups through resource reallocation.   Using  household  panel  data and a DiD strategy,  we find that administrative integration significantly increases clean cooking fuel adoption.  Heterogeneous results confirm that the reform promotes energy equity by empowering poor households while inducing wealthier households to reoptimize toward more efficient energy networks.  A welfare analysis suggests the transition generates approximately $4.31 billion in annual national healthcare savings.  These findings highlight breaking administrative barriers as a low-cost policy instrument for accelerating green energy transitions in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国"县改区"改革如何通过减少行政壁垒促进家庭清洁能源转型，发现该改革显著增加了清洁烹饪燃料的使用，产生了约43.1亿美元的年度医疗健康节省。
AI.research_question: 行政一体化如何通过减少区域间摩擦促进家庭能源转型？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家推动清洁能源转型面临区域壁垒等制度性障碍，理解行政整合能否以及如何降低这些障碍具有重要政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段动态模型，考虑了清洁能源供给约束和家庭异质性。
AI.method: 基于中国"县改区"改革的典型事实，采用双重差分（DiD）策略分析家庭面板数据。
AI.findings: 行政一体化显著增加了清洁烹饪燃料的使用；在供给约束下，低收入家庭的参与会对富裕群体产生资源再分配的挤出效应；改革促进了能源公平，赋权贫困家庭，同时引导富裕家庭优化选择更高效的能源网络；改革带来约43.1亿美元的年度全国医疗健康节省。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行政一体化影响能源转型的微观机制，特别是供给约束下不同收入群体间的资源再分配效应（挤出效应）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供了一种低成本的绿色能源转型政策工具——打破行政壁垒。

title: Hydroelectric Generation and Wholesale Electricity Price Stabilization in Spain: Causal Evidence from a Hydrological Instrument
affiliations: Universidad de Alcalá

detail.title: Hydroelectric Generation and Wholesale Electricity Price Stabilization in Spain: Causal Evidence from a Hydrological Instrument
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of hydroelectric generation on wholesale electricity prices in the Spanish day-ahead market over the period 2012–2024. Hydroelectric dispatch is endogenous to price because reservoir operators respond dynamically to market signals. We address this simultaneity by instrumenting monthly hydroelectric generation with the hydraulic producible — the energy that could have been generated from observed hydrological inflows — published monthly by Red Eléctrica de España since 1920. The first-stage F-statistic is 87.5, well above conventional weak-instrument thresholds. Our IV/2SLS estimate is −0.665 €/MWh per GWh/day of hydroelectric generation (p < 0.001), 49 percent larger in absolute value than the OLS estimate, consistent with upward simultaneity bias. The result is robust across nine alternative specifications, including a temperature control using AEMET station data. Quantile regression reveals a U-shaped pattern: the stabilizing effect is stronger at the tails of the price distribution, indicating that hydropower compresses both price peaks and troughs. Subsample analysis shows the effect is 2.8 times larger in dry years than in wet years, consistent with a convex supply curve when gas prices are high. The difference between a high-hydro year (75th percentile) and a low-hydro year (25th percentile) implies a price differential of 17.9 €/MWh and consumer savings of approximately €4.5 billion per year.

AI.tldr: 利用1920年起发布的水力可发电量数据作为工具变量，估计了2012-2024年西班牙日前市场中水电发电对批发电价的因果效应，发现每增加1 GWh/天水发电量使电价降低0.665欧元/MWh，在干旱年份效应更显著，消费者年节省约45亿欧元。
AI.research_question: 水力发电对西班牙日前市场批发电价有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: 水电调度与电价存在双向因果关系（水库运营者根据市场信号动态响应），导致OLS估计有偏，需要识别因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供需均衡理论、水电调度内生性理论、工具变量识别策略
AI.method: 工具变量/两阶段最小二乘法（IV/2SLS），以Red Eléctrica de España自1920年起每月发布的水力可发电量（hydraulic producible）作为工具变量，辅以分位数回归和子样本分析。
AI.findings: (1) IV估计值为-0.665 €/MWh per GWh/day（p<0.001），绝对值比OLS大49%；(2) 第一阶段F统计量87.5，排除弱工具变量问题；(3) 分位数回归显示U型模式，电价分布两端的水电稳定效应更强；(4) 干旱年份效应是湿润年份的2.8倍；(5) 高水电年份与低水电年份价差达17.9 €/MWh，消费者年节省约45亿欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为水电对电价的因果效应提供了可靠的识别证据，揭示了水电调度的向上同时性偏差方向，发现了电价分布两端的非对称稳定效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了水电对消费者电费的真实节省效果（约45亿欧元/年），为电力市场政策制定和可再生能源投资决策提供了依据。

title: A Hybrid Numerical Method for Reliable Settlement Prediction of Raft Foundations on an Enhanced Pasternak Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Hybrid Numerical Method for Reliable Settlement Prediction of Raft Foundations on an Enhanced Pasternak Model
detail.abstract: This paper presents a study on the immediate static settlement behavior of raft foundations using a 2D hybrid numerical method. The 2D hybrid method establishes differential equation relationships based on first-order shear deformation theory, combined with an improved Pasternak elastic foundation theory. This approach not only enhances practicality but also allows for efficient integration with commercial FEM software. The study also proposes applying a statistical hypothesis testing method combined with simple linear regression, while using empirical formulas from field plate load test, to more reliably determine the elastic modulus of the soil. An expression for determining the expansion range of the soil mass outside the raft foundation based on the deflection attenuation function is also proposed, thereby limiting the influence of boundary conditions and being flexibly applicable to both 2D and 3D models. The 2D hybrid method showed good agreement with the reference experimental data while reducing computational cost. When using this method with the plate load test modulus, the deviation from the experiment in the linear elastic domain is only about 0.05% to less than 17%. For the modulus determined from triaxial compression tests, the deviation ranges from 5% to 45% when considering the entire linear domain and a portion of the nonlinear domain of the load-settlement relationship curve. Furthermore, the study verifies the thickness-weighted average method in determining the elastic modulus representative of layered soil masses, and clarifies the procedure for analyzing the static settlement of raft foundations, thereby supplementing the theoretical and practical basis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种2D混合数值方法，结合改进的Pasternak弹性地基理论和一阶剪切变形理论，用于研究筏板基础的即时静力沉降行为，并通过统计假设检验和现场板荷载试验经验公式更可靠地确定土体弹性模量，在降低计算成本的同时与实验数据吻合良好。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高效、可靠的2D混合数值方法来预测筏板基础的即时静力沉降行为，并提高土体弹性模量确定的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统筏板基础沉降分析方法在计算效率与精度之间存在权衡，且土体弹性模量的确定方法不够可靠，需要一种既能降低计算成本又能保证精度的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一阶剪切变形理论；改进的Pasternak弹性地基理论；统计假设检验；简单线性回归；厚度加权平均法。
AI.method: 2D混合数值方法（结合一阶剪切变形理论与改进Pasternak地基理论）；统计假设检验结合简单线性回归确定弹性模量；基于挠度衰减函数确定土体扩展范围；与商业FEM软件集成。
AI.findings: 2D混合方法与参考实验数据吻合良好，计算成本降低；使用板荷载试验模量时，线弹性域偏差仅约0.05%至17%；使用三轴压缩试验模量时偏差为5%至45%；验证了厚度加权平均法在层状土体弹性模量确定中的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了改进的Pasternak弹性地基理论与一阶剪切变形理论相结合的2D混合数值方法；提出了基于挠度衰减函数的土体扩展范围确定方法，灵活适用于2D和3D模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出统计假设检验结合简单线性回归及现场板荷载试验经验公式来确定土体弹性模量，提高了可靠性；验证了厚度加权平均法用于层状土体模量确定；阐明了筏板基础静力沉降分析的程序。

title: How does the low-carbon city pilot policy impact the marginal abatement cost of urban carbon emissions?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How does the low-carbon city pilot policy impact the marginal abatement cost of urban carbon emissions?
detail.abstract: With the intensifying global climate challenge, achieving emission-reduction targets at minimal economic cost has emerged as a central concern in urban low-carbon governance. Although China’s Low-Carbon City Pilot (LCCP) policy has been extensively evaluated for its emission-reduction effectiveness, its influence on the marginal abatement cost (MAC) of carbon emissions remains underexplored. Using panel data from 41 prefecture-level cities in the Yangtze River Delta from 2005 to 2022, this study estimates city-level MAC via a quadratic directional distance function and employs a staggered difference-in-differences approach to identify the causal effect of the LCCP on MAC. The results show that the LCCP significantly raises MAC by approximately 10.7% on average, operating through three competing channels. While industrial structural transition and tightened carbon abatement caps exert upward pressure on MAC, the cost-reducing effect of green technological innovation is insufficient to offset these forces, yielding a significant net increase. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the MAC-increasing effect is concentrated in non-resource-based cities, mega cities, financially developed cities, and those with initially weaker environmental regulation. These findings offer critical evidence for evaluating the cost implications of LCCP and underscore the necessity of balancing regulatory stringency with targeted innovation support across differentiated urban contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用长三角41个城市2005-2022年面板数据，发现中国低碳城市试点政策通过产业结构转型和碳减排约束使边际减排成本平均提升约10.7%，而绿色技术创新的降本效应不足以抵消这一上升。
AI.research_question: 中国低碳城市试点政策如何影响城市的边际减排成本？
AI.motivation: 现有研究广泛评估了低碳城市试点政策的减排效果，但该政策对碳排放边际减排成本（即减排的经济代价）的影响尚不明确，而这对于实现以最低经济成本达成减排目标至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于二次方向性距离函数估算边际减排成本，并通过三重竞争性机制（产业结构转型、碳减排约束收紧、绿色技术创新）分析政策对MAC的影响路径。
AI.method: 采用2005-2022年长三角41个地级市面板数据，运用二次方向性距离函数估算城市级MAC，并采用交错双重差分法识别因果效应。
AI.findings: LCCP使MAC平均提升约10.7%；产业结构转型和碳减排约束抬高MAC，但绿色技术创新的降本效应不足以抵消；MAC提升效应集中在非资源型城市、超大城市、金融发达城市及初始环境规制较弱的城市。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从边际减排成本视角评估低碳城市试点政策的经济代价，揭示了政策影响MAC的三重竞争性机制，丰富了环境规制与减排成本关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了低碳城市试点政策经济成本的实证证据，提示在差异化城市背景下需平衡环境监管力度与针对性创新支持，以最低经济成本实现减排目标。

title: Coal Dependence, Structural Persistence, and Population Health in Southeast Asia
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - Edinburgh Business School, University of Edinburgh Business School, Monash University - Department of Econometrics & Business Statistics and Gnosis Management Consultants, HOCG (Hellenic Observatory of Corporate Governance

detail.title: Coal Dependence, Structural Persistence, and Population Health in Southeast Asia
detail.abstract: Energy transitions affect welfare not only through aggregate energy use or carbon emissions, but also through the structural position of specific fuels within national energy systems. This paper examines whether coal dependence remains central to the energy--health relationship in Southeast Asia, whether renewable energy expansion has begun to displace that centrality, and whether the observed pattern is regionally specific. Using an unbalanced panel of all ten ASEAN economies over 1990--2020, we adapt a rolling weighted-degree diagnostic, termed Aggregated Influence Scores (AIS), that tracks persistent systemic centrality within the energy--health correlation network, and combine it with two-way fixed-effects panel regression. Permutation-validated AIS results show that coal has the highest mean structural centrality in the regional energy--health network and retains this position throughout the sample despite rising renewable integration. Renewable energy exhibits structural emergence from the mid-2000s but does not displace coal or generate a stable life-expectancy association. Panel regressions provide qualified supporting evidence: coal consumption is negatively associated with life expectancy in the core ASEAN panel ($\beta = -7.34$, $p < 0.001$; Driscoll--Kraay inference), with the sign remaining negative across more than twenty specifications. The association captures medium-term within-country co-movement and should not be interpreted as a causal effect, long-run equilibrium parameter, or exposure-response coefficient. Extended-panel benchmarking across 38 developing economies yields a more conservative Southeast Asian estimate ($\beta = -1.02$, $p = 0.042$), which is treated as the preferred benchmark for policy appraisal; the association is not significant outside Southeast Asia. The findings support evaluating coal phase-down for potential regional health co-benefits and show that renewable capacity addition without coal displacement may represent structural transition without welfare translation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）十国1990-2020年间煤炭依赖与可再生能源扩张对健康（预期寿命）的影响，发现煤炭在能源-健康关联网络中保持核心地位，可再生能源虽在增长但未能取代煤炭，且煤炭消费与预期寿命的负相关关系具有区域特异性。
AI.research_question: 煤炭依赖是否仍是东南亚能源-健康关系的核心？可再生能源扩张是否已开始取代煤炭的这一核心地位？观察到的模式是否具有区域特异性？
AI.motivation: 能源转型不仅通过总能源使用或碳排放影响福利，还通过特定燃料在能源系统中的结构位置产生影响。现有研究缺乏从网络视角考察燃料结构位置与健康关系的方法，尤其是在东南亚这一快速能源转型但煤炭仍占重要地位的区域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源-健康关联网络理论、结构性系统中心性（Aggregated Influence Scores, AIS）、能源转型与福利转化理论。
AI.method: 采用不平衡面板数据（1990-2020），结合滚动的加权度诊断（AIS）方法追踪能源-健康关联网络中的持久系统性中心性，以及双向固定效应面板回归，并辅以置换检验验证AIS结果。还进行了跨38个发展中经济体的扩展面板基准比较。
AI.findings: 1）煤炭在区域能源-健康网络中具有最高的平均结构性中心性，且在整个样本期内保持这一地位；2）可再生能源从2000年代中期开始显现结构性出现，但未取代煤炭，也未产生稳定的预期寿命关联；3）煤炭消费与预期寿命在核心ASEAN面板中呈负相关（β=-7.34, p<0.001），在扩展到38个发展中经济体后的更保守估计为β=-1.02, p=0.042；4）该关联在东南亚以外不显著，具有区域特异性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Aggregated Influence Scores (AIS)这一新诊断方法，用于追踪能源系统中特定燃料的结构性中心性及其与健康指标的动态关联；揭示了能源转型中"结构性转型"与"福利转化"之间的脱钩现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持将煤炭逐步削减作为潜在的区域健康共同效益策略；警示可再生能源扩容若不伴随煤炭退出，可能仅是结构性转型而未能转化为实际福利改善，为东南亚能源政策制定提供实证依据。

title: The Staircase Methodology for AI Adoption in US Small and Mid-Sized Businesses
affiliations: InnovAItive Labs

detail.title: The Staircase Methodology for AI Adoption in US Small and Mid-Sized Businesses

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of a consulting firm that advises US small and mid-sized businesses on AI adoption strategy and implementation. The Staircase Methodology was developed and refined through direct client engagements conducted by this firm. The illustrative case in Section 4.5 is drawn from this work, with names anonymized and figures altered. The author received no external funding for this paper. Generative AI tools (large language model assistants) were used for language refinement, grammar correction, and editorial polish during manuscript preparation; all conceptual contributions are solely those of the author. The author declares no other relationships, financial or personal, that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a conceptual methodology developed through design science research and does not involve human subjects, patient data, or experimental participants. The illustrative case in Section 4.5 is drawn from prior consulting engagements, with all identifying details anonymized and figures altered to protect client confidentiality. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: US small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) account for roughly 43.5% of GDP and almost 46% of private-sector employment, yet a persistent gap separates their adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) from that of large enterprises. Recent evidence indicates that, while headline adoption rates have risen sharply, value capture has not: 95% of generative AI pilots produce no measurable profit-and-loss impact, and roughly 80% of AI projects fail outright - twice the failure rate of non-AI information-technology projects. The dominant adoption frameworks (TAM, UTAUT, TOE, Rogers' Diffusion of Innovations) are descriptive theories of individual or firm acceptance, while industry maturity models (McKinsey, Gartner, BCG, Deloitte) presume enterprise-scale resources, dedicated AI teams, multi-year horizons, and modernized data infrastructure. None offers an action-first, resource-aware path that an owner-operator can execute on a sub-$100,000 budget. This paper introduces the Staircase Methodology, a phase-gated, prescriptive framework designed for the SMB context. The methodology organizes adoption into two sequential phases: Optimize (Phase 1) and Grow (Phase 2). Each is executed through six steps that move from goal definition through use-case scoring (Bleed for Phase 1, Hidden Revenue for Phase 2), four sequential filters (AI feasibility, effort, return on investment, and a Risk × Stickiness reversibility check), and a written commit-and-ship gate. Heuristic scoring devices are designed to be usable without a data team, while the Risk × Stickiness construct provides a reversibility safeguard tailored to customer-facing and regulated-industry contexts. The methodology is illustrated with a small-business case and positioned as a complement to, not a replacement for, existing adoption theories. The contribution is a prescriptive, owner-operator-native artifact suitable for empirical validation, sector-specific adaptation, and integration with broader maturity assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"阶梯方法论"(Staircase Methodology)，一个专为中小型企业(SMB)设计的、分阶段、可操作的AI采用框架，弥补了现有技术接受理论和行业成熟度模型无法适应资源受限的SMB情境的空白。
AI.research_question: 中小型企业如何在有限预算（低于10万美元）下有效采用AI并实现价值捕获，而非仅仅进行试点？
AI.motivation: SMB贡献了美国GDP的43.5%和私营部门就业的46%，但其AI采用率与大型企业之间存在持续差距；95%的生成式AI试点未产生可衡量的利润影响，80%的AI项目失败（是非AIIT项目失败率的两倍）；现有框架（TAM、UTAUT、TOE、创新扩散理论）是描述性的，行业成熟度模型（麦肯锡、Gartner、BCG、德勤）预设了企业级资源，均不适于SMB情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型(TAM)、统一技术接受与使用理论(UTAUT)、技术-组织-环境框架(TOE)、罗杰斯创新扩散理论、行业AI成熟度模型（麦肯锡、Gartner、BCG、德勤）、阶段-门控(Phase-Gate)方法论。
AI.method: 提出"阶梯方法论"这一规范性分阶段框架，包含两个阶段（优化阶段和增长阶段），每个阶段通过六个步骤执行：目标定义→用例评分→四个顺序过滤器（AI可行性、工作量、ROI、风险×粘性可逆性检查）→书面提交与交付门。采用启发式评分工具，无需数据团队即可使用。
AI.findings: 设计了适用于SMB的AI采用框架：Phase 1（优化阶段）聚焦"止血"用例，Phase 2（增长阶段）聚焦"隐性收入"用例；风险×粘性（Risk × Stickiness）构念提供了面向客户和受监管行业的可逆性保障；通过小企业案例进行了说明性验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个面向SMB所有者-经营者的、行动优先、资源感知的规范性AI采用框架；引入了风险×粘性可逆性检查机制；将阶段-门控思想引入SMB AI采用领域；作为现有采用理论的补充而非替代。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小型企业提供了可在低于10万美元预算内执行的、无需数据团队的AI采用路径；包含具体的用例评分、过滤器设计和门控机制；可进行实证验证、行业特定适配和与更广泛成熟度评估的整合。

title: Satellite-Verified Greenwashing: ESG Claim Credibility Among US Heavy Emitters
affiliations: University of North Florida - Department of Accounting and Finance, University of North Florida and

detail.title: Satellite-Verified Greenwashing: ESG Claim Credibility Among US Heavy Emitters
detail.abstract: Verifying corporate sustainability claims is difficult when available benchmarks rely on firm-supplied or commercially processed data. For energy-intensive industries, satellite remote sensing offers an independent alternative: methane emissions from oil and gas, utilities, and chemicals are large enough to detect from orbit, making satellite-based verification both feasible and credible. This study introduces the Claim-Reality Divergence (CRD) index, which triangulates ESG language intensity from SEC filings and earnings call transcripts against facility-level methane reported to the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program and atmospheric methane column densities observed by the Sentinel-5P TROPOMI satellite, a physical measurement source that firms cannot influence or selectively report. Using 1,937 firm-year observations across 233 publicly listed US heavy emitters from 2018 to 2023, a one standard deviation increase in ESG text intensity is associated with a 0.635 to 0.694 standard deviation increase in the CRD index across eleven specifications, robust to financial controls, emissions baseline controls, and firm fixed effects. Annual 10-K-based scoring confirms the greenwashing premium is a cross-sectional phenomenon: persistent differences in ESG communication posture across firms predict claim-reality gaps, but year-to-year within-firm variation does not. Taken together, the results indicate that greenwashing among US heavy emitters operates through selective investor-facing disclosure rather than falsification of regulatory data, and that satellite-based benchmarking provides a scalable, independent verification tool with direct implications for emissions disclosure regulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建"声明-现实差异指数"，结合卫星遥感数据（Sentinel-5P TROPOMI）与ESG文本强度分析，发现美国高排放企业的漂绿行为主要通过选择性披露实现，而非伪造监管数据。卫星监测为验证企业气候声明提供了独立、可扩展的工具。
AI.research_question: 如何利用卫星遥感数据独立验证企业可持续发展声明的真实性？企业的ESG语言强度与实际排放之间存在怎样的差距？
AI.motivation: 现有企业可持续性声明的验证缺乏独立基准，企业自报数据或商业处理数据可能不可靠。卫星遥感提供了独立于企业的物理测量手段，但尚未被系统用于验证ESG声明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声明-现实差异指数（Claim-Reality Divergence, CRD）；ESG语言强度（ESG text intensity triangulation）；选择性披露理论；漂绿行为理论
AI.method: 构建CRD指数，三角验证ESG文本强度（源自SEC 10-K文件和财报电话会议记录）、设施级甲烷排放数据（EPA温室气体报告计划）与大气甲烷柱密度（Sentinel-5P TROPOMI卫星数据）。样本涵盖2018-2023年233家美国上市高排放企业的1,937个公司-年度观测值，采用多种回归模型控制财务变量、排放基线和公司固定效应。
AI.findings: ESG文本强度每增加一个标准差，CRD指数增加0.635至0.694个标准差（在11种规格下均稳健）。年度10-K评分证实漂绿溢价是横截面现象：不同企业间ESG沟通姿态的持续差异能预测声明-现实差距，但企业内部的年度波动则不能。美国高排放企业的漂绿主要通过选择性投资者披露实现，而非伪造监管数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将卫星遥感数据系统性地纳入企业漂绿验证框架；提出CRD指数作为独立量化工具；区分了选择性披露与数据伪造两种漂绿机制，揭示前者是主要方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于卫星的可扩展、独立的企业排放验证工具；对排放披露监管政策具有直接启示意义；帮助投资者、监管机构和公众识别企业漂绿行为。

title: Domain-Aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Robert Gordon University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Northwestern Polytechnical University and Northwestern Polytechnical University

detail.title: Domain-Aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection
detail.abstract: Incremental object detection aims to adapt models to new domains while preserving detection performance on previously learned scenes. However, existing methods often suﬀer from problems such as catastrophic forgetting and high inference latency when multi-domain data access is restricted. To address these challenges, we propose the Domain-aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection (DILOD), a framework designed to achieve eﬃcient and scalable incremental adaptation across diverse visual domains. DILOD integrates two key components: Similarity-Guided Incremental Adaptation (SGIA), which selectively expands and calibrates the network by identifying low-similarity layers requiring additional capacity, and the Prototype-Based Routing Module (PRM), which enables dynamic inference-time routing based on learned domain prototypes without relying on scene labels. Extensive experiments on BDD100K, VisDrone2019, and NWPU VHR10 demonstrate that DILOD outperforms prior methods in mean Average Precision while maintaining stable inference latency and controlled parameter growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DILOD框架，通过相似性引导的增量适应（SGIA）和基于原型的路由模块（PRM），实现多场景目标检测的高效增量学习，在保持低推理延迟和可控参数增长的同时，有效缓解灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖场景标签且数据访问受限的条件下，实现多场景目标检测的高效增量学习，同时避免灾难性遗忘并保持低推理延迟？
AI.motivation: 现有增量目标检测方法在多域数据访问受限时存在灾难性遗忘和高推理延迟问题，亟需一种能够高效、可扩展地适应多样视觉域的增量学习框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增量学习、域自适应、基于相似度的网络扩展、原型路由机制
AI.method: 提出DILOD框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 相似性引导的增量适应（SGIA），通过识别低相似度层进行选择性网络扩展与校准；(2) 基于原型的路由模块（PRM），利用学习到的域原型实现无需场景标签的动态推理时路由。
AI.findings: 在BDD100K、VisDrone2019、NWPU VHR10数据集上的实验表明，DILOD在平均精确率（mAP）上优于现有方法，同时保持稳定的推理延迟和可控的参数增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了相似性引导的网络选择性扩展策略，以及不依赖场景标签的基于原型的动态路由机制，为增量目标检测提供了新的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: DILOD框架能够在多场景迁移中保持低推理延迟和可控参数增长，适用于实际部署中对实时性和资源效率有严格要求的增量目标检测场景。

title: A Novel Hybrid Fusion Embedding Framework for FaceVerification
affiliations: Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology, Institut Teknologi Adhi Tama Surabaya, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember and Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology

detail.title: A Novel Hybrid Fusion Embedding Framework for FaceVerification
detail.abstract: Face verification has become an essential component in biometric security and intelligentsystems, yet its performance often degrades under uncontrolled conditions such as pose, age,and illumination variations. While state-of-the-art models like ArcFace, AdaFace, and MagFacereport strong accuracy on controlled datasets, their robustness drops on more challengingbenchmarks such as CALFW and CPLFW. Ensemble-based approaches attempt to addressthese limitations but often incur high computational costs. To overcome this, this researchproposes a novel hybrid fusion embedding framework designed to improve verification accu-racy without sacrificing efficiency. The methodology progresses in four stages: (1) baselineevaluation across 462 embedding–detector–metric–alignment configurations, (2) single-featuremachine learning analysis to determine the most reliable classifier, (3) two-backbone fusion toidentify complementary pairs, and (4) three-backbone fusion combining AdaFace, MagFace,and Dlib across five public datasets with 10-fold cross-validation. Experimental results showthat the proposed framework reports state-of-the-art verification performance, with the three-backbone fusion reaching 99.88% on LFW, 99.43% on CFP-FP, 98.55% on AgeDB-30, 96.42%on CALFW, and 95.00% on CPLFW, representing an average improvement of about 1.2%over single-backbone methods. Complexity analysis shows that although the proposed methodrequires slightly higher computation than a single-backbone model, it remains much lighter thantransformer or ensemble-based approaches, scaling linearly with the number of fused backbonesand reducing to 𝑂(𝑁) when embeddings are cached.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合融合嵌入框架，通过多阶段方法结合AdaFace、MagFace和Dlib三个骨干网络，在五个公开数据集上实现了人脸验证的SOTA性能，平均比单骨干方法提升约1.2%，且计算成本低于集成方法和Transformer模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持计算效率的前提下，通过多骨干融合提升人脸验证在非受控条件下的准确率？
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA人脸验证模型在非受控条件下性能下降，集成方法虽有效但计算成本高，因此需要一种兼具高精度与低计算开销的融合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合融合嵌入框架、多骨干融合、线性复杂度缩放理论
AI.method: 四阶段方法：1）462种嵌入-检测器-度量-对齐配置的基线评估；2）单特征机器学习分析选取最可靠分类器；3）双骨干融合识别互补对；4）三骨干融合（AdaFace+MagFace+Dlib），在5个数据集上采用10折交叉验证。
AI.findings: 三骨干融合在LFW达99.88%，CFP-FP达99.43%，AgeDB-30达98.55%，CALFW达96.42%，CPLFW达95.00%，平均比单骨干方法提升约1.2%；复杂度为线性可缩放，嵌入缓存后为O(N)，远低于Transformer或集成方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出系统性的多骨干融合评估框架；2) 验证了不同骨干网络嵌入的互补性原理；3) 证明了线性复杂度融合在精度-效率权衡上的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种可直接部署的高精度低计算成本的人脸验证方案；2) 为实际生物识别系统在非受控条件下的鲁棒性提升提供了工程化路径；3) 框架可扩展至更多骨干网络，具有通用性。

title: Multiscale Attention-Enhanced Progressive Transfer Learning for Pipeline High-Consequence Area Identification from Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Corridor Imagery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, China University of Petroleum (Beijing), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and China University of Petroleum (Beijing)

detail.title: Multiscale Attention-Enhanced Progressive Transfer Learning for Pipeline High-Consequence Area Identification from Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Corridor Imagery

keywords.keywords: Pipeline high consequence areaUAV imageryBuilding extractionTransfer learningRisk assessment

detail.abstract: Reliable building evidence within pipeline buffers is essential for high consequence area (HCA) grading, and unmanned aerial vehicle corridor orthomosaics provide a high-resolution, updatable data source for this purpose. In practical application, however, overlap tiling can place the same building in both training and test subsets, while scale variation, nonbuilding interference, and limited target annotations hinder stable building extraction. To address these issues, this study proposes a multiscale attention-enhanced progressive transfer learning method for pipeline HCA identification. Specifically, connected building clusters are used as the split unit to reduce the recurrence of identical buildings across training and test subsets under overlap tiling; a building extraction network combining an ImageNet-22K initialized encoder, a multiscale attention decoder, and boundary supervision is developed to improve footprint recovery under scale variation and nonbuilding interference; and a three-stage transfer process with frozen adaptation, progressive unfreezing, and full fine-tuning is adopted to improve cross-corridor adaptation under limited target annotations. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves favorable trade-offs among split validity, extraction performance, and small-sample transfer stability. The object-level cluster split reduces building recurrence between training and test subsets by 69%, the extraction network achieves a Dice of 0.860 and a recall of 0.889, and the progressive transfer protocol improves Dice from 0.702 to 0.860 compared with single-stage training. Validation on 22 pipeline segments further shows that final HCA grades remain consistent with engineering verification, indicating that the extracted building evidence can be stably carried through the HCA grading workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多尺度注意力增强的渐进式迁移学习方法，用于管道高后果区（HCA）识别中的建筑物提取，解决了重叠切片、尺度变化、非建筑干扰和标注样本有限等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在管道HCA分级中，利用无人机正射影像实现稳定、可靠的建筑物提取？
AI.motivation: 管道缓冲区建筑物证据的可靠性对HCA分级至关重要，但现有方法在重叠切片导致的数据泄露、尺度变化、非建筑干扰和标注样本有限等问题下难以实现稳定的建筑物提取。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度注意力增强网络、渐进式迁移学习、边界监督学习
AI.method: (1) 以连通建筑集群为分割单元，减少训练集与测试集间的建筑重复；(2) 构建结合ImageNet-22K初始化编码器、多尺度注意力解码器和边界监督的建筑物提取网络；(3) 采用三阶段渐进式迁移学习（冻结适应→渐进解冻→全微调）。
AI.findings: 对象级集群分割将训练-测试集的建筑重复率降低69%；提取网络Dice达0.860，召回率0.889；渐进式迁移协议相比单阶段训练，Dice从0.702提升至0.860；在22个管道段验证中，HCA分级结果与工程验证一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对管道HCA场景的渐进式迁移学习框架，结合多尺度注意力与边界监督机制，解决了小样本跨场景迁移中的建筑物提取稳定性和泛化性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管道HCA分级提供了一套可靠的建筑物自动化提取方案，减少了人工核查成本，提升了分级一致性和工程应用可行性。

title: Deployment-Oriented Multi-View Graph Feature Enrichment for Transaction-Level Financial Crime Detection
affiliations: Utrecht University, Utrecht University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Utrecht University

detail.title: Deployment-Oriented Multi-View Graph Feature Enrichment for Transaction-Level Financial Crime Detection
detail.abstract: Financial crime detection can benefit from relational signals in transaction networks, but real-world systems require low latency and scalable deployment. We present a deployment-oriented graph feature enrichment framework for transaction-level classification that combines an offline/online processing design with multi-view transaction network representations. The framework integrates conventional graph views based on transaction count and volume with novel views based on pointwise mutual information (PMI) and exclusivity, enabling complementary relational signals that are hard to capture with flat per-transaction features alone. In the offline stage, transactions are processed in sliding temporal windows to build aggregated graphs and compute node, edge, and community-level features for accounts. In the online stage, these precomputed features are retrieved and combined with transaction-time attributes for low-latency scoring, avoiding real-time graph updates. We evaluate the framework on a real-world banking dataset with expert-verified transaction-to-mule fraud labels and on public anti-money laundering benchmarks, using both ensemble models and graph neural networks. On a real-world banking dataset, the full graph feature set improves Average Precision by 45% over the baseline, while public benchmarks show mostly consistent gains across ensemble and graph-based models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向部署的图特征增强框架，通过离线/在线处理设计结合多视图交易网络表示（包括传统视图和基于PMI与排他性的新颖视图），在保持低延迟和可扩展性的同时，显著提升交易级金融犯罪检测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在金融犯罪检测中利用交易网络的关系信号，同时满足现实系统对低延迟和可扩展部署的要求？
AI.motivation: 金融犯罪检测能从交易网络的关系信号中受益，但现有系统需要在低延迟和可扩展部署条件下实现这一目标，存在挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多视图交易网络表示（交易计数、交易量、PMI、排他性）、离线/在线处理设计、图特征工程（节点、边、社区级特征）
AI.method: 离线阶段：滑动时间窗口构建聚合图并预计算账户级特征；在线阶段：检索预计算特征结合实时交易属性进行低延迟评分。使用集成模型和图神经网络进行评估。
AI.findings: 在真实银行数据集上，完整图特征集相比基线平均精度提升45%；在公开反洗钱基准上，集成模型和基于图的模型均表现出一致的性能提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于PMI和排他性的新颖图视图，能够捕获传统单交易特征难以捕捉的互补关系信号；设计了离线/在线分离的图特征增强框架，兼顾关系信号的利用与部署可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可实际部署的低延迟、可扩展的金融犯罪检测框架；在真实银行数据集上验证了显著的效果提升（平均精度提升45%）。

title: Integrating Geospatial Flood Inundation and Risk Analysis for Coastal Cities: A Framework for Premium Pricing Insurance
affiliations: Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember, Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology, Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember and Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember

detail.title: Integrating Geospatial Flood Inundation and Risk Analysis for Coastal Cities: A Framework for Premium Pricing Insurance
detail.abstract: Urban coastal flooding presents major challenges for disaster risk management and insurance planning, particularly in rapidly developing cities with limited flood mitigation capacity. This article presents a geospatial and risk-based workflow for estimating flood-induced physical losses and deriving flood insurance premium rates in data-limited coastal urban environments. The framework combines DEM-based bathtub inundation modeling with probabilistic rainfall thresholds derived from Extreme Value Theory using the Peaks Over Threshold (EVT–POT) approach. Scenario-based modeling incorporates runoff coefficient, drainage loss, and sea level rise, while model performance is evaluated using the Intersection over Union (IoU) metric.
