Physical building losses are estimated using depth–damage relationships and incorporated into the Picard insurance model to calculate pure premiums. These premiums are then adjusted using a coverage ratio to obtain more realistic premium rates. The proposed method offers a transparent and transferable workflow for integrating raster-based flood assessment, physical loss estimation, and risk-based insurance pricing in coastal cities.• Integrates probabilistic rainfall analysis, raster-based inundation modeling, and physical loss estimation.• Incorporates runoff, drainage loss, and sea level rise through scenario-based assessment.• Links geospatial flood loss outputs with risk-based insurance pricing using the Picard model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套结合地理空间分析、洪水淹没建模与保险定价的流程，用于数据有限的海岸城市评估洪水物理损失并计算保险费率。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据有限的海岸城市环境中，通过地理空间和风险分析方法估算洪水导致的物理损失并推导洪水保险费率？
AI.motivation: 快速发展的海岸城市防洪能力有限，洪水灾害风险管理与保险规划面临重大挑战，而现有方法往往需要大量数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 极值理论（EVT-POT）概率降雨阈值分析、DEM浴缸式淹没建模、深度-损失函数、Picard保险定价模型。
AI.method: 结合DEM浴缸式淹没模型与EVT-POT概率降雨阈值，纳入径流系数、排水损失和海平面上升的情景模拟，用IoU指标评估模型性能，通过深度-损失关系估计物理建筑损失，再用Picard模型计算纯保费，最后通过覆盖率调整得到实际保费率。
AI.findings: 提出了一套透明且可迁移的工作流程，成功将栅格洪水评估、物理损失估计与风险导向的保险定价整合在一起。
AI.theory_contributions: 将极值理论概率降雨阈值与浴缸式淹没建模相结合，拓展了数据有限情境下的洪水风险评估理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据有限的海岸城市提供了一套可操作的洪水保险定价流程，支持灾害风险管理与保险规划决策。

title: Domain-Aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Robert Gordon University, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Northwestern Polytechnical University and Northwestern Polytechnical University

detail.title: Domain-Aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection
detail.abstract: Incremental object detection aims to adapt models to new domains while preserving detection performance on previously learned scenes. However, existing methods often suﬀer from problems such as catastrophic forgetting and high inference latency when multi-domain data access is restricted. To address these challenges, we propose the Domain-aware Incremental Learning for Multi-scene Object Detection (DILOD), a framework designed to achieve eﬃcient and scalable incremental adaptation across diverse visual domains. DILOD integrates two key components: Similarity-Guided Incremental Adaptation (SGIA), which selectively expands and calibrates the network by identifying low-similarity layers requiring additional capacity, and the Prototype-Based Routing Module (PRM), which enables dynamic inference-time routing based on learned domain prototypes without relying on scene labels. Extensive experiments on BDD100K, VisDrone2019, and NWPU VHR10 demonstrate that DILOD outperforms prior methods in mean Average Precision while maintaining stable inference latency and controlled parameter growth.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向多场景目标检测的域感知增量学习框架DILOD，通过相似性引导的增量适应（SGIA）和原型路由模块（PRM），在无需场景标签的情况下实现高效增量适应，缓解了灾难性遗忘，并保持低推理延迟和可控参数增长。
AI.research_question: 如何在多域数据访问受限的条件下，实现高效且可扩展的增量式目标检测，同时避免灾难性遗忘并保持低推理延迟？
AI.motivation: 现有增量目标检测方法在多域数据访问受限时存在灾难性遗忘和推理延迟高的问题，亟需一种能够平衡检测性能、推理效率与参数增长的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 域感知增量学习；相似性引导的增量适应（SGIA）；基于原型的路由模块（PRM）
AI.method: 提出DILOD框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) SGIA模块，通过识别低相似性层进行选择性网络扩展与校准；(2) PRM模块，基于学习到的域原型实现动态推理时路由，无需场景标签。
AI.findings: 在BDD100K、VisDrone2019和NWPU VHR10数据集上的实验表明，DILOD在平均精度（mAP）上优于先前方法，同时保持稳定的推理延迟和可控的参数增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了域感知的增量学习范式，将相似性引导的网络扩展与原型驱动的无标签路由相结合，为多场景下的增量目标检测提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: DILOD在无需场景标签的情况下实现了多域增量适应，显著降低了推理延迟和参数增长，适用于实际中动态变化的多场景目标检测任务。

title: Fine-grained Text-driven 3D Facial Expression Generation via Multi-scale Diffusion Model
affiliations: Beijing Information Science and Technology University, Beijing Information Science and Technology University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Beihang University (BUAA), Beijing Information Science and Technology University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fine-grained Text-driven 3D Facial Expression Generation via Multi-scale Diffusion Model
detail.abstract: Generating fine-grained 3D facial expressions from text remains challenging due to the inherent mismatch between high-level semantic descriptions and localized geometric deformations. Existing methods typically rely on global text embeddings, which lack explicit modeling of facial structure and thus fail to capture subtle expression details.In this paper, we reformulate text-driven facial expression generation as a hierarchical semantic-to-geometry alignment problem. We propose a multi-level conditional diffusion framework that decomposes textual descriptions into global emotion, action-level semantics, and region-specific attributes. To bridge semantics and geometry, we introduce an expression field that encodes spatially-aware deformation cues over the facial surface.Our model aligns semantic hierarchy with the diffusion process by injecting different levels of conditions into corresponding stages of denoising, enabling consistent control from global expression intent to local geometric detail. In addition, we incorporate geometry-aware regularization to ensure anatomically plausible facial deformation.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves semantic fidelity, expression detail, and controllability compared to existing methods, while showing strong generalization to unseen expressions.Our results highlight the importance of explicit hierarchical and spatial modeling in text-driven 3D facial generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多层级条件扩散框架，将文本驱动的3D面部表情生成重新定义为分层语义-几何对齐问题，通过引入表情场和分层条件注入，显著提升了语义保真度、表情细节和可控性。
AI.research_question: 如何从文本描述生成细粒度的3D面部表情，解决高层语义描述与局部几何形变之间的不匹配问题？
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖全局文本嵌入，缺乏对面部结构的显式建模，无法捕捉细微的表情细节。文本语义与3D几何之间存在固有的层级不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层语义-几何对齐理论、多层级条件扩散模型、表情场（Expression Field）空间编码。
AI.method: 提出多层级条件扩散框架，将文本分解为全局情感、动作层语义和区域特定属性三个层次；引入表情场编码面部表面的空间感知形变线索；不同层级条件注入到扩散去噪的不同阶段实现分层控制；加入几何感知正则化确保解剖学上合理的面部形变。
AI.findings: 该方法在语义保真度、表情细节和可控性上显著优于现有方法，并对未见过的表情展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了显式分层建模和空间建模在文本驱动3D面部生成中的重要性，提出了语义-几何对齐的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文本到3D面部表情生成提供了更精细、可控且解剖学合理的解决方案，可应用于虚拟人、动画制作、人机交互等领域。

title: Aerial-NeRF: Adaptive Spatial Partitioning and Sampling for Large-Scale Aerial Rendering
affiliations: South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology, South China University of Technology and South China University of Technology

detail.title: Aerial-NeRF: Adaptive Spatial Partitioning and Sampling for Large-Scale Aerial Rendering
detail.abstract: Recent progress in large-scale scene rendering has yielded Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based models with an impressive ability to synthesize scenes across small objects and indoor scenes. Nevertheless, applying this concept to large-scale aerial rendering presents two significant challenges. Firstly, a single NeRF is insufficient to accurately render the entire scene in complex large-scale aerial datasets due to inadequate sampling along each view ray to sufficiently capture buildings. Secondly, traditional NeRFs are infeasible to train on one GPU to enable interactive fly-throughs for modeling massive images. Instead, existing methods typically separate the whole scene into multiple regions and train a NeRF on each region, which is unaccustomed to different flight trajectories and hindered by slow rendering speeds.  To that end, we propose Aerial-NeRF with three innovative modifications for jointly adapting NeRF in large-scale aerial rendering: (1) Designing an adaptive spatial partitioning and selection method based on drones' poses to adapt different flight trajectories; (2) Using similarity of poses instead of (expert) network for rendering speedup to determine which region a new viewpoint belongs to; (3) Developing an adaptive sampling approach for rendering performance improvement to cover the entire buildings at different heights. Numerous experiments have been carried out to confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of Aerial-NeRF, leading to the attainment of new state-of-the-art results on two publicly available large-scale aerial datasets and the SCUTic dataset. Note that our model allows us to perform rendering over 4 times as fast as compared to multiple competitors.

AI.tldr: Aerial-NeRF提出自适应空间划分、姿态相似性加速和自适应采样三大改进，解决NeRF在大规模航拍场景渲染中的采样不足和渲染速度慢问题，在多个数据集上达到SOTA效果，渲染速度提升4倍以上。
AI.research_question: 如何将NeRF有效应用于大规模航拍场景渲染，克服单NeRF采样不足和训练效率低下的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有NeRF模型在室内和小物体场景表现优异，但在大规模航拍渲染中面临两个挑战：单NeRF难以捕捉复杂场景中的建筑物细节（采样不足），以及传统NeRF无法在单GPU上高效训练以实现交互式飞行漫游。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经辐射场（NeRF）、自适应空间划分、姿态相似性度量、自适应采样
AI.method: (1) 基于无人机位姿的自适应空间划分与选择方法，适应不同飞行轨迹；(2) 利用位姿相似性（而非专家网络）代替渲染加速，判断新视角所属区域；(3) 开发自适应采样方法，覆盖不同高度的完整建筑物。
AI.findings: 在两个公开大规模航拍数据集和SCUTic数据集上达到SOTA结果，渲染速度比多个竞品提升4倍以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将NeRF适配于大规模航拍渲染的三种创新性改进方案，包括自适应空间划分、基于姿态相似性的加速机制和自适应采样策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了大规模航拍场景的高效渲染，渲染速度提升4倍以上，支持不同飞行轨迹的自适应调整，便于实际航拍应用中的交互式飞行漫游。

title: Topology-Preserving and Denoising Data Reduction Algorithm for Topological Data Analysis
affiliations: Seowon University, Kyungpook National University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Kyungpook National University

detail.title: Topology-Preserving and Denoising Data Reduction Algorithm for Topological Data Analysis
detail.abstract: Persistent homology is a central tool in topological data analysis, but its application to large and noisy datasets is often limited by computational cost and the presence of spurious topological features. Noise not only increases data size but also obscures the underlying structure of the data.In this paper, we propose the Refined Characteristic Lattice Algorithm (RCLA), a grid-based method that integrates data reduction with threshold-based denoising in a single procedure. By incorporating a threshold parameter $k$, RCLA removes noise while preserving the essential structure of the data in a single pass. We further provide a theoretical guarantee by proving a stability theorem under a homogeneous Poisson noise model, which bounds the bottleneck distance between the persistence diagrams of the output and the underlying shape with high probability. In addition, we introduce an automatic parameter selection method based on nearest-neighbor statistics and Bayesian estimation. Experimental results demonstrate that RCLA consistently outperforms existing methods, and its effectiveness is further validated on a 3D shape classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于网格的改进特征晶格算法（RCLA），通过整合数据降维与基于阈值的去噪，在单次处理中去除噪声并保留数据结构，并提供了同质泊松噪声模型下的稳定性理论保证及自动参数选择方法。
AI.research_question: 如何高效地对大规模、高噪声数据集应用持续同调分析，减少计算成本并抑制虚假拓扑特征？
AI.motivation: 持续同调是拓扑数据分析的核心工具，但面对大规模和噪声数据时，计算成本高昂且易产生虚假拓扑特征。现有方法往往需要分离数据降维和去噪步骤，效率较低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同质泊松噪声模型下的稳定性定理（以高概率界定输出与潜在形状的持续同调图之间的瓶颈距离）；基于最近邻统计和贝叶斯估计的参数选择方法。
AI.method: 提出改进特征晶格算法（RCLA），一种基于网格的方法，将数据降维与阈值去噪整合为单一流程，通过引入阈值参数k在单次处理中去除噪声并保留本质结构。
AI.findings: RCLA在多个实验数据集上持续优于现有方法；在3D形状分类任务中进一步验证了其有效性；提供了噪声模型下的理论稳定性保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在同质泊松噪声模型下，RCLA输出与潜在形状的持续同调图之间的瓶颈距离具有高概率上界，为算法的鲁棒性提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种可自动选择参数的方法，使RCLA便于实际应用；在3D形状分类等真实任务中展示了优越性能，有助于推动持续同调在大规模高噪声场景中的应用。

title: Open-VSRD: A Large-Scale Dynamic Dataset and Diffusion Framework for Video Shadow Removal
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology and Hefei University of Technology

detail.title: Open-VSRD: A Large-Scale Dynamic Dataset and Diffusion Framework for Video Shadow Removal
detail.abstract: Video shadow removal remains a challenging and underexplored task due to the lack of large-scale datasets and open-source benchmarks. To address this gap, we present Open Video Shadow Removal Dataset (Open-VSRD), the first publicly available dataset for video shadow removal, accompanied by a dedicated video diffusion framework designed specifically for multi-frame shadow removal. Open-VSRD is a large-scale synthetic dataset built using the Unity engine, consisting of 5,932 training clips and 244 testing clips captured from diverse scenes. It features a wide range of dynamic scenarios involving various moving objects, complex camera motions, and heterogeneous lighting conditions, offering rich spatial–temporal and illumination variations essential for robust model training and evaluation. Building upon this dataset, we propose a video diffusion method based on {alternating bidirectional diffusion guidance} strategy that enhances temporal stability specifically within shadow regions while maintaining overall visual coherence. Furthermore, a temporal VAE (variational autoencoder) decoder is designed to leverage multi-scale latent features from a frozen encoder, significantly improving reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing single-frame shadow removal approaches, validating both the effectiveness of the proposed framework and the significance of the Open-VSRD dataset. Datasets and codes will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个公开的视频阴影去除数据集Open-VSRD，并设计了基于交替双向扩散引导策略的视频扩散框架，显著优于现有单帧方法。
AI.research_question: 如何解决视频阴影去除任务中缺乏大规模数据集和开源基准的问题，并设计有效的多帧阴影去除方法？
AI.motivation: 视频阴影去除是一个极具挑战性且研究不足的任务，主要受限于缺少大规模数据集和开源基准。现有方法多为单帧处理，无法充分利用视频的时序信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩散模型（Diffusion Model）、交替双向扩散引导策略（Alternating Bidirectional Diffusion Guidance）、时序VAE解码器（Temporal VAE Decoder）
AI.method: 1. 基于Unity引擎构建大规模合成数据集Open-VSRD（5932训练片段+244测试片段）；2. 提出基于交替双向扩散引导策略的视频扩散方法，增强阴影区域的时序稳定性；3. 设计时序VAE解码器，利用冻结编码器的多尺度潜在特征提升重建保真度和时序一致性。
AI.findings: 所提方法在视频阴影去除任务上显著优于现有单帧阴影去除方法，验证了数据集和框架的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首个公开的大规模视频阴影去除数据集，填补了领域空白；2. 提出交替双向扩散引导策略，解决了扩散模型在阴影区域的时序不稳定问题；3. 设计时序VAE解码器，提升了多帧重建的保真度与一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为视频阴影去除研究提供了标准化基准和开源数据；2. 提出的框架可直接用于视频后期处理、监控视频增强等实际应用场景；3. 数据集和代码将公开，促进该领域的进一步发展。

title: Sim-to-Real Visual Reinforcement Learning for Strawberry Harvesting from Dense Clusters
affiliations: University of Lincoln and University of Lincoln

detail.title: Sim-to-Real Visual Reinforcement Learning for Strawberry Harvesting from Dense Clusters

keywords.keywords: reinforcement learning \sep sim-to-real transfer \sep fruit harvesting \sep domain randomisation \sep inverse reinforcement learning \sep reward learning

detail.abstract: Autonomous fruit harvesting presents significant challenges for robotics due to the heavy occlusion, visual variability, and delicate manipulation requirements in unstructured agricultural environments. Classical perception-planning-control pipelines achieve limited reliability in these conditions, motivating learning-based approaches. This paper presents a three-fold contribution to visual reinforcement learning framework for autonomous strawberry harvesting from dense clusters that extends previous work in three directions. First, we introduce an extended version of the FruitGym simulation environment with a new multi-target environment featuring forked stems, leaf-based occlusions, interconnected clusters, and a comprehensive nine-stage domain randomization pipeline. Second, we present a novel multi-term reward function for picking from fruit clusters with multiple ripe strawberries, including target isolation, alignment, and bad grasp penalties. Third, we introduce Dual-Anchor Contrastive Loss (DACL), a novel video-based inverse reinforcement learning method that derives shaped rewards from both successful and negative demonstrations, mitigating the need for complex, hand-engineered reward design. DACL fine-tunes a Temporal Cycle Consistency (TCC) embedding space using fixed start and end anchors, pulling failure endpoints toward the start anchor to treat them as functionally equivalent to the task's beginning. When combined with ground-truth sparse rewards, the learned dense reward achieves approximately 5$\times$ more successful picks than the hand-engineered baseline. We validate the sim-to-real pipeline on a physical Franka Panda robot, achieving a 50\% success rate in dense laboratory clusters with five distractor strawberries and a 20\% success rate in preliminary polytunnel field trials on clusters comparable to the most challenging categories reported in the literature. FruitGym is released as an open-source resource at \url{https://github.com/emlynw/fruit-gym}

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于视觉强化学习的自主草莓采摘框架，包含扩展的FruitGym仿真环境、多目标奖励函数和双锚对比损失（DACL）逆强化学习方法，在实验室和田间试验中验证了从仿真到真实的迁移效果。
AI.research_question: 如何在密集遮挡、视觉多变且需要精细操作的非结构化农业环境中，实现自主草莓采摘的高可靠性？
AI.motivation: 传统感知-规划-控制管线在非结构化农业环境中可靠性有限，而强化学习等方法面临奖励函数设计复杂、仿真到真实迁移困难等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉强化学习、逆强化学习、双锚对比损失（DACL）、时间循环一致性（TCC）嵌入空间。
AI.method: （1）扩展FruitGym仿真环境，加入多目标场景、分叉茎、叶片遮挡等；（2）设计多目标奖励函数；（3）提出DACL方法，利用成功和失败演示学习密集奖励函数。
AI.findings: DACL结合稀疏奖励的密集奖励函数比手工设计的基线实现了约5倍的采摘成功率提升；在物理机器人上实验室密集簇成功率为50%，田间初步试验成功率为20%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DACL这一新颖的基于视频的逆强化学习方法，通过固定起始和结束锚点将失败终点拉向起始锚点，从而从正负演示中学习密集奖励函数。
AI.practical_contributions: 开源了FruitGym仿真环境，提供了从仿真到真实迁移的完整管线验证，为农业自动化采摘机器人提供了可行的技术方案。

title: Regionally tailored biomass blends enable cost-effective sugar and bioproduct Production
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Government of the United States of America - Idaho National Laboratory, Government of the United States of America - Idaho National Laboratory, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of California, Berkeley - Biological Systems and Engineering Division

detail.title: Regionally tailored biomass blends enable cost-effective sugar and bioproduct Production
detail.abstract: Heavy reliance on a single biomass feedstock poses significant challenges for commercial biomanufacturing due to supply variability, cost uncertainty, and quality degradation during storage. Biomass blending offers a flexible strategy to mitigate these risks; however, its economic implications at scale remain insufficiently understood. This study evaluates a field-to-lignocellulosic sugar production system using single feedstocks and blends derived from 11 herbaceous and 11 woody biomass types. A total of 24 herbaceous and 31 woody blends were identified using a multi-factor decision matrix and random sampling approach. Results show that blending significantly improves the stability of the minimum sugar selling price (MSSP). Herbaceous blends exhibit the most favorable economic performance, achieving the lowest median MSSP (~$0.38/kg) and the narrowest cost distribution, while single woody feedstocks display the highest volatility and median costs. Although woody blends retain a broader price range, they eliminate extreme high-cost outliers observed in single-feedstock scenarios. Net-zero sugar production is achievable with a lignin-oil value of approximately $2.2/kg, and several blends achieve MSSP values below $0.40/kg. Downstream analysis using models for isoprenol, 1,4-dimethylcyclooctane (DMCO), and indigoidine indicates that cost stabilization through blending extends to final products. While biofuel pathways remain above current market prices, indigoidine demonstrates strong economic potential. Overall, blending enhances cost stability and reduces risk, with high-value bioproducts and lignin valorization representing key pathways to economic viability.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了生物质混合对木质纤维素糖生产成本稳定性的影响，发现混合原料能显著降低最低糖销售价格（MSSP）的波动性，草本混合原料经济表现最优（中位数MSSP约$0.38/kg），木质素增值至$2.2/kg可实现净零糖生产成本，且成本稳定效应可传递至下游生物产品。
AI.research_question: 生物质混合策略在大规模商业化生物制造中能否提升经济稳定性并降低风险？
AI.motivation: 单一生物质原料在商业生物制造中面临供应波动、成本不确定性和存储质量下降等挑战，而生物质混合作为一种灵活策略，其规模化经济影响尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物质混合理论、多因素决策矩阵、经济风险评估框架
AI.method: 基于11种草本和11种木质生物质，利用多因素决策矩阵和随机抽样方法识别24种草本混合和31种木质混合，对田间到木质纤维素糖生产系统进行经济分析。
AI.findings: 1. 混合显著提升最低糖销售价格（MSSP）的稳定性；2. 草本混合原料经济表现最优（中位数MSSP~$0.38/kg，分布最窄）；3. 单一木质原料波动性和中位成本最高；4. 木质混合虽保留较宽价格范围，但消除了极端高成本异常值；5. 木质素油价值约$2.2/kg可实现净零糖生产；6. 成本稳定效应可延伸至异戊烯醇、DMCO和靛蓝素等下游产品；7. 生物燃料路径仍高于市价，但靛蓝素显示出强劲经济潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了生物质混合策略对糖生产成本稳定性的影响机制，量化了混合原料降低极端经济风险的效果，建立了从原料到下游产品的成本传递分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业化生物制造企业提供了原料混合策略的经济依据，指明了草本混合原料的最佳经济路径，强调了木质素增值和高价值生物产品（如靛蓝素）是实现经济可行的关键方向。

title: Diagnosing Temporal Complexity in Short-Term Fuel Consumption Prediction Using Real-World Vehicle Data
affiliations: Lublin University of Technology and Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) - School of Information Technology & Engineering (SITE)

detail.title: Diagnosing Temporal Complexity in Short-Term Fuel Consumption Prediction Using Real-World Vehicle Data
detail.abstract: Prediction of short-term fuel consumption is important for smart mobility systems; however, the literature often assumes that sequential artificial intelligence models are required due to strong temporal dependencies. This study verifies this assumption and evaluates the temporal complexity of the process. The analysis is based on real-world data from the controller area network of an 18-metre city bus, including vehicle speed, throttle pedal position and fuel consumption, recorded at two measurements per second. Artificial intelligence models are applied, including a non-sequential multilayer perceptron and sequential models such long short-term memory networks and gated recurrent unit networks. Physics-based feature engineering, including kinematic derivatives and rolling statistics, is used to construct the input space. All models achieve high predictive accuracy, with the coefficient of determination exceeding 0.94. Sequential models provide only marginal improvement compared to the multilayer perceptron. Effect size analysis confirms no significant differences. Ablative analysis shows that feature engineering removes the need for long-term memory, while raw-data models require a time window of approximately 30 seconds at the cost of higher error variance. The results demonstrate that short-term fuel consumption is quasi-static and depends mainly on the current system state. Consequently, lightweight artificial intelligence models provide efficient solutions for real-time vehicle energy analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比非序列模型（多层感知机）与序列模型（LSTM、GRU）在短期油耗预测上的表现，发现非序列模型已能达到同等高精度，证明短期油耗过程是准静态的，主要依赖当前系统状态，而非强时间依赖性。
AI.research_question: 短期油耗预测是否需要依赖序列人工智能模型？短期油耗过程的时间复杂性如何？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设短期油耗预测需要序列模型来处理强时间依赖关系，但这一假设尚未被系统验证。验证该假设有助于简化模型设计，提升实时能源分析的效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列复杂性理论、准静态过程假设、人工智能模型对比框架（非序列 vs 序列模型）
AI.method: 基于18米城市公交车的CAN总线真实数据（车速、油门踏板位置、油耗，每秒2次采样），构建非序列模型（MLP）与序列模型（LSTM、GRU），结合基于物理的特征工程（运动学导数、滚动统计量），进行预测效果对比、效应量分析及消融分析。
AI.findings: 1. 所有模型R²均超过0.94，预测精度高；2. 序列模型相比MLP仅带来边际改进，效应量分析无显著差异；3. 特征工程消除了对长时记忆的需求，原始数据模型需要约30秒时间窗口但误差方差更高；4. 短期油耗是准静态过程，主要取决于当前系统状态。
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑并验证了“短期油耗预测必须使用序列模型”的普遍假设，揭示了短期油耗过程的准静态特性，提出了时间复杂性评估的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实时车辆能源分析提供了轻量级AI模型的可行方案，降低了计算成本，有利于智能交通系统中的油耗预测部署。

title: Numerical Investigation on Thermal Dynamic Characteristics of Pool Fires in Time-Varying Wind Environments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Numerical Investigation on Thermal Dynamic Characteristics of Pool Fires in Time-Varying Wind Environments
detail.abstract: In actual fire scenarios, wind fields frequently exhibit dynamic fluctuations in both speed and direction, which significantly affect the thermal dynamic behavior of pool fires. However, existing research predominantly focuses on steady-state crosswinds ignoring the spatial sweeping effect brought by dynamic wind direction. This paper numerically investigates n-heptane and aviation kerosene pool fires under time-varying winds and proposes the "flame-swept area" (Af) to quantify spatial hazard distributions. Results show that time-varying winds trigger quasi-synchronous pulsations in flame height (Hf) and tilt angle (θf). While peak θf reaches 80° for both fuels, n-heptane exhibits superior anti-tilting stiffness. A nonlinear kinematic phase lag emerges between the flame and wind vectors, increasing with wind rotation rate (ω) to peaks of 26.5° and 19.2° at ω = 20◦/s. Furthermore, Af decreases by 19.7% and 11.9% as ω increases from 5°/s to 20°/s, confirming that high-frequency fluctuations spatially constrain flame extension. Internally, external forcing triggers a frequency lock-in mechanism, shifting heat release rate (HRR) pulsations from buoyancy-driven natural modes ( 1.4 Hz) to forced-convection modes (0.1–0.2 Hz). These quantified findings provide a critical theoretical basis for fire safety assessments in complex aerodynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值模拟研究了动态变化风速和风向对池火燃烧行为的影响，提出了"火焰扫掠面积"（Af）来量化空间危险分布，发现时变风会引发火焰高度和倾斜角的准同步脉动，高频风动会空间约束火焰延伸，并揭示了热释放率脉动从浮力驱动自然模态到强制对流模态的频率锁定机制。
AI.research_question: 动态时变风（风速和风向同时变化）如何影响池火的热动力学行为？具体包括火焰几何形态（高度、倾斜角）、空间危险分布（火焰扫掠面积）以及热释放率脉动特征。
AI.motivation: 实际火灾场景中风场通常是动态变化的，但现有研究主要关注稳态侧风，忽略了动态风向带来的空间扫掠效应，这导致对复杂气动环境中火灾风险评估存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 火焰-风场非线性运动相位滞后理论；2. 频率锁定机制（从浮力驱动的自然对流模态向强制对流模态转变）；3. 火焰扫掠面积（Af）作为空间危险分布量化指标。
AI.method: 数值模拟方法，研究正庚烷和航空煤油两种燃料的池火在时变风条件下的燃烧行为，通过改变风旋转速率（ω从5°/s到20°/s）系统分析火焰动态响应。
AI.findings: 1. 时变风引发火焰高度和倾斜角的准同步脉动，峰值倾斜角可达80°；2. 正庚烷相比航空煤油具有更好的抗倾斜刚度；3. 火焰与风向量之间存在非线性运动相位滞后，随旋转速率增大而增大（最高达26.5°）；4. Af随ω增大而减小（最高降幅19.7%），高频风动空间约束火焰延伸；5. HRR脉动从1.4Hz自然模态降至0.1-0.2Hz强制对流模态的频率锁定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出"火焰扫掠面积"（Af）概念，为动态风环境下火灾空间危险分布提供新量化指标；2. 揭示火焰-风场非线性相位滞后规律及其与风旋转速率的定量关系；3. 发现频率锁定机制，阐明外部强迫如何改变池火内部燃烧脉动模态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为复杂气动环境（如城市建筑群、山地风场）中的火灾安全评估提供关键理论基础；2. 指导火灾危险区域划分和消防策略优化，特别是在动态风向条件下；3. 不同燃料（正庚烷与航空煤油）的对比结果为特定场景燃料选择提供依据。

title: Augmented Data-Driven Machine Learning for Liquid Accumulation Prediction in a Gathering Pipeline of Chongqing Shale Gas Field
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Augmented Data-Driven Machine Learning for Liquid Accumulation Prediction in a Gathering Pipeline of Chongqing Shale Gas Field
detail.abstract: Prediction of liquid accumulation volume is critical for the safe operation of complex mountain shale gas gathering pipelines, enabling optimization of pigging cycles and prevention of operational failures. Traditional mechanistic/empirical models exhibit poor universality and require tedious segment-wise calculations, whereas machine learning approaches rely on small field datasets lacking extreme working conditions, resulting in unreliable predictions and unresolved ”black-box” issues. To address this problem, a dual-path data augmentation strategy combining OLGA physical simulation and MixUp interpolation is proposed, and an interpretable framework comparing XGBoost, LightGBM, and DNN is developed using five daily monitored operating parameters. The results show that XGBoost with fully augmented data achieves the best performance, with a test set coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.935, mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.274 m3, and root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.353 m3. OLGA-based physical augmentation consistently improves all three models, whereas MixUp-based algorithmic augmentation significantly benefits only XGBoost. Partial Dependence Plot (PDP) and Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) analyses demonstrate that the augmented data correct small-sample cognitive bias and align model feature responses with gas-liquid two-phase flow mechanisms. This framework provides a physically reliable support tool for liquid accumulation risk control and offers a reference for small-sample data-driven modeling in oil and gas engineering.

title: A digital-twin framework for rapid field-level prediction using parametric POD-ROM and Phase-Locked transient analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Xihua University

detail.title: A digital-twin framework for rapid field-level prediction using parametric POD-ROM and Phase-Locked transient analysis
detail.abstract: A digital-twin framework for efficient prediction of field-level quantities in pump-turbine systems using a reduced-order modeling (ROM) approach is presented in this paper. The framework integrates a parametric POD-ROM for steady-state predictions and a phase-locked Fourier representation for transient simulations, enabling rapid reconstruction of blade-surface pressure and velocity distributions. Although pressure and velocity are used as representative examples, the framework is agnostic to specific variables and can be extended to any monitored scalar or vector quantity. The steady-state POD-ROM demonstrated high accuracy with global relative L2errors of 0.55% for pressure and 3.0% for velocity, while pointwise relative errors for pressure and velocity were below 7.6% and 19.2% at the 95th percentile, respectively. For transient simulations, the phase-locked Fourier state efficiently captures rotor-synchronous loading, with computational times on the order of milliseconds for real-time inference, offering substantial advantages over traditional CFD simulations. The proposed methodology is validated through comparisons with CFD reference data, showing high fidelity for both steady and transient predictions. This approach provides a powerful tool for real-time digital-twin applications in energy systems, facilitating predictive maintenance and operational optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于降阶建模的数字孪生框架，用于泵-涡轮系统中场量（如压力和速度）的高效预测，稳态误差低至0.55%，瞬态计算仅需毫秒级，为实时数字孪生应用提供了有力工具。
AI.research_question: 如何利用降阶建模方法构建一个高效、实时的数字孪生框架，以准确预测泵-涡轮系统中叶片表面压力和速度等场量？
AI.motivation: 传统CFD模拟计算成本高、耗时长，难以满足实时预测、预测性维护和运行优化的需求；亟需一种高效且高保真的降阶建模方法来支持数字孪生应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参数化POD-ROM（本征正交分解降阶模型）用于稳态预测；锁相傅里叶表示用于捕捉转子同步载荷的瞬态模拟。
AI.method: 将参数化POD-ROM与锁相傅里叶表示相结合：稳态部分利用POD进行降阶建模；瞬态部分采用锁相傅里叶表示捕捉周期性转子载荷。通过与传统CFD参考数据对比进行验证。
AI.findings: 稳态预测：压力全局相对L2误差0.55%，速度3.0%；点态相对误差（95百分位）压力低于7.6%，速度低于19.2%。瞬态模拟：计算时间仅为毫秒级，可实现实时推理，高保真复现CFD结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种变量无关的通用降阶建模框架，将稳态POD-ROM与瞬态锁相傅里叶表示有机结合，实现了从稳态到瞬态的全场景高效预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源系统中的实时数字孪生应用提供了可行的解决方案，能够显著降低计算成本，支持预测性维护和运行优化。

title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of a Multi-Stage Separated Gravity Heat Pipe System for Liquid-Cooled Data Centers
affiliations: Nanchang University, Nanchang University, Nanchang University, Nanchang University, Nanchang University and Nanchang University

detail.title: Modeling and Performance Analysis of a Multi-Stage Separated Gravity Heat Pipe System for Liquid-Cooled Data Centers
detail.abstract: The rapid development of high-power-density server chips has continuously increased the cooling demand of liquid-cooled data centers, posing new challenges for improving heat transfer performance and optimizing the operation of cooling systems. In this study, a system-level simulation model of a multi-stage separated gravity heat pipe (MS-SGHP) system was developed based on the AMESim platform. This model was validated by experimental data and then applied to analyze the operating characteristics of the MS-SGHP system. Based on the validated model, the effects of working fluid type, filling ratio, temperature difference between the heat source and cold source, and air flow rate on the operating characteristics of the separated gravity heat pipe (SGHP) system were investigated. In addition, the heat transfer performance and equivalent thermal resistance of SGHP systems with different numbers of stages were compared. The results show that the multi-stage configuration can distribute the overall system temperature difference among different evaporation–condensation loops, thereby improving local temperature-difference matching and reducing the overall thermal resistance. Among the investigated configurations, the three-stage system provides a favorable balance between heat transfer enhancement and structural complexity. On this basis, the filling ratio optimization, streamwise temperature distribution, stage-wise heat load allocation, and thermal resistance characteristics were further analyzed for the three-stage system. The results clarify the role of non-uniform filling distribution among stages in improving system performance. This study provides modeling concepts, analytical methods, and design references for simulation model development, system-level performance analysis, and parameter optimization of SGHP systems for liquid-cooled data centers.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于AMESim平台建立了多级分离式重力热管（MS-SGHP）系统的系统级仿真模型，通过实验数据验证后，分析了工质类型、充液率、冷热源温差及风量等参数对系统运行特性的影响，并对比了不同级数系统的传热性能。结果表明，三级系统在传热增强与结构复杂性之间取得了良好平衡，非均匀充液分布有助于提升系统性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过多级分离式重力热管系统设计和参数优化，提升液冷数据中心冷却系统的传热性能并降低热阻？
AI.motivation: 高功率密度服务器芯片的快速发展使液冷数据中心的冷却需求持续增长，需要改进传热性能和优化冷却系统运行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分离式重力热管（SGHP）传热理论、多级蒸发-冷凝回路温度差匹配原理、等效热阻理论。
AI.method: 基于AMESim平台开发系统级仿真模型，通过实验数据验证，然后进行参数化分析（工质类型、充液率、冷热源温差、风量、级数），重点对三级系统进行充液率优化、流向温度分布、级间热负荷分配和热阻特性分析。
AI.findings: 多级配置可将系统总体温差分配至不同蒸发-冷凝回路，改善局部温度差匹配并降低整体热阻；三级系统在传热增强与结构复杂性之间取得最佳平衡；非均匀充液分布有助于提升系统性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多级分离式重力热管系统中温度差分配机制和级间耦合规律，阐明了非均匀充液分布在多级系统中的性能提升机理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为液冷数据中心SGHP系统的仿真模型开发、系统级性能分析和参数优化提供了建模思路、分析方法和设计参考。

title: China’s Bank Fintech and Balance Sheet Behaviors: Risking or De-risking
affiliations: Renmin University of China, Central University of Finance and Economics and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: China’s Bank Fintech and Balance Sheet Behaviors: Risking or De-risking
detail.abstract: This paper constructs a Fintech index for 202 Chinese banks based on text analysis from news and examines how Fintech affects banks’ risk-taking behaviors. We find that Fintech significantly promotes banks’ willingness to risk-taking but has no overwhelming impact on realized risk performances. Heterogeneity analysis shows that banks with strong profitability, high safety, and ample liquidity are more inclined to alter the risk structure of asset side by allocating a higher proportion of risky assets. Whereas banks with weaker profitability, lower safety, insufficient liquidity tend to leverage the power of Fintech more to optimize their liability structure by expanding non-core liabilities, thus reshaping the risk characteristics on the liability side.

AI.tldr: 本文基于新闻文本分析构建了202家中国银行的金融科技指数，发现金融科技显著促进银行风险承担意愿，但对实际风险表现影响不显著。异质性分析表明，不同特征的银行通过资产端或负债端的不同渠道调整风险结构。
AI.research_question: 金融科技如何影响中国银行的风险承担行为？
AI.motivation: 金融科技快速发展背景下，银行风险承担行为的变化及其机制尚不清晰，特别是不同特征银行的风险调整路径存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文本分析的金融科技指数构建、银行风险承担理论（包括风险承担意愿与实际风险表现的区别）、银行资产端与负债端风险结构调整的异质性机制。
AI.method: 采用新闻文本分析方法构建202家中国银行的金融科技指数，结合银行微观数据进行实证回归和异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）金融科技显著促进银行风险承担意愿，但对实际风险表现无显著影响；（2）盈利能力强、安全性高、流动性充足的银行倾向于通过增加高风险资产配置来调整资产端风险结构；（3）盈利能力弱、安全性低、流动性不足的银行则更多借助金融科技优化负债结构，通过扩大非核心负债来重塑负债端风险特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了银行风险承担意愿与实际风险表现的不同影响，揭示了金融科技影响银行风险行为的异质性渠道（资产端 vs 负债端）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构差异化监管不同特征银行的金融科技应用提供参考，也为银行根据自身禀赋合理运用金融科技管理风险提供启示。

title: PRODUCTION FUNCTION FOR ECONOMIES WITH DEPLOYED SELF-LEARNING TECHNOLOGIES (WITH EMPIRICAL EVIDENCES)

detail.title: PRODUCTION FUNCTION FOR ECONOMIES WITH DEPLOYED SELF-LEARNING TECHNOLOGIES (WITH EMPIRICAL EVIDENCES)
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a production function for economies, in which deployed self-learning AI have become meaningful determinant of total output. The production function is the following: Y(t) = (T(t)l × [S(t) × D(t)]q(t)) × (KAI(t)a1 × KNAI(t)a2) × (LAI(t)Æ1 × LNAI(t)Æ2) × (HAI(t)¶1 × HNAI(t)¶2). The most unique feature is the exponent q(t), the only exponent whose value is determined by its base; this is the unique recursive feature. Self-learning AI, which determine the value of q(t), also determine whether the economy has production function with decreasing, constant or increasing returns to scale. In the production function, singularity is impossible. Empirical evidences from 26 high-income countries show that the proposed production function is much more accurate than Mankiw-Romer-Weil (MRW) production function. While MRW production function produces 0.49 correlation among 22 OECD countries in year 1985, the proposed production function produces 0.96 correlation among 26 high-income countries in year 2024.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含自学习AI的新生产函数，其独特之处在于指数q(t)由底数决定，具有递归特征。该函数比传统MRW函数更准确，在26个高收入国家中相关性达0.96（MRW仅0.49），并指出奇点不可能发生。
AI.research_question: 如何将自学习AI纳入生产函数，以更准确地描述经济总产出？
AI.motivation: 传统生产函数（如MRW）未充分纳入自学习AI对经济的结构性影响，且未能捕捉AI带来的递归特征和规模报酬变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典经济增长理论、生产函数理论、自学习AI递归特征、规模报酬理论。
AI.method: 提出包含自学习AI的递归生产函数模型，并使用26个高收入国家的数据进行实证对比（与MRW模型比较相关性）。
AI.findings: (1) 新生产函数在26个高收入国家中相关性达0.96，远优于MRW在22个OECD国家中的0.49；(2) 自学习AI决定了经济是递减、不变还是递增规模报酬；(3) 在该函数框架下，奇点（技术奇点）不可能发生。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将自学习AI的递归特征引入生产函数，重新定义了规模报酬的确定机制，并提出奇点不可能的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济学家提供了更准确的AI时代经济产出预测工具，有助于理解AI对经济增长的实质性影响。

title: Does financialisation crowd out productive investment? Evidence from IBEX large-cap firms
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad CEU Cardenal Herrera and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Does financialisation crowd out productive investment? Evidence from IBEX large-cap firms
detail.abstract: We examine the association between financial asset intensity and productive capital intensity. Using a panel of 42 IBEX large-cap non-financial Spanish firms listed over 2005–2024. We document a robust negative within-firm association between financial asset intensity and productive capital intensity. A 10-percentage point increase in financial asset holdings as a share of total assets is associated with a 2.4 percentage point reduction in productive capital intensity, equivalent to 7.4% of the sample mean. This association is stable across winsorised, forward-looking, and lagged specifications. Critically, it is five times larger in capital-intensive sectors than in asset-light sectors indicating that the financial–productive capital trade-off is mediated by firms' productive-capital structure. We find no significant associations with employment growth or dividend payouts, suggesting that in this continental European institutional setting financialisation manifests through balance-sheet reallocation rather than distributional channels.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2005-2024年42家西班牙IBEX大型非金融上市公司面板数据，发现企业金融资产强度与生产性资本强度之间存在稳健的负向关系，且这种替代效应在资本密集型行业中是轻资产行业的5倍，但并未显著影响就业增长或股息支付。
AI.research_question: 企业金融资产持有强度与生产性资本强度之间存在何种关联？这种关联在不同行业结构下是否有差异？
AI.motivation: 探究在西班牙等大陆欧洲制度环境下，企业金融化是否通过资产负债表重新配置（而非分配渠道）影响实体投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融化理论、资产负债表重新配置假说、行业资本结构调节效应
AI.method: 采用2005-2024年42家IBEX大型非金融西班牙上市公司的面板数据，进行固定效应回归分析，并采用缩尾处理、前瞻性和滞后期规格进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 金融资产强度每提高10个百分点，生产性资本强度降低2.4个百分点（样本均值的7.4%）；该效应在资本密集型行业中是轻资产行业的5倍；对就业增长和股息支付无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融化通过资产负债表重新配置影响实体投资的机制，并发现行业资本结构对该效应的调节作用，丰富了金融化与实体投资的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解企业金融化对实体经济的潜在负面影响提供实证依据，提示需关注资本密集型行业的金融资产替代效应。

title: Sex Imbalance and Cross-border Marriages：Evidence from China
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Economics

detail.title: Sex Imbalance and Cross-border Marriages：Evidence from China
detail.abstract: Over the past four decades, China’s one-child policy has caused a pronounced sex imbalance favoring men. Using provincial panel data for 2001–2019, this paper examines the impact of sex imbalances on cross-border marriage. The results show that, first, a higher sex ratio significantly increases men’s participation in cross-border marriage, with the effect concentrated among men aged 31–40 who are relatively marginalized in the domestic marriage market. Second, a higher sex ratio reduces women’s participation in cross-border marriage, primarily affecting women aged 26–35 with relatively high levels of human capital. Third, an increase in men’s cross-border marriage participation is associated with lower domestic crime rates, suggesting that cross-border marriage plays a positive role in mitigating the social risks arising from the concentration of “surplus men.”

AI.tldr: 本文利用2001-2019年中国省级面板数据，研究性别失衡对跨境婚姻的影响。发现：性别比升高显著增加31-40岁边缘化男性的跨境婚姻参与，降低26-35岁高人力资本女性的跨境婚姻参与；男性跨境婚姻增加与国内犯罪率下降相关，表明跨境婚姻有助于缓解"剩男"聚集带来的社会风险。
AI.research_question: 性别失衡（男女比例失调）如何影响中国跨境婚姻（跨国通婚）？
AI.motivation: 中国独生子女政策实施四十年导致严重性别失衡（男性过剩），这种"剩男"现象可能带来社会风险。研究跨境婚姻能否作为缓解机制具有重要的政策和社会意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻市场供需理论、性别失衡的社会风险理论、跨境婚姻作为替代性婚姻市场的理论。
AI.method: 使用2001-2019年中国省级面板数据，采用计量经济学回归分析方法，考察性别比对男性和女性跨境婚姻参与率的异质性影响。
AI.findings: 1. 性别比越高，男性跨境婚姻参与率越高，这一效应集中于31-40岁、在境内婚姻市场中相对边缘化的男性。2. 性别比越高，女性跨境婚姻参与率越低，主要影响26-35岁、人力资本相对较高的女性。3. 男性跨境婚姻参与增加与国内犯罪率下降相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将性别失衡研究与跨境婚姻研究相连接，揭示了性别结构影响婚姻市场行为的新机制。2. 发现了跨境婚姻作为"安全阀"缓解性别失衡社会风险的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解中国性别失衡的社会后果提供了实证证据。2. 对跨境婚姻政策制定具有参考价值，表明跨境婚姻可能具有降低犯罪率的正外部性。3. 为人口政策调整（如放开二胎/三胎）提供了间接支持。

title: Study on optimization strategy for cold start of PEMFC based on CGA-Net and HOA
affiliations: Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, Wenzhou University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Wenzhou University

detail.title: Study on optimization strategy for cold start of PEMFC based on CGA-Net and HOA
detail.abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) are regarded as a promising energy conversion technology because of their clean operation, low acoustic emission, and environmental compatibility. Nevertheless, subzero startup remains a major obstacle to the practical application of PEMFCs, because the coupled transport, phase-change, and electrochemical processes inside the cell are highly intricate and cannot be described accurately with simple analytical approaches. To address this issue, a three-dimensional multiphase non-isothermal numerical model was established for PEMFC cold start. Based on this model, a first-order finite-difference sensitivity analysis was performed to identify six dominant control parameters: namely, the initial membrane water content ([[EQUATION]]), initial current density ([[EQUATION]]), gas diffusion layer porosity ([[EQUATION]]), catalyst layer porosity ([[EQUATION]]), ionomer volume fraction ([[EQUATION]]), and membrane thickness ([[EQUATION]]). A convolutional neural network–gated recurrent unit–attention architecture (CGA-Net) was constructed as the surrogate model and further integrated with the Hippopotamus Optimization Algorithm (HOA) to jointly optimize these parameters. The optimization was carried out with two objectives: improving the uniformity of ice distribution in the cathode catalyst layer (CCL) and prolonging the cold-start failure time. Under the optimized parameter combination, the ice distribution uniformity index reached 0.153809, representing a 3.609% improvement over the baseline case. Meanwhile, the cold-start failure time increased to 265.35s, which is 8.746% longer than the baseline value. These findings demonstrate that the proposed method mitigates performance deterioration caused by localized ice accumulation, thereby contributing to improved fuel cell durability. The prolonged failure time further implies that ice formation is suppressed during cold start, which may facilitate faster startup in subsequent auxiliary-heating-assisted cold-start processes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）低温启动难题，建立三维多相非等温数值模型，通过灵敏度分析识别六个关键控制参数，构建CGA-Net代理模型并联合河马优化算法（HOA）进行多目标优化，使冰分布均匀性提升3.609%，冷启动失效时间延长8.746%。
AI.research_question: 如何通过参数优化改善质子交换膜燃料电池冷启动过程中的冰分布均匀性并延长冷启动失效时间？
AI.motivation: PEMFC冷启动时，内部的耦合传输、相变和电化学过程极为复杂，传统简单解析方法无法准确描述，导致低温启动成为实际应用的主要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三维多相非等温数值模型、一阶有限差分灵敏度分析、卷积神经网络-门控循环单元-注意力架构（CGA-Net）、河马优化算法（HOA）
AI.method: 建立三维多相非等温数值模型→进行一阶有限差分灵敏度分析识别六个主导参数→构建CGA-Net代理模型→集成HOA算法进行多目标联合优化
AI.findings: 优化后冰分布均匀性指数达0.153809（提升3.609%），冷启动失效时间延长至265.35s（提升8.746%），验证了该方法可缓解局部冰积聚导致的性能退化，提升燃料电池耐久性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于CGA-Net代理模型与HOA算法联合优化的参数优化方法，为复杂多物理场耦合系统的参数设计提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 优化后的参数组合能有效改善冰分布均匀性和延长冷启动时间，有助于提升PEMFC低温启动性能和耐久性，为辅助加热冷启动过程提供便利。

title: Reform of Local Government Debt Management System and Technological Convergence of Digital and Real-Economy Industries
affiliations: Xiangtan University, Xiangtan University and Xiangtan University

detail.title: Reform of Local Government Debt Management System and Technological Convergence of Digital and Real-Economy Industries

keywords: system under the paradigm of high-quality and innovation-driven productivity.Keywords: Reform of local government debt management system
Technological convergence of digital and real-economy industries

detail.abstract: Leveraging the reform of local government debt management system (hereafter “LGDMReform”) since 2015 as a quasi-natural experiment, this study systematically investigates the impact of fiscal institutional restructuring on the technological convergence of digital and real-economy industries of non-financial listed firms from 2010 to 2022. The empirical findings reveal that reform of local government debt management system significantly enhances firms’ capacity to integrate digital technologies with real-economy industrial processes. Mechanism analyses suggest that the reform of local government debt management system facilitates this integration through multiple channels, including the alleviation of credit constraints, improves innovation efficiency, and the mitigation of resource misallocation. Heterogeneity analyses across firm-level and city-level dimensions further indicate that reform of local government debt management system positive effects were more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises with greater R&D intensity and tighter financing constraints, as well as in cities characterized by higher fiscal expenditure on science and technology and greater fiscal stress. Anchored in the context of local government debt governance, this paper offers a novel analytical lens for understanding the intrinsic drivers of capacity to integrate digital technologies with real-economy industrial processes, and provides robust empirical evidence to support the development of a modern industrial system under the paradigm of high-quality and innovation-driven productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文以2015年地方政府债务管理制度改革为准自然实验，研究发现该改革通过缓解信贷约束、提升创新效率和改善资源错配，显著增强了企业数字技术与实体经济融合的能力，尤其对非国企、高研发投入及财政压力大的城市效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 地方政府债务管理制度改革如何影响企业数字技术与实体经济的融合能力？
AI.motivation: 在数字经济与实体经济深度融合的背景下，探究财政制度变革（地方政府债务管理改革）对产业技术融合的驱动作用，为理解数字化转型的深层制度性因素提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政制度变迁理论、信贷约束理论、资源配置理论，构建"财政制度改革→缓解信贷约束/提升创新效率/改善资源错配→数字与实体经济融合"的分析框架。
AI.method: 以2015年地方政府债务管理制度改革为准自然实验，采用双重差分法（DID），使用2010-2022年非金融上市公司面板数据进行实证分析，并进行机制检验和异质性分析。
AI.findings: 改革显著提升了企业数字技术与实体经济融合能力；机制上通过缓解信贷约束、提升创新效率和改善资源错配三条路径发挥作用；异质性上对非国企、高研发投入、强融资约束企业，以及科技支出高、财政压力大的城市效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财政制度研究拓展至数字技术融合领域，揭示了地方政府债务治理对企业数字化转型的制度性驱动机制，丰富了财政制度与产业融合交叉研究的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府债务管理改革的经济效果提供了微观证据，为构建现代产业体系、推动创新驱动的高质量发展提供了政策启示。

title: Modeling of Light Interception and Radiation Use Efficiency in Pigeon Pea under Varying Irrigation and Planting Geometries in Semi-arid Region
affiliations: University of the Free State, University of the Free State - Department of Soil, Crop, and Climate Sciences and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Modeling of Light Interception and Radiation Use Efficiency in Pigeon Pea under Varying Irrigation and Planting Geometries in Semi-arid Region
detail.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of three irrigation regimes (full, partial, and rainfed) and three planting geometries [wide, common and narrow] on canopy development, intercepted photosynthetically active radiation, and RUE in two pigeon pea cultivars (ICEAP 00604 and 86012) across two seasons (2023/24 and 2024/25) in a semi-arid environment in South Africa. Cultivar differences were evident: ICEAP 00604 generally produced a larger canopy and higher IPAR under irrigation, whereas ICEAP 86012 maintained relatively greater LAI and interception efficiency under moisture limitation, indicating superior drought responsiveness. Planting geometry interacted with irrigation, with GW maximizing radiation capture under irrigated conditions and GN supporting greater interception under rainfed conditions due to denser canopies. A key novel finding is that the canopy light extinction coefficient (k) is a dynamic, water-responsive parameter rather than a fixed constant. Both cultivars exhibited increasing k-values with improved moisture supply, ranging from 0.32 under rainfed GN to 0.63–0.64 under partial irrigation, demonstrating strong sensitivity to water regime and canopy architecture. This provides the first quantitative evidence that k varies with environmental and management factors in pigeon pea, highlighting the need for dynamic k-parameterization in radiation-use models. The empirical fPAR model showed excellent agreement with observed data (R² ≥ 0.98; RMSE ≤ 0.05) under irrigation but modest declines under rainfed conditions. RUE followed similar trends, with full irrigation achieving the highest efficiencies (up to 2.29 g MJ⁻¹) and rainfed treatments the lowest, though ICEAP 01284/2 maintained marginally higher RUE under stress.

AI.tldr: 本研究在非洲半干旱地区评估了三个灌溉制度、三种种植几何和两个木豆品种对冠层发育、光合有效辐射截获及辐射利用效率的影响，发现消光系数k是随水分条件动态变化的参数，而非固定常数，为木豆辐射利用模型中的k参数动态化提供了首个定量证据。
AI.research_question: 灌溉制度和种植几何如何影响不同木豆品种的冠层发育、光合有效辐射截获及辐射利用效率？消光系数k是否在不同水分条件下保持恒定？
AI.motivation: 在半干旱地区，水分是限制木豆产量的关键因素，但灌溉制度与种植几何的交互作用对冠层光能利用的影响尚不明确；此外，辐射利用模型通常假设消光系数k为常数，这一假设在水分胁迫下是否成立缺乏定量验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 辐射利用效率（RUE）理论、冠层光截获模型（Beer-Lambert定律）、消光系数（k）动态变化假设。
AI.method: 在2023/24和2024/25两个生长季，设置三个灌溉水平（充分灌溉、部分灌溉、雨养）、三种种植几何（宽行距、常规行距、窄行距）和两个木豆品种（ICEAP 00604和ICEAP 86012），采用裂区设计，测量冠层发育指标、光合有效辐射（PAR）截获比例、消光系数k及辐射利用效率（RUE），并建立经验fPAR模型进行验证。
AI.findings: （1）品种差异显著：ICEAP 00604在灌溉条件下冠层更大、截获更高IPAR，而ICEAP 86012在水分限制下保持较高的LAI和截获效率，表现出更优的干旱响应能力；（2）种植几何与灌溉存在交互：宽行距在灌溉条件下最大化辐射捕获，窄行距在雨养条件下因更密冠层支持更高的截获；（3）关键发现：消光系数k是动态的水分响应参数，从雨养窄行距的0.32变化到部分灌溉下的0.63–0.64，证明k随水分状况和冠层结构显著变化；（4）经验fPAR模型在灌溉条件下拟合极佳（R²≥0.98，RMSE≤0.05），在雨养条件下略有下降；（5）RUE在充分灌溉下最高（达2.29 g MJ⁻¹），雨养处理最低，但ICEAP 01284/2在胁迫下维持略高的RUE。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供木豆消光系数k随环境和管理因素动态变化的定量证据，挑战了辐射利用模型中k为固定常数的传统假设，提出需要动态参数化k以准确模拟不同水分条件下的冠层光能利用效率。
AI.practical_contributions: 为半干旱地区木豆生产提供了灌溉制度与种植几何的优化组合建议：灌溉条件下推荐宽行距以最大化辐射捕获，雨养条件下推荐窄行距以维持较高的光截获效率；同时，品种选择需考虑水分可用性，干旱敏感型品种（如ICEAP 00604）适合灌溉条件，耐旱型品种（如ICEAP 86012）更适合雨养种植。

title: Managerial Disclosure Cohesion and Information Asymmetry:Evidence from Earnings Conference Calls
affiliations: California Polytechnic State University and California Polytechnic State University

detail.title: Managerial Disclosure Cohesion and Information Asymmetry:Evidence from Earnings Conference Calls
detail.abstract: This study examines whether managerial disclosure cohesion in earnings conference calls is associated with information asymmetry. We define managerial disclosure cohesion as the extent to which ideas, events, and concepts in the Presentation section of a conference call are logically connected and coherently organized. Our sample consists of 55,776 firm-quarter earnings conference calls from 2005 to 2017. For each transcript, we use the Coh-Metrix software to measure disclosure cohesion. We find that higher managerial disclosure cohesion is associated with lower bid-ask spreads. This association remains significant after controlling for readability, suggesting that cohesion captures a textual attribute distinct from linguistic complexity. Additional analyses using analyst forecast dispersion and stock return volatility as alternative information asymmetry proxies provide consistent results. We also find that the association between managerial disclosure cohesion and information asymmetry is stronger when earnings conference call presentations are more linguistically complex. Overall, our findings suggest that disclosure effectiveness depends not only on linguistic simplicity but also on how information is organized and connected.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于55,776份公司季度盈余电话会议记录（2005-2017年），发现管理层披露连贯性（即电话会议陈述部分中思想、事件和概念之间的逻辑连接和组织连贯性）越高，信息不对称程度（以买卖价差衡量）越低，且这一效应在语言复杂度较高时更为显著。
AI.research_question: 盈余电话会议中管理层披露的连贯性是否与信息不对称程度相关？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注披露的可读性（语言简洁性），但忽略了信息组织和逻辑连贯性对信息披露有效性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露有效性理论；语言连贯性与信息处理成本理论。
AI.method: 使用Coh-Metrix软件量化电话会议陈述部分的披露连贯性；以买卖价差为主要信息不对称代理变量，辅以分析师预测离散度和股票收益波动率；控制可读性等变量进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 1) 管理层披露连贯性越高，买卖价差越低（信息不对称程度降低）；2) 控制可读性后该效应依然显著，表明连贯性是独立于语言复杂性的文本属性；3) 在语言复杂度较高的电话会议中，连贯性对信息不对称的缓解作用更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将“披露连贯性”作为独立于可读性的文本属性引入会计信息披露研究；2) 拓展了信息披露有效性理论，证明信息组织方式（逻辑连接与连贯结构）与语言简洁性同等重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为管理层优化电话会议披露策略提供指导：除降低语言复杂度外，还应注重信息的逻辑组织和连贯表达；2) 为投资者和分析师评估信息披露质量提供新维度（连贯性指标）。

title: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Automated Unit Price Analysis in Construction: Experimental Evaluation of Accuracy, Consistency, and Efficiency
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Automated Unit Price Analysis in Construction: Experimental Evaluation of Accuracy, Consistency, and Efficiency
detail.abstract: This study presents and evaluates a RetrievalAugmented Generation system for automating Unit Price Analysis (UPA) in construction cost estimation. The system integrates semantic vector search with a Large Language Model, built upon a database of more than 37,000 UPAs from 63 real-world construction projects. A controlled between-subjects experiment with 10 civil engineers compared AI-assisted and traditional manual estimation across three dimensions: accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency. Each participant developed 36 cost items from a real public infrastructure benchmark project. Results show that the traditional method achieved higher accuracy (MAPE: 5.51%) than the AI-assisted approach (MAPE: 9.85%), with both falling within AACE Class 3 thresholds. The AI-assisted approach improved consistency, reducing the coefficient of variation from 73.56% to 34.74%, and decreased development time by 44.21% (Mann–Whitney U test, p = 0.008). These findings position AI-augmented systems as standardization and productivity tools rather than replacements for expert judgment in construction cost estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的自动化单价分析系统，利用37,000余条实际工程数据，通过10名工程师的对照实验发现：AI辅助虽精度略低于传统方法（MAPE 9.85% vs 5.51%），但显著提升了一致性（变异系数从73.56%降至34.74%）并缩短44.21%的开发时间。
AI.research_question: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统在建筑成本估算中的单价分析任务上，相比传统人工方法，在准确性、一致性和操作效率三个维度表现如何？
AI.motivation: 建筑成本估算中的单价分析（UPA）高度依赖专家经验，存在效率低下、主观性强、一致性差等问题，而现有AI方法在专业领域知识整合和可解释性方面存在不足，亟需一种既能利用历史数据又能结合领域知识的自动化方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 检索增强生成（RAG）框架；语义向量检索技术；大语言模型（LLM）；对照实验设计（between-subjects）
AI.method: 构建基于37,000余条UPA数据的RAG系统（语义向量搜索+LLM）；采用受控的组间对照实验，招募10名土木工程师，分别使用AI辅助和传统手动方法对同一公共基础设施基准项目的36个成本项进行估算；使用MAPE衡量准确性、变异系数衡量一致性、开发时间衡量效率，并进行Mann-Whitney U检验。
AI.findings: （1）传统方法准确率更高（MAPE 5.51% vs 9.85%），但两者均在AACE Class 3阈值内；（2）AI辅助方法显著提升一致性，变异系数从73.56%降至34.74%；（3）AI辅助方法缩短44.21%的开发时间（p=0.008），差异统计显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了RAG系统在建筑成本估算领域的可行性和边界条件——AI可作为标准化和效率提升工具，但尚未达到替代专家判断的水平；为AI辅助下"人机协作"模式在专业工程估算中的效果提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑行业提供了可落地的AI辅助单价分析系统原型；量化了AI在成本估算中的效率提升（44%）和一致性改善（变异系数降低一半以上），为企业在标准化成本管理和快速报价方面提供了决策依据；明确了AI辅助方法的适用场景（追求一致性和效率）和局限性（精度仍需专家把关）。

title: Bayesian optimization for design space exploration of tokamak fusion reactors
affiliations: Korea Institute of Fusion Energy, Korea Institute of Fusion Energy, Korea Institute of Fusion Energy, Jeonbuk National University, Korea Institute of Fusion Energy, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bayesian optimization for design space exploration of tokamak fusion reactors
detail.abstract: Designing a tokamak fusion reactor requires exploring a high-dimensional parameter space where multiple coupled variables must simultaneously satisfy physics constraints and engineering limits. Conventional exhaustive search approaches become computationally prohibitive as dimensionality increases. This paper demonstrates the application of multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) to tokamak design space exploration using a low-fidelity system analysis code.We compare state-of-the-art acquisition functions against an exhaustive search baseline for bi-objective optimization minimizing major radius (a capital cost proxy) and maximizing net electric power. Results show that all MOBO methods recover Pareto fronts comparable to exhaustive search while requiring orders of magnitude fewer function evaluations. We investigate the effects of acquisition function choice, batch size for parallel evaluation, and constraint handling strategies on convergence behavior. The methodology provides practical guidelines for efficient design optimization and establishes a framework applicable to higher-fidelity,computationally expensive plasma simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）在托卡马克聚变反应堆设计空间探索中的应用，相比穷举搜索，MOBO方法能以极少的函数评估次数恢复出可比的Pareto前沿。
AI.research_question: 如何利用多目标贝叶斯优化高效地探索托卡马克聚变反应堆的高维设计空间，在满足物理约束和工程限制的同时优化多个目标？
AI.motivation: 传统穷举搜索方法在高维托卡马克设计空间中计算成本过高，亟需更高效的优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）、采集函数（acquisition functions）、帕累托前沿（Pareto front）
AI.method: 使用低保真度系统分析代码，比较多种先进的MOBO采集函数与穷举搜索基线，进行双目标优化（最小化大半径作为资本成本代理，最大化净电功率），并研究采集函数选择、并行评估批量大小、约束处理策略对收敛行为的影响。
AI.findings: 所有MOBO方法均能以数量级更少的函数评估次数恢复出与穷举搜索相当的Pareto前沿。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了将MOBO应用于托卡马克设计优化的方法论框架，系统比较了不同采集函数和策略的收敛效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高效设计优化提供了实用指南，建立了一个可推广到更高保真度、计算成本高昂的等离子体模拟的框架。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning vs Classical MPPT Algorithms in Photovoltaic Systems Under Partial Shading: A Comparative Study
affiliations: University of Bejaia

detail.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning vs Classical MPPT Algorithms in Photovoltaic Systems Under Partial Shading: A Comparative Study
detail.abstract: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is a fundamental control strategy in photovoltaic (PV) systems, ensuring solar panels operate at their optimal power output under varying environmental conditions. This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four distinct MPPT techniques: Perturb and Observe (P&O), Incremental Conductance (INC), Sliding Mode Control (SMC) [1], and Deep Q-Network (DQN)-based Reinforcement Learning, with particular emphasis on performance under partial shading conditions (PSC). Partial shading introduces multiple local maximum power points on the P-V characteristic curve, posing a significant challenge for conventional tracking algorithms. Each method is rigorously evaluated across key performance metrics including tracking speed, steady-state oscillation, global MPP detection accuracy, convergence time, and robustness to rapid irradiance fluctuations. Traditional methods such as P&O and Incremental Conductance demonstrate satisfactory performance under uniform irradiance but suffer from entrapment at local maxima during partial shading. Sliding Mode Control offers improved robustness through its nonlinear control framework, while the DQN-based approach leverages deep reinforcement learning to intelligently navigate complex multi-peak P-V curves without prior system knowledge. Simulation results confirm that the DQN technique achieves superior global tracking accuracy and dynamic adaptability under PSC[2], establishing it as a promising solution for next-generation intelligent solar energy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了四种光伏最大功率点跟踪技术（P&O、INC、滑模控制、DQN强化学习），发现DQN在局部遮阴条件下具有最优的全局跟踪精度和动态适应性。
AI.research_question: 在局部遮阴条件下，四种MPPT技术（P&O、INC、滑模控制、DQN强化学习）在跟踪速度、稳态振荡、全局MPP检测精度、收敛时间及抗辐照波动鲁棒性方面的性能表现如何？
AI.motivation: 局部遮阴会导致光伏P-V特性曲线出现多个局部最大功率点，传统MPPT算法容易陷入局部最优，亟需寻找更优的全局跟踪解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最大功率点跟踪理论；P&O与INC的经典扰动观测理论；滑模控制的非线性鲁棒控制理论；深度Q网络（DQN）的强化学习理论。
AI.method: 仿真对比研究，从跟踪速度、稳态振荡、全局MPP检测精度、收敛时间、辐照波动鲁棒性五个维度对四种MPPT技术进行系统评估。
AI.findings: P&O和INC在均匀辐照下表现良好，但局部遮阴时易陷入局部最大值；滑模控制鲁棒性更强；DQN方法无需先验系统知识，在多峰P-V曲线中实现最优全局跟踪精度和动态适应性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统建立了四种MPPT技术在多峰P-V曲线下的性能对比框架，验证了深度强化学习在光伏最大功率跟踪中的理论可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为下一代智能太阳能系统提供了MPPT技术选型依据，证明DQN方法在复杂光照条件下的工程应用价值。

title: Sequential Contingency Finder for Power System Security Tasks
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Delft University of Technology

detail.title: Sequential Contingency Finder for Power System Security Tasks
detail.abstract: The increasing penetration of variable renewable energy sources has significantly altered power system dynamics, compelling operators to analyze a wide range of credible contingencies to ensure security. The high variability of operating conditions continuously reshapes the critical contingency set, making exhaustive screening computationally intractable under a limited computation budget, especially for multiple contingencies. This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework with an adaptive reward formulation for contingency prioritization as a sequential decision-making problem. The framework learns adaptive selection policies directly from power flow features and is applicable to both dynamic and static security formulations. Evaluations on the IEEE 39-bus system demonstrate the effective identification of critical contingencies across both security formulations, confirming the viability of RL-based screening as a practical tool for system operators to reduce the search space under multi-contingency scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应奖励框架，用于电力系统关键故障筛选的优先级排序，在IEEE 39节点系统上验证了其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限计算预算下，高效识别多故障场景下电力系统的关键故障集？
AI.motivation: 高比例可变可再生能源并网导致运行条件高度不确定，关键故障集不断变化，传统穷举筛选在多故障场景下计算量过大，不可行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习（Reinforcement Learning）
AI.method: 提出强化学习框架，采用自适应奖励公式，将故障优先级排序建模为序列决策问题，直接从潮流特征中学习自适应选择策略。
AI.findings: 在IEEE 39节点系统上，该方法在动态和静态安全分析两种场景下均能有效识别关键故障，验证了基于强化学习的筛选方法作为实用工具的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将强化学习应用于电力系统多故障场景下的关键故障优先排序，提出了自适应奖励机制以适应不断变化的运行条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统运营商提供了一种在有限计算预算下减少搜索空间、快速识别关键故障的实用工具，有助于提升电力系统安全运行效率。

title: Oil Prices, Public Holidays, And Inflation: The Effect on the Saudi Tadawul All Share Index (Tasi)
affiliations: George Washington University

detail.title: Oil Prices, Public Holidays, And Inflation: The Effect on the Saudi Tadawul All Share Index (Tasi)
detail.abstract: This paper examines the determinants of the Saudi Tadawul All Share Index (TASI) over the period January 2020 to December 2025, with a focus on three drivers: global oil prices, Islamic public holiday seasonality, and consumer price inflation. Using daily TASI data (1,500 observations), monthly Brent crude prices, and World Bank CPI figures for Saudi Arabia, we document a statistically significant positive correlation between oil and equity returns (Pearson r = 0.30, p = 0.011), while finding no robust holiday effect on returns (p = 0.731). Holiday windows do exhibit elevated return volatility (+0.17 pp standard deviation above normal days). Cumulative TASI returns substantially exceeded inflation over the period, delivering positive real equity returns in four of five years. These findings have implications for asset allocation, risk management, and the evolving relationship between oil revenues and Saudi equity market performance under Vision 2030.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2020年1月至2025年12月期间沙特Tadawul全股指数（TASI）的驱动因素，聚焦于全球油价、伊斯兰公共假期季节性和消费者价格通胀三个变量。研究发现油价与股市回报呈显著正相关（r=0.30, p=0.011），但假期效应不显著（p=0.731），不过假期期间波动率更高。五年中有四年实现正实际回报，对资产配置和风险管理具有启示意义。
AI.research_question: 沙特TASI指数的驱动因素是什么？具体而言，全球油价、伊斯兰公共假期季节性和消费者价格通胀如何影响TASI指数的回报与波动？
AI.motivation: 在沙特"2030愿景"经济转型背景下，理解沙特股市驱动因素对投资者资产配置、风险管理和政策制定具有重要意义，同时有助于厘清石油收入与沙特股市之间不断演变的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 石油市场与股市联动理论（石油作为沙特经济命脉）、日历效应理论（假期季节性与市场行为）、实际回报与通胀关系理论（Fisher效应）
AI.method: 使用2020年1月至2025年12月的日度TASI数据（1500个观测值）、月度布伦特原油价格和世界银行沙特CPI数据，采用Pearson相关性分析和统计检验方法。
AI.findings: （1）油价与沙特股市回报呈统计显著正相关（Pearson r=0.30, p=0.011）；（2）伊斯兰公共假期对股市回报无显著影响（p=0.731），但假期窗口内波动率升高（标准差高出0.17个百分点）；（3）累计TASI回报大幅超过通胀，五年中有四年实现正实际回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 在沙特特定市场情境下验证了石油-股市联动理论，并发现假期效应在回报层面不显著但在波动率层面显著，丰富了新兴市场日历效应的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特股市投资者提供资产配置和风险管理参考，尤其是在"2030愿景"背景下重新审视石油与股市的关系；提示关注假期期间波动率上升的风险。

title: Design of Hybrid Human-AI Agent Organizations: A Mathematical Framework for Organizational Dynamics

detail.title: Design of Hybrid Human-AI Agent Organizations: A Mathematical Framework for Organizational Dynamics
detail.abstract: This work develops a mathematically closed, fully identifiable, and empirically falsifiable theory of hybrid Human-AI organizational design. The research introduces a unified probabilistic representation in which classical and AI-native organizational dimensions are embedded into a 17-dimensional latent space and mapped to a Fisher-geometric probability simplex through a softmax transformation. Measurement is formalized through RKHS-bounded feature maps, dynamics evolve on latent space via controlled stochastic differential equations, and governance is encoded through a Kullback-Leibler potential with strict dissipation. The resulting system forms a controlled stochastic manifold with explicit information geometry and guarantees convergence to a governance-optimal equilibrium. Note: Definitions are provided in the Appendices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个数学上封闭、完全可识别且可实证证伪的混合人-AI组织设计理论，通过17维潜在空间、Fisher几何概率单纯形、RKHS特征映射、受控随机微分方程和KL散度治理势能，形成了一个具有显式信息几何的受控随机流形，并保证收敛到治理最优均衡。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个数学封闭、完全可识别且可实证证伪的混合人-AI组织设计理论？
AI.motivation: 现有组织设计理论缺乏对混合人-AI系统的严格数学形式化，无法同时满足封闭性、可识别性和可证伪性三大科学要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息几何（Fisher几何）、RKHS（再生核希尔伯特空间）理论、随机微分方程、KL散度势能、受控随机流形
AI.method: 构建17维潜在空间，通过softmax变换映射到Fisher几何概率单纯形；采用RKHS有界特征映射进行测量；通过受控随机微分方程刻画潜在空间动力学；通过具有严格耗散性质的KL散度势能编码治理机制。
AI.findings: 该系统形成了一个受控随机流形，具备显式信息几何，并保证收敛到治理最优均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出数学封闭、完全可识别且可实证证伪的混合人-AI组织设计理论；建立了融合经典维度与AI原生维度的统一概率框架；将信息几何引入组织设计研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为混合人-AI组织的实际设计提供了可量化的数学工具和可证伪的检验框架，有助于指导组织治理机制的设计与优化。

title: Multi-Parameter Optimization of Dual-Gate Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors Using Artificial Neural Networks
affiliations: National Institute of Technology Raipur and National Institute of Technology Raipur

detail.title: Multi-Parameter Optimization of Dual-Gate Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors Using Artificial Neural Networks
detail.abstract: The prediction and optimization of low-power semiconductor devices have become increasingly important for the design of next-generation energy-efficient electronic systems. Although TCAD simulations provide accurate device analysis, they require significant computational time and resources, particularly during multi-parameter optimization. To overcome these limitations, this work proposes a machine learning (ML)-based framework for accurate prediction of the 𝐼𝐷𝑆-𝑉𝐺𝑆 characteristics of Dual-Gate Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors (DG-TFETs) using TCAD generated datasets. Key device parameters, including oxide thickness (𝑡𝑜𝑥), gate length (𝐿𝑔), gate work function (𝜙𝐺), and temperature (𝑇) are utilized as input features to capture the nonlinear electrical behavior of the device. A comparative analysis is carried out using Polynomial Regression (PR), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest Regression (RFR), Light Gradient Boosting (LGB), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models. The performance of these models is evaluated using statistical metrics such as 𝑅2, Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Among all the models, ANN achieved the highest prediction accuracy with an 𝑅2 value of nearly 0.9988 and the lowest prediction errors. In addition, the proposed framework is employed for multiparameter device optimization by simultaneously maximizing the 𝐼ON∕𝐼OFF ratio and minimizing RC delay. The optimized ML predictions exhibit excellent agreement with TCAD simulation results, achieving an overall optimization accuracy of approximately 99.55%. The proposed ML-assisted framework considerably reduces computational complexity while providing a fast, reliable, and efficient approach for DG-TFET modeling and optimization

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了基于机器学习的框架，利用TCAD生成的数据集准确预测DG-TFET的电流-电压特性，并通过多参数优化实现约99.55%的优化准确率，大幅降低了计算复杂度。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法高效准确地预测和优化双栅隧穿场效应晶体管（DG-TFET）的电学特性（𝐼𝐷𝑆-𝑉𝐺𝑆曲线）及器件性能（𝐼ON/𝐼OFF比和RC延迟）？
AI.motivation: TCAD仿真虽然精确，但在多参数优化时计算耗时且资源消耗大，难以满足下一代低功耗半导体器件快速设计与优化的需求，因此需要一种计算高效且可靠的替代方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习回归模型（多项式回归、决策树、随机森林、LightGBM、人工神经网络）；TCAD物理仿真；器件物理（DG-TFET的工作原理、𝐼𝐷𝑆-𝑉𝐺𝑆特性、𝐼ON/𝐼OFF比、RC延迟）。
AI.method: 以氧化层厚度、栅极长度、栅极功函数和温度为输入特征，利用TCAD生成数据集，训练五种ML模型（PR、DT、RFR、LGB、ANN），以R²、MSE、MAE、MAPE评估性能，并基于最优模型进行多参数优化（最大化𝐼ON/𝐼OFF比、最小化RC延迟）。
AI.findings: ANN模型预测精度最高（R²≈0.9988，误差最低）；优化后的ML预测与TCAD仿真结果高度一致，整体优化准确率约99.55%；所提框架显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了机器学习（尤其是ANN）在半导体器件非线性电学行为建模中的有效性，为数据驱动的器件建模方法提供了理论依据；建立了ML预测与物理仿真之间的高一致性验证标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DG-TFET的设计提供了一种快速、可靠且计算高效的预测与优化工具，有助于加速下一代低功耗电子系统的研发进程，降低TCAD仿真的时间和资源成本。

title: A Forensic Accounting Test of the Retail-Throughput Financing Hypothesis: Unit Economics, Capacity Constraints, and Stress Resilience (2008-2019)

detail.title: A Forensic Accounting Test of the Retail-Throughput Financing Hypothesis: Unit Economics, Capacity Constraints, and Stress Resilience (2008-2019)
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the financial plausibility of a widely circulated hypothesis: that a multi-asset ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) ecosystem comprising private islands, multiple residences, marine and aviation assets, permanent security, and ongoing legal overhead was primarily financed through a high-ticket retail service operation (“retail-throughput” hypothesis). Using an estimated UHNW run-rate (G ≈ 35M USD/year; ≈95K/day) constructed from documented asset valuations, staffing records, and aviation cost benchmarks, formal unit-economics equations, operational capacity constraints, and a 2019 liquidity stress test (+15–30M USD; defense 10–20M USD), the analysis demonstrates that the retail throughput required to sustain the ecosystem demands industrial-scale operational capacity (≥38 to 128 daily units), incompatible with low-visibility operational profiles. Banking records from USVI v. JPMorgan Chase (S.D.N.Y. 2022) provide an empirical counterpoint: documented transaction frequency falls an order of magnitude below the throughput the retail hypothesis demands. A patrimonial model (4–6% yield on capital ≥500M USD) is parsimonious and stress-resilient. This paper addresses financial structure only; criminal determinations (United States v. Epstein, S.D.N.Y. 2019) remain unaffected.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对超高净值（UHNW）运行成本（约3500万美元/年）的量化分析，证伪了“零售吞吐量假说”——即杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的多元资产帝国（私人岛屿、多处房产、海空资产等）主要由高客单价零售业务融资的观点。通过单位经济学模型、运营容量约束和2019年流动性压力测试，研究发现维持该生态系统所需的日吞吐量（38-128单/天）远超低可见度运营的可行范围。银行记录显示实际交易频率比假说要求低一个数量级。最优解释是世袭财富模型（5亿美元以上资本产生4-6%收益）。
AI.research_question: 杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的多资产超高净值生态系统是否主要通过高客单价零售服务业务（零售吞吐量假说）融资？
AI.motivation: 广泛流传的零售吞吐量假说缺乏严谨的财务可行性检验，且与爱泼斯坦案中已知的低可见度运营特征存在矛盾。本文旨在用财务建模方法检验该假说的逻辑一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单位经济学（Unit Economics）、运营容量约束（Operational Capacity Constraints）、流动性压力测试（Liquidity Stress Testing）、世袭财富模型（Patrimonial Model）
AI.method: 构建UHNW运行成本估算（G≈3500万美元/年≈9.5万美元/天），基于已记录的资产估值、人员配置记录和航空成本基准；建立正式的单位经济学方程和运营容量约束模型；实施2019年流动性压力测试（+1500-3000万美元；辩护费1000-2000万美元）；引用USVI v. JPMorgan Chase案（S.D.N.Y. 2022）银行记录作为实证对照。
AI.findings: (1) 维持生态系统所需零售吞吐量为每日38-128单位，远超低可见度运营的可行能力； (2) 银行记录显示实际交易频率比假说要求低一个数量级； (3) 世袭财富模型（≥5亿美元资本产生4-6%收益率）在简约性和压力韧性上均优于零售假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 将单位经济学和运营容量约束首次系统应用于超高净值生态系统的融资假说检验；提出了“世袭财富模型”作为比零售吞吐量假说更简约且韧性更强的替代性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解爱泼斯坦案财务结构提供严谨的量化分析框架；澄清了广泛传播但缺乏依据的零售假说的不可行性；为相关法律和公共讨论提供财务分析基础。

title:
Dual Anchors: China-U.S. Factors Jointly Determining Global Gold and Crude Oil Pricing

—Systematic Evidence Based on Exhaustive Testing with VIF Constraints

detail.title:
Dual Anchors: China-U.S. Factors Jointly Determining Global Gold and Crude Oil Pricing

—Systematic Evidence Based on Exhaustive Testing with VIF Constraints
detail.abstract: Abstract: Traditional commodity pricing literature has long anchored gold and crude oil pricing to U.S.-centric variables, leaving China-linked factors systematically excluded from quantifiable pricing frameworks. This study employs a rolling regression framework with a 756-trading-day window and variance inflation factor (VIF) constraints, exhaustively testing 462 factor combinations for gold and 141 for crude oil. The optimal gold model (China-U.S. Dual-Anchor Three-Factor Gold Valuation Model) consists of the TIPS real yield, the China-U.S. 10-year sovereign yield spread, and the gold-oil ratio, achieving a rolling full-sample R² of 0.908 and a static full-sample R² of 0.814 (2016–2026), with all VIFs below 5. The optimal crude oil model (China-U.S. Dual-Anchor Four-Factor Crude Oil Valuation Model) consists of Shanghai crude oil futures (SC), the VIX, the synthetic time spread, and the China-U.S. yield spread, achieving a full-sample R² of 0.889 and a fixed-parameter out-of-sample R² of 0.611. Under Newey-West autocorrelation-consistent corrections and LASSO regularization, all China-linked factors retain statistical significance and model survival. The China-U.S. yield spread is the only factor that enters the optimal models in both markets. Its independent explanatory power in gold traces back to at least 2006 (three-factor historical static R² = 0.836), while in crude oil its pricing function strictly begins with the launch of Shanghai crude oil futures in March 2018, as evidenced by a systematic sign reversal of its coefficient from +7.51 pre-launch to -10.48 post-launch. The SC factor maintains a 100% positive sign across all six rolling sub-periods with zero sign reversals. Exhaustive strategy backtesting across both markets demonstrates that valuation signals systematically improve risk-adjusted returns, with the optimal gold strategy achieving a Sharpe ratio of 1.66 and the optimal crude oil strategy achieving a Sharpe ratio of 0.86. The global commodity pricing regime has evolved from a single-anchor to a China-U.S. dual-anchor structure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过滚动回归框架和VIF约束，从462种黄金和141种原油因子组合中筛选出最优定价模型，发现中国因素已系统性嵌入全球大宗商品定价，黄金和原油定价正从美国单锚转向中美双锚结构。
AI.research_question: 中国因素是否以及如何被系统性纳入黄金和原油的量化定价模型？大宗商品定价是否已从美国单锚转向中美双锚结构？
AI.motivation: 传统大宗商品定价文献长期以美国为中心的变量锚定黄金和原油价格，中国相关因素被系统性排除在可量化的定价框架之外，亟需检验中国因素的实际定价作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 滚动回归框架、方差膨胀因子（VIF）约束、LASSO正则化、Newey-West自相关一致性修正、多因子定价模型。
AI.method: 以756个交易日为窗口的滚动回归，对黄金462种因子组合和原油141种因子组合进行穷举测试，采用VIF<5约束筛选最优模型，辅以LASSO和新威-韦斯特修正进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）最优黄金模型（中美双锚三因子模型）包含TIPS实际收益率、中美10年期主权利差、金油比，全样本R²=0.814；（2）最优原油模型（中美双锚四因子模型）包含上海原油期货（SC）、VIX、合成时间价差、中美利差，全样本R²=0.889；（3）中美利差是唯一同时进入两个最优模型的因子；（4）SC因子所有滚动子期间100%正系数、零符号反转；（5）基于估值信号的策略夏普比率分别达1.66（黄金）和0.86（原油）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性证明中国因素对全球黄金和原油定价的量化解释力，提出大宗商品定价已从美国单锚结构演进为中美双锚结构的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供包含中国因子的黄金和原油估值模型，策略回测显示基于估值信号的交易策略能系统性改善风险调整后收益；揭示了上海原油期货上市对原油定价机制的结构性转变。

title: Cross-Border Digital Evidence and Data Sovereignty in Criminal Proceedings

detail.title: Cross-Border Digital Evidence and Data Sovereignty in Criminal Proceedings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: “The author declares no conflict of interest regarding the research, writing, or publication of this manuscript. This work was conducted independently, without financial or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the study.

detail.abstract: This study examines the structural and doctrinal tensions arising from cross-border digital evidence in contemporary criminal proceedings. As data is increasingly stored in distributed cloud infrastructures, territorial principles of jurisdiction are challenged by the transnational nature of information flows. The research analyzes how data sovereignty conflicts, platform-mediated access, and jurisdictional fragmentation affect evidentiary admissibility, chain of custody, and due process guarantees. Using a comparative and interdisciplinary framework integrating criminal procedure, cyberlaw, and transnational governance, the study identifies systemic asymmetries in access to digital evidence and proposes a harmonized admissibility model grounded in procedural safeguards, evidentiary reliability, and international cooperation. The findings support the hypothesis that structural sovereignty fragmentation-rather than isolated procedural deficiencies-constitutes the primary constraint on effective and fair use of digital evidence in criminal justice systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨境数字证据在刑事程序中引发的结构性冲突，指出主权碎片化（而非程序缺陷）是制约数字证据有效与公平使用的首要因素，并提出了基于程序保障、证据可靠性和国际合作的协调性可采性模型。
AI.research_question: 跨境数字证据如何挑战刑事司法中的领土管辖原则？主权碎片化如何影响证据可采性、保管链和正当程序保障？
AI.motivation: 随着数据越来越多地存储在分布式云基础设施中，传统领土管辖原则难以应对信息流动的跨国性，导致数据主权冲突、平台中介访问和管辖碎片化等问题，亟需系统分析并提出协调方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合刑事程序法、网络法和跨国治理理论的比较法与跨学科框架。
AI.method: 比较研究方法与跨学科分析框架，融合刑事程序、网络法与跨国治理理论。
AI.findings: 结构性主权碎片化（而非孤立程序缺陷）是制约数字证据在刑事司法中有效与公平使用的首要约束因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“主权碎片化作为首要约束”的理论命题，挑战将问题归咎于程序缺陷的传统认知；构建了协调性可采性模型，为跨境数字证据治理提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和司法实践者提供基于程序保障、证据可靠性和国际合作的协调性可采性模型，有助于改善跨境数字证据在刑事司法中的适用规则。

title:
Ghost Debt and the Mirage of Consumer Resilience: 
How Unregulated Shadow Credit is Hiding a Structural Consumer Credit Crisis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Ghost Debt and the Mirage of Consumer Resilience: 
How Unregulated Shadow Credit is Hiding a Structural Consumer Credit Crisis
detail.abstract: Standard measures of U.S. consumer financial health-payroll employment, aggregate creditcard delinquency rates, and headline confidence indices-present a surface stability that conceals a structural deterioration in household balance sheets. This paper identifies and maps a five-stage transmission mechanism linking employment-quality erosion to systemic credit risk: (1) the quality-versus-quantity divergence in labour-market data; (2) the exhaustion of COVID-era savings buffers; (3) the transition from discretionary to survival-mode borrowing; (4) the accumulation of "ghost debt" in unregulated Buy Now Pay Later and payday-loan channels invisible to credit bureaus; and (5) the transmission of household distress to Asset-Backed Securities markets via credit-card ABS. We argue that the BNPL/payday-loan complex constitutes a structural analogue to the 2006-2007 CDO opacity problem, with household leverage understated by an estimated USD 300-500 billion. The Tricolor Financial collapse (September 2025) is examined as a canary-event confirming the transmission risk. We conclude that the U.S. economy is experiencing a credit recession rather than a systemic crisis comparable to 2008, but that policy tools calibrated to visible credit data will systematically under-respond to the true stress level.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示美国消费者金融健康表面稳定（就业率、信用卡违约率、信心指数）背后隐藏的结构性恶化，提出一个五阶段传导机制，将就业质量恶化与系统性信用风险联系起来，并指出BNPL/发薪日贷款构成类似2006-2007年CDO不透明问题的结构性类比，家庭杠杆被低估约3000-5000亿美元。
AI.research_question: 美国消费者金融健康表面稳定背后是否存在结构性恶化？就业质量恶化如何通过隐蔽信贷渠道传导至系统性信用风险？
AI.motivation: 标准指标（就业率、信用卡违约率、信心指数）呈现表面稳定，但可能掩盖了家庭资产负债表的真实恶化，尤其是COVID-era储蓄耗尽后，隐蔽信贷渠道（BNPL、发薪日贷款）积累了大量未被征信机构记录的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五阶段传导机制：（1）就业质量与数量的分化；（2）COVID储蓄缓冲的耗尽；（3）从 discretionary 借贷转向生存模式借贷；（4）隐蔽渠道中"幽灵债务"的积累；（5）家庭困境通过信用卡ABS传导至资产支持证券市场。BNPL/发薪日贷款与2006-2007年CDO不透明问题的结构性类比。
AI.method: 理论分析与案例研究（Tricolor Financial 2025年9月倒闭事件作为验证性案例）。
AI.findings: 美国正经历信贷衰退而非2008年式的系统性危机；隐蔽信贷渠道使家庭杠杆被低估约3000-5000亿美元；Tricolor Financial的倒闭证实了传导风险的存在；基于可见信用数据校准的政策工具将系统性低估真实压力水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"幽灵债务"概念，建立就业质量恶化→隐蔽信贷→ABS市场传导的理论框架，揭示BNPL/发薪日贷款与2006-2007年CDO不透明问题的结构相似性。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者：基于表面稳定的标准指标将导致政策反应不足；呼吁加强对隐蔽信贷渠道的监管和数据透明度建设；为识别和防范新型系统性信用风险提供分析框架。

title: Time Poverty among Student Workers and its Impact on Health and Happiness in U.S. Universities
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley
