detail.title: Time Poverty among Student Workers and its Impact on Health and Happiness in U.S. Universities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no financial or personal relationships that could be viewed as presenting a conflict of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based solely on secondary data and previously published sources. No new data were collected from human participants, so institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: For many university students today, working a part-time job is no longer just a way to earn extra pocket money. It has quietly become a basic condition for paying tuition and rent. Because of rising college costs and the high price of living in many urban areas, students are working more hours than ever before. While employment can provide short-term financial stability, it often traps young adults in a state of “time poverty,” where almost no free time remains after paid work, classes, commuting, and basic self-care. Time poverty is linked to poorer grades, disrupted sleep, higher stress, and worsening mental health when weekly work hours climb above roughly fifteen to twenty hours. It also tends to deepen loneliness, since students who rush from class to work and back to homework have little time left to build friendships or participate in campus life. At the same time, existing labor laws and university rules rarely address the scheduling needs of student workers or protect them from unstable and excessive hours. This policy brief argues that time poverty among student workers is a serious but under-recognized threat to well-being and proposes several practical reforms. On campus, universities should limit work hours for student jobs, pay wages that allow students to rely on fewer jobs, and offer scheduling protections during midterm and final exam periods. Beyond campus, local governments and labor agencies should encourage more predictable, student-friendly schedules in off-campus workplaces. Together, these changes would help students regain free time, improve health, strengthen long-term academic and economic prospects, and deepen social connection, all without placing additional strain on the natural environment.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在学兼职工的学生正面临严重的“时间贫困”问题——工作时间过长导致几乎没有自由时间，进而损害学业、睡眠、心理健康和社交关系。文章建议大学和地方政府采取限制工时、提高工资、保障考试期间排班等改革措施。
AI.research_question: 高校学生兼职工的时间贫困问题如何影响其福祉，以及如何通过政策干预缓解这一问题？
AI.motivation: 大学学费和生活成本持续攀升，学生不得不增加工时以维持基本生活，但长时间工作导致的“时间贫困”对学业、健康、社交等多方面造成严重负面影响，而现有法律和大学政策未能有效保护学生兼职工，亟需关注和改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间贫困理论（Time Poverty）：个体在满足基本生存和必要活动后，几乎没有可自由支配的时间，从而损害整体福祉。
AI.method: 政策简报（Policy Brief），基于已有研究综述和逻辑论证提出改革建议。
AI.findings: 1. 每周工作超过15-20小时的学生兼职工面临时间贫困，表现为成绩下降、睡眠紊乱、压力升高、心理健康恶化、孤独感加深。2. 现有劳动法和大学规则未针对学生兼职工的排班需求提供保护。3. 提出校园和政府两个层面的政策改革方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将时间贫困理论应用于高校学生兼职工群体，系统论证了时间贫困对学业、心理、社交的多维负面影响，并指出了现有制度保护的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的、可操作的政策建议：校园层面限制学生工作工时、提高工资以减少兼职工数量、考试期间提供排班保护；政府层面推动校外雇主制定可预测且对学生友好的排班制度。

title: From Individual Consumers to Networked Response Clusters: How Digital Marketing Shapes Gen Z's Mental Health

detail.title: From Individual Consumers to Networked Response Clusters: How Digital Marketing Shapes Gen Z's Mental Health
detail.abstract:
Contemporary digital marketing has fundamentally altered the relationship between brands and Generation Z. This paper argues that prevailing frameworks that treat Gen Z as a conventional consumer segment-defined by individual cognition and deliberate decision-making-are structurally inadequate. Drawing on concepts from network theory, behavioural economics, and media psychology, the paper develops the construct of the Networked Response Cluster: a connected group whose consumption behaviour, emotional states, and identity signals are simultaneously activated by the same digital cue. 

The analysis proceeds through five interconnected propositions: 
(1) brands exercise asymmetric environmental power over Gen Z through algorithmic and content systems; 
(2) the classical need-want-demand sequence has been compressed into a cue-response loop; 
(3) social media operates as a contagion system, not merely a communication channel; 
(4) marketing stimuli reach mental health outcomes through identifiable psychological pathways; and 
(5) these outcomes-including anxiety, self-esteem pressure, compulsive checking, and emotional overload-are not incidental side-effects but central consequences of environment design. 

The paper concludes with strategic and ethical implications for brands, platforms, and policy actors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"网络化响应集群"（Networked Response Cluster）这一新构念，论证当代数字营销已从根本上改变了品牌与Z世代的关系，传统将Z世代视为常规消费者细分群体的框架已不再适用。文章通过五个相互关联的命题，揭示数字环境如何压缩消费决策过程、社交媒体如何成为情绪传染系统，以及营销刺激如何通过可识别的心理路径影响Z世代的心理健康。
AI.research_question: 当代数字营销如何重构品牌与Z世代的关系？传统的消费者行为框架为何不足以解释这一新现象？
AI.motivation: 基于网络理论、行为经济学和媒介心理学，提出"网络化响应集群"（Networked Response Cluster）概念，论证Z世代在网络环境中是一个被同一数字线索同时激活消费行为、情绪状态和身份信号的连接群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络理论、行为经济学、媒介心理学
AI.method: 概念性命题推导（五个相互关联的命题分析）
AI.findings: (1)品牌通过算法和内容系统对Z世代行使不对称的环境力量；(2)经典的需要-想要-需求序列被压缩为线索-响应环路；(3)社交媒体是感染系统而非沟通渠道；(4)营销刺激通过可识别的心理路径影响心理健康；(5)焦虑、自尊压力、强迫性查看和情绪过载等心理健康结果是环境设计的核心后果而非偶然副作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"网络化响应集群"新构念，挑战传统将Z世代视为基于个体认知和理性决策的消费者细分框架，揭示了数字营销环境下消费行为、情绪与身份认同的同步激活机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌、平台和政策制定者提供战略与伦理启示，指出营销设计的环境力量对Z世代心理健康具有核心而非附属的影响，呼吁重新审视数字营销的责任边界。

title:
Is Social Media Regulation asking the Wrong Question? 
Education Policy, Not Platform Policy, Explains Generational Vulnerability
affiliations: Gungri Research Lab

detail.title:
Is Social Media Regulation asking the Wrong Question? 
Education Policy, Not Platform Policy, Explains Generational Vulnerability
detail.abstract:
This paper argues that the social media debate is missing its most consequential variable: the systematic erosion of criteria-setting capacity from national curricula. While governments worldwide accelerate social media regulation targeting youth — Australia's minimum-age ban for users under 16, restrictions on school-based access in eleven U.S. states, the European Union's expanded youth provisions under the Digital Services Act — regulation without education reform addresses the symptom while leaving the cause untouched.

Following Jonathan Haidt's The Anxious Generation (2024), the dominant policy narrative frames social media as the primary cause of declining adolescent mental health. This paper challenges that narrative — not by disputing the correlation between social media use and mental health outcomes, but by arguing that the causal interpretation is incomplete. The more fundamental driver of generational vulnerability is the disappearance, from school curricula across multiple countries, of the subjects that cultivate the ability to form internal evaluative standards for judging external information: philosophy, ethics, logic, and moral reasoning.

Drawing on a comparative analysis of eleven countries (South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, Finland, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Australia, and the United States), this paper presents a 2x2 analytical framework mapping criteria-setting education (present/absent) against social pressure (high/low). The analysis identifies two distinct failure modes: Absence (South Korea, Taiwan); and Suppression (Japan, Singapore). Countries where criteria-setting education is present and social pressure is low — the Netherlands (5%) and Germany (11.1%) — show problematic-use rates approximately eightfold lower than those of the worst-performing Absence-quadrant cases (South Korea 40.1%, Taiwan 42.6%).

No country has yet produced causal evidence that social media regulation improves youth mental health outcomes. The paper argues that regulation without education reform is structurally incomplete: it addresses the symptom while leaving the cause untouched.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了社交媒体是青少年心理健康问题主要原因的主流叙事，提出更根本的驱动因素是各国学校课程中哲学、伦理、逻辑等"标准设定教育"的系统性缺失。通过对11国比较分析，该研究构建了2×2分析框架，发现标准设定教育缺失且社会压力高的国家（如韩国、台湾）青少年问题性使用率（40%+）是标准设定教育存在且社会压力低的国家（如荷兰5%、德国11.1%）的约8倍。论文主张，没有教育改革的社交媒体监管只是治标不治本。
AI.research_question: 青少年心理健康问题的根本原因是什么？是社交媒体本身，还是教育体系中批判性评价能力的培养缺失？
AI.motivation: 挑战当前以Jonathan Haidt《焦虑的一代》（2024）为代表的社交媒体监管主导政策叙事，指出该叙事忽略了教育变革这一关键变量。各国加速社交媒体监管（如澳大利亚16岁以下禁令、美国11州校园限制、欧盟《数字服务法》），但尚无一国提供因果证据证明监管改善了青少年心理健康。
AI.theoretical_framework: 2×2分析框架：横轴为标准设定教育（criteria-setting education）的存在与否（存在/缺失），纵轴为社会压力高低（高/低）。识别出两种失败模式：缺席型（标准设定教育缺失，如韩国、台湾）和压制型（标准设定教育存在但被压制，如日本、新加坡）。
AI.method: 11国比较分析：韩国、日本、台湾、新加坡、芬兰、法国、德国、荷兰、挪威、澳大利亚、美国。采用2×2分析框架，以问题性使用率作为因变量。
AI.findings: 标准设定教育存在且社会压力低的国家（荷兰5%、德国11.1%）的问题性使用率比标准设定教育缺失且社会压力高的国家（韩国40.1%、台湾42.6%）低约8倍。核心观点：社交媒体与心理健康的因果关系解读不完整，代际脆弱性的根本驱动因素是哲学、伦理、逻辑和道德推理等学科从多国课程中的消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了社交媒体作为青少年心理健康问题主因的主流因果叙事；2. 提出了"标准设定教育缺失"作为更根本的解释变量；3. 构建了区分"缺席型"和"压制型"两种失败模式的2×2分析框架；4. 揭示了"治标（监管）不治本（教育改革）"的政策结构性缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各国政策制定者提供实证依据：没有教育改革的社交媒体监管效果有限；2. 提供了具体可比较的11国案例，指出荷兰和德国作为正面范例；3. 建议将哲学、伦理、逻辑和道德推理学科重新纳入课程体系，以培养学生的内部评价标准。

detail.title: Analysis of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between UAE and Vietnam
detail.abstract: Analysis of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between the United Arab Emirates and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (UAE-Vietnam CEPA). Final Draft submitted towards the fulfilment of the assessment in International Trade Law.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿拉伯联合酋长国与越南社会主义共和国之间的全面经济伙伴关系协定（UAE-Vietnam CEPA），作为国际贸易法课程评估的最终草案提交。
AI.research_question: UAE-Vietnam CEPA的关键条款内容是什么？该协定对两国贸易、投资及法律框架有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着全球经济一体化深化，区域贸易协定日益重要。UAE与越南作为新兴经济体，其CEPA的签署对两国经贸关系及国际贸易法实践具有重要意义，值得深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运用国际贸易法理论，包括WTO规则框架、区域贸易协定（RTA）法律原则、关税减让与市场准入理论、原产地规则及争端解决机制等。
AI.method: 文本分析与法律解释方法，对CEPA协定条款进行系统性解读，结合比较法视角，参照其他区域贸易协定的实践经验。
AI.findings: 该CEPA涵盖了货物贸易、服务贸易、投资、知识产权、原产地规则、海关程序与贸易便利化、争端解决等多个领域。协定旨在降低或取消关税壁垒，扩大市场准入，促进双边投资流动，并为两国企业创造更稳定的法律环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于新兴经济体之间"南南型"区域贸易协定的研究，为国际贸易法中非传统贸易伙伴间的协定分析方法提供了案例参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、贸易从业者及法律实务者理解UAE-Vietnam CEPA的具体法律义务与商业机会提供了系统性分析，有助于两国企业利用协定条款优化贸易与投资策略。

title: Policy Brief: The Importance of Financial Literacy in Decreasing Debt in the United States by Implementation of Educational, and Economic Policies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Brief: The Importance of Financial Literacy in Decreasing Debt in the United States by Implementation of Educational, and Economic Policies
detail.abstract: Debt is constantly increasing in the United States, affecting many families and individuals. People accumulate debt due to credit cards, student loans, high interest financial services, limited policy on investment opportunities, and low financial literacy. Rising interest rates, economic inequality, and limited access to safe investment opportunities contribute to long-term financial instability. Debt not only impacts financial health but mental health as well. It can increase conditions such as anxiety, depression and stress 1. This is why it is crucially important to implement a number of policies to decrease the amount of debt individuals get. To reduce the debt many individuals in the United States face, this paper argues for a comprehensive policy approach that addresses both structural and educational causes of financial insecurity. The key proposals in this paper include: implementation of mandatory financial literacy curriculum, regulations on financial institutions, expansion of supportive student loan policies, and creating programs to improve financial health for low-income individuals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过强制金融素养教育、金融机构监管、扩大学生贷款支持政策以及改善低收入群体金融健康计划等综合政策，来减少美国日益严重的个人债务问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过综合政策手段减少美国个人债务负担？
AI.motivation: 美国债务持续增长，影响家庭和个人的财务健康与心理健康（焦虑、抑郁、压力），现有政策效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性因素（利率上升、经济不平等、投资机会受限）与教育因素（金融素养不足）共同导致债务累积的理论。
AI.method: 政策分析与论证，提出综合性政策建议框架。
AI.findings: 债务增加源于多种因素（信用卡、学生贷款、高息金融服务、投资机会有限、金融素养低）；债务损害财务与心理健康；综合政策（金融教育、监管、贷款政策、低收入群体支持）可有效降低债务。
AI.theory_contributions: 将债务问题的结构性原因与教育性原因整合分析，提出多维度政策干预的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体的政策建议：强制金融素养课程、金融机构监管、学生贷款政策改革、低收入群体金融健康计划。

title: Health Before Profit: Universal Healthcare access as a Foundation for Human Flourishing
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Health Before Profit: Universal Healthcare access as a Foundation for Human Flourishing
detail.abstract:
Health is the foundation that makes wealth, love, and happiness possible, and without access to affordable and effective healthcare, individuals face hurdles that extend far beyond physical illness, which affects their finances, relationships, and ability to live stable and fulfilling lives. In the United States, rising medical costs, unequal insurance access, and profit-driven healthcare structures create significant disparities in health outcomes, particularly for low-income communities, undocumented residents, and people of color. Fear of medical debt, lack of preventative care, and limited access to mental health services often cause individuals to delay treatment until conditions become severe and more expensive to manage.

This policy brief argues that healthcare should be treated as a public good rather than a market commodity. It proposes a transition toward value-based care models that prioritize patient outcomes over service volume, the implementation of federal caps on out-of-pocket costs for life-saving treatments, and the expansion of inclusive healthcare protections. Additionally, this brief recommends strengthening preventative care, mental health parity, and healthcare pricing transparency in order to reduce long-term healthcare costs and improve social well-being. By addressing healthcare inequities through structural reform, policymakers can strengthen not only public health outcomes but also the economic and emotional stability necessary for human flourishing.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份政策简报，论述美国应将医疗保健视为公共产品而非市场商品，并提出向价值导向医疗模式转型、设定联邦自付费用上限、扩大保护覆盖等改革建议，以解决医疗不平等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构性改革解决美国医疗体系中存在的可及性、公平性和成本问题？
AI.motivation: 美国医疗成本上升、保险覆盖不平等、利润驱动的医疗结构导致低收入群体、无证居民和有色人种在健康结果上存在显著差距，医疗债务恐惧和预防性护理缺失使问题恶化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗保健应被视为公共产品而非市场商品；价值导向医疗（Value-Based Care）理论。
AI.method: 政策简报（Policy Brief），基于现有证据的规范性政策分析。
AI.findings: 提出三项核心改革建议：（1）转向以患者结果而非服务量为中心的价值导向医疗；（2）对救命治疗实施联邦自付费用上限；（3）扩大包容性医疗保护覆盖。同时建议加强预防性护理、心理健康平等和医疗定价透明度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"医疗作为公共产品"的理论框架应用于美国具体医疗政策改革讨论，为非商品化医疗提供了操作性政策路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体可行的改革方案，包括价值导向支付、费用上限和透明度措施，旨在降低长期医疗成本并改善社会福祉。

title: Designing and Implementing an Organizational Cybersecurity Governance Training Program Based on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0: A Practitioner Curriculum Model

detail.title: Designing and Implementing an Organizational Cybersecurity Governance Training Program Based on the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0: A Practitioner Curriculum Model
detail.abstract: The National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework version 2.0 (NIST CSF 2.0), released in February 2024, represents the most significant revision to the framework since its original publication in 2014. A central feature of this revision is the formal elevation of Governance (GV) to a standalone, cross-cutting function-signaling a shift in industry expectations toward treating cybersecurity as an enterprise risk discipline rather than a purely technical domain. This working paper presents an original, practitioner-designed training curriculum comprising 26 structured sessions organized across eight thematic modules. The curriculum is designed to operationalize NIST CSF 2.0 at the organizational level through a train-the-trainer model, enabling internal practitioners to build durable cybersecurity governance competencies across functional roles-from executive leadership to operational personnel. The paper documents the curriculum architecture, instructional design rationale, learning objective framework, facilitation methodology, and assessment model. It positions cybersecurity governance training not as compliance overhead, but as a strategic organizational capability. The curriculum is designed to be institution-agnostic and applicable across government, regulated industries, healthcare, financial services, and higher education environments. This paper establishes the original authorship, design framework, and intellectual property of the curriculum as developed independently by the author. The model presented herein has not been derived from, commissioned by, or produced in any institutional capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文基于NIST CSF 2.0框架，提出了一套由26个课程模块组成的网络安全治理培训体系，采用"培训培训者"模式，旨在将网络安全从技术问题提升为企业风险治理能力，并适用于多种组织类型。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套可操作化的NIST CSF 2.0培训课程，使组织能够将网络安全治理从技术合规转变为战略能力？
AI.motivation: NIST CSF 2.0将治理（Governance）提升为独立的核心功能，标志着行业对网络安全定位的转变——从纯技术领域转向企业风险管理。然而，缺乏系统化的培训方案来落地这一新框架，现有培训多流于合规层面。
AI.theoretical_framework: NIST网络安全框架2.0（NIST CSF 2.0）；企业风险管理理论；培训培训者（Train-the-Trainer）模型；治理作为跨领域核心功能的定位。
AI.method: 实践者导向的课程设计方法，包含26个结构化课程、8个主题模块、学习目标框架、教学促进方法论及评估模型；课程设计独立完成，非机构产出。
AI.findings: 提出了一套完整的、机构无关的NIST CSF 2.0培训课程架构，涵盖治理（GV）功能向不同角色（从高管到运营人员）传导的路径，并建立了可复制的内部培训师培养机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将NIST CSF 2.0的治理理论从抽象框架转化为具体的、可操作的教学设计，丰富了网络安全治理落地的理论实践接口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、受监管行业、医疗、金融服务及高等教育等机构提供了即用型培训方案；通过培训培训者模式降低组织长期依赖外部专家的成本；将网络安全培训从合规负担重新定位为战略资产。

title: Prediction of heat transfer for film boiling of water on a vertical flat plate for a wide parametric condition using Artificial Neural Network
affiliations: , National Institute of Technology Agartala, Jadavpur University, Jadavpur University and Jadavpur University

detail.title: Prediction of heat transfer for film boiling of water on a vertical flat plate for a wide parametric condition using Artificial Neural Network
detail.abstract: In the present work two Artificial Neural Network based feed forward models are developed to predict the film boiling of heat transfer of water in a plate for a wide range of experimental data involving surface temperatures, water temperatures and flow velocities. The input non-dimensional variables used in the analysis are Jakob superheat number (Jasup) of surface, Jakob subcooling number (Jasub) of water, vapour Grashof number (Grv) and Reynolds number (Rel) of the water, while Nusselt number (Nu) is used as output. The analysis reveals that Bayesian Regularization Artificial Neural Network algorithm exhibits more accurate results over the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm for overall data, encompassing all the data range of both high and low superheat of the surface. The scale-based correlations method shows high MSE, increased MAPE, and some negative R2 values in multiple datasets, while the Artificial Neural Network model achieves low error metrics. The R2 values for overall tested data are significantly lower compared to Artificial Neural Network prediction, respectively. The results show that the data-driven Artificial Neural Network approach predicts film boiling heat transfer processes for various non-dimensional numbers.

AI.tldr: 本文基于人工神经网络（ANN）开发了两种前馈模型，用于预测水在板上的膜态沸腾传热，发现贝叶斯正则化算法优于Levenberg-Marquardt算法，且ANN模型整体预测精度显著高于传统的尺度相关方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工神经网络模型准确预测水在平板上的膜态沸腾传热过程？
AI.motivation: 膜态沸腾传热是一个复杂的热流体过程，传统基于尺度的相关性方法存在高均方误差（MSE）、高平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）甚至负R²值等问题，需要更精确的数据驱动方法来进行预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工神经网络（ANN）前馈模型；贝叶斯正则化算法（Bayesian Regularization）与Levenberg-Marquardt算法对比；输入无量纲变量包括雅各布过热数（Jasup）、雅各布过冷数（Jasub）、蒸汽格拉晓夫数（Grv）和水雷诺数（Rel），输出为努塞尔数（Nu）。
AI.method: 开发两种基于ANN的前馈模型，使用贝叶斯正则化算法和Levenberg-Marquardt算法进行训练和比较，引入表面温度、水温和流速等实验数据，以四个无量纲数为输入、努塞尔数为输出进行预测分析。
AI.findings: 贝叶斯正则化ANN算法在高低表面过热度的整个数据范围内均比Levenberg-Marquardt算法更精确；传统尺度相关方法显示出高MSE、高MAPE及部分负R²值，而ANN模型误差指标低；ANN模型的R²值显著高于传统方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了数据驱动的人工神经网络方法在膜态沸腾传热预测中的有效性，为传统传热相关性方法提供了替代方案，拓展了ANN在复杂热流体过程建模中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程实践中膜态沸腾传热的预测提供了更精确的数据驱动工具，有助于优化热交换器设计和核反应堆安全分析等涉及膜态沸腾的应用场景。

title: Gap Safe Screening Rules for Fast Training of Robust Support Vector Machines under Feature Noise
affiliations: Can Tho University, Can Tho University and Can Tho University

detail.title: Gap Safe Screening Rules for Fast Training of Robust Support Vector Machines under Feature Noise
detail.abstract: Robust Support Vector Machines (R-SVMs) address feature noise by adopting a worst-case robust formulation that explicitly incorporates uncertainty sets into training. While this robustness improves reliability, it also leads to increased computational cost. In this work, we develop safe sample screening rules for R-SVMs that reduce the training complexity without affecting the optimal solution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply safe screening techniques to worst-case robust models in supervised machine learning. Our approach safely identifies training samples whose uncertainty sets are guaranteed to lie entirely on either side of the margin hyperplane, thereby reducing the problem size and accelerating optimization. Owing to the nonstandard structure of R-SVMs, the proposed screening rules are derived from the Lagrangian duality rather than the Fenchel–Rockafellar duality commonly used in recent methods. Based on this analysis, we first establish an ideal screening rule, and then derive a practical rule by adapting GAP-based safe regions to the robust setting. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces training time while preserving classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出针对鲁棒支持向量机（R-SVM）的安全样本筛选规则，通过从拉格朗日对偶性推导筛选条件，在不影响最优解的前提下减少训练样本规模，从而显著降低计算成本。
AI.research_question: 如何在不影响最优解的前提下，降低鲁棒支持向量机（R-SVM）的训练复杂度？
AI.motivation: R-SVM通过引入不确定性集来增强对特征噪声的鲁棒性，但这种鲁棒性带来了更高的计算成本。现有安全筛选技术尚未应用于最坏情况鲁棒模型，亟需开发适用于R-SVM的高效筛选方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉格朗日对偶性（替代常见的Fenchel–Rockafellar对偶）、安全样本筛选规则、GAP安全区域
AI.method: 从拉格朗日对偶性推导理想筛选规则；基于GAP安全区域适应鲁棒场景，提出实用筛选规则；通过实验验证筛选效果与加速性能。
AI.findings: 提出的安全筛选方法能有效识别不确定性集完全位于间隔超平面一侧的训练样本，显著减少训练规模，在保持分类精度的同时大幅缩短训练时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将安全样本筛选技术应用于最坏情况鲁棒监督学习模型；为R-SVM这类非标准结构模型提供了基于拉格朗日对偶性的筛选规则推导框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出实用的GAP安全区域适应规则，显著降低R-SVM的训练计算开销，增强其在实际高维或大规模数据场景中的可用性。

title: Scalable Multi-Objective Graph Layout via Phase-wise Optimizations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Scalable Multi-Objective Graph Layout via Phase-wise Optimizations
detail.abstract: Graph layout is a core problem in graph visualization, aiming to produce readable and aesthetically pleasing layouts under multiple, often conflicting, aesthetic objectives. Existing methods, including learning-based approaches, commonly rely on weighted loss fusion, which often leads to optimization conflicts, unstable training, and high computational cost.In this work, we reformulate graph layout generation as a multi-objective optimization problem and propose a \emph{phase-wise multi-objective optimization} (PMO) approach. PMO decomposes multi-objective learning into sequential single-objective training phases, effectively mitigating gradient interference and stabilizing optimization.Based on PMO, we develop a GNN-based layout framework that achieves strong and well-balanced layout quality across multiple aesthetic targets while significantly reducing training time and computational resources. Furthermore, we show that the training cost scales linearly with the number of optimized objectives, demonstrating favorable model capacity and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于阶段式多目标优化（PMO）的图布局方法，将图布局生成重构为多目标优化问题，通过将多目标学习分解为顺序的单目标训练阶段，有效缓解了梯度冲突，在多个美学目标上实现了高质量且均衡的布局效果，同时大幅降低了训练时间和计算成本。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决图布局生成中多个（往往相互冲突的）美学目标之间的优化冲突问题，实现高质量、高效率的图布局生成？
AI.motivation: 现有图布局方法（包括基于学习的方法）通常依赖加权损失融合，这容易导致优化冲突、训练不稳定且计算成本高。需要一种新的方法来解决这些限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多目标优化理论；阶段式多目标优化（PMO）——将多目标学习分解为顺序的单目标训练阶段。
AI.method: 提出PMO方法，将多目标学习分解为顺序的单目标训练阶段；基于PMO开发GNN（图神经网络）布局框架。
AI.findings: PMO方法有效缓解了梯度干扰，稳定了优化过程；在多个美学目标上实现了强且均衡的布局质量；显著减少了训练时间和计算资源；训练成本随优化目标数量呈线性增长，展现出良好的模型容量和可扩展性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将图布局生成问题重新定义为多目标优化问题，并提出了PMO这一新的多目标优化学习范式，为处理多目标图布局提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了基于PMO的GNN布局框架，在提高布局质量的同时大幅降低了计算成本；训练成本线性增长的特性使其在实际应用中具有良好的可扩展性。

title:
Deliberation, Trust, and Preventive Public Investment 
A Theory and Cross-National Evidence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Deliberation, Trust, and Preventive Public Investment 
A Theory and Cross-National Evidence
detail.abstract: Iceland spends 1.9% of its GDP on early childhood education and care; Ireland spends 0.16%, one tenth of the Icelandic level, for two countries at similar income. Norway has 116 preventable deaths per 100 000; Hungary has 363, a threefold difference within the same European Union framework. Why do some societies invest substantially more than others in preventing social risks before they materialise? This paper develops a theoretical framework and provides cross-national empirical evidence linking the quality of deliberative institutions and interpersonal trust to preventive public investment. A threecohort overlapping-generations model with a public social capital stock and preferences interdependent in the manner of Becker (1974) delivers, under three monotonicity assumptions and no functional-form specification, a strict positive effect of trust and deliberation on the preventive allocation of discretionary public spending, through four distinct channels (altruistic and productive for trust; altruistic and long-horizon for deliberation). The central empirical result is a robust positive association between deliberative institutional quality and ECEC spending across 32 countries (β = +5.77, p < 0.001, R 2 = 0.54), surviving competition with the World Governance Indicators, exclusion of Nordic countries, controls for total welfare-state generosity, a permutation test, placebo outcomes, a 2015-2019 pre-COVID replication, and seven alternative aggregations of the deliberative index. Preventable mortality and the infrastructure gap are studied as cross-sectoral consistency checks; their results are directionally consistent with the theory. We discuss what cross-section can and cannot establish, present panel and difference-indifferences extensions including a within-country case study of Hungary, and outline a research programme on the endogenisation of trust and deliberation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了为什么不同社会在预防性公共投资（如早期儿童教育和可预防死亡率）上存在巨大差异，提出并验证了 deliberative institutions（协商制度）质量和人际信任对预防性支出有正向影响的理论框架。基于32个国家的跨国数据，发现协商制度质量与ECEC支出呈强正相关（β=+5.77, p<0.001, R²=0.54），并进行了多种稳健性检验。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些社会在预防社会风险（如早期儿童教育、可预防死亡率）上的公共投资明显高于其他社会？协商制度质量和人际信任如何影响预防性公共支出？
AI.motivation: 观察到冰岛与爱尔兰在早期儿童教育支出上的巨大差距（1.9% vs 0.16% GDP），以及挪威与匈牙利在可预防死亡率上的三倍差异（116 vs 363/100,000），这些现象在相似收入水平和同一制度框架内（如欧盟）仍存在，说明现有理论无法完全解释预防性投资差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Becker (1974)的 interdependent preferences（相互依赖偏好）理论，构建了一个三队列交叠世代模型（three-cohort OLG model），纳入社会公共资本存量，在三个单调性假设下无需函数形式设定，推导出信任和协商通过四个渠道（信任的利他渠道和产出渠道；协商的利他渠道和长视界渠道）正向影响预防性公共支出分配。
AI.method: 跨国截面回归分析（32个国家），使用协商制度质量指数和人际信任指标作为核心解释变量，以早期儿童教育支出（ECEC）占GDP比重为主要被解释变量。进行了多种稳健性检验：控制World Governance Indicators、排除北欧国家、控制福利国家总体慷慨度、置换检验、安慰剂检验、2015-2019年COVID前复制、七种协商指数替代聚合方式。还以可预防死亡率和基础设施缺口作为跨部门一致性检验，并进行了面板数据和双重差分拓展（包括匈牙利国内案例研究）。
AI.findings: 1) 协商制度质量与ECEC支出呈稳健正相关（β=+5.77, p<0.001, R²=0.54），该结果通过多种稳健性检验。2) 可预防死亡率和基础设施缺口的结果与理论方向一致。3) 讨论了截面分析的局限性，提供了面板和DID扩展证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次建立协商制度质量与预防性公共投资之间的理论链接。2) 提出信任和协商通过四个渠道（利他/产出/长视界）影响预防性支出的机制。3) 在不依赖具体函数形式假设下推导出严格的正向效应，增强了理论的普适性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了提升预防性投资的新视角——改善协商制度质量和培育社会信任。2) 解释了为什么单纯增加福利支出总量不足以解决预防性投资不足问题。3) 为跨国比较和国内政策改革（如匈牙利案例）提供了实证依据。

title: Structured Knowledge-Guided Self-Evolution for LLM Agents via Group Relative Policy Optimization
affiliations: Tsinghua University - Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University - Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Seoul National University and Harbin Institute of Petroleum

detail.title: Structured Knowledge-Guided Self-Evolution for LLM Agents via Group Relative Policy Optimization
detail.abstract: Large language model agents can solve increasingly complex tasks, but their behavior is still often governed by fixed prompts, manually designed rules, or external supervision. This makes adaptation costly when the environment changes. We formulate agent self-evolution as a structured policy learning problem and propose SEAF, a self-evolutionary framework that combines explicit knowledge updates with policy optimization. SEAF separates interaction into two stages: in-episode execution, where the agent uses retrieved experience and environment rules to choose actions, and post-episode evolution, where trajectories are distilled into structured knowledge and used to update the policy. The framework maintains two complementary knowledge stores: Environment Rules (ER), which capture causal constraints of the environment, and Strategy Memory (SM), which records successful heuristics and recurring failure patterns. To internalize these experiences, SEAF applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with weighted reward broadcasting, allowing sparse episode-level rewards to provide more informative step-level training signals. Experiments on logic games and the TravelPlanner benchmark show that SEAF improves both rule discovery and long-horizon planning, outperforming prompting baselines, automated agent methods, and vanilla GRPO on most evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: SEAF是一个让大语言模型智能体通过知识提取与策略优化实现自我进化的框架，在逻辑游戏和TravelPlanner基准测试中表现优于多种基线方法。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能让大语言模型智能体在没有外部监督的情况下，通过自身经验进行策略学习和自我进化的框架？
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体行为仍受限于固定提示、人工设计的规则或外部监督，在环境变化时适应成本高昂，缺乏自主学习与进化能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将智能体自我进化形式化为结构化策略学习问题，结合显式知识更新与策略优化（GRPO），采用两阶段交互机制（回合内执行与回合后进化），维护互补知识库（环境规则ER与策略记忆SM）。
AI.method: 提出SEAF框架：1）两阶段设计（回合内执行+回合后进化）；2）双知识库（环境规则ER+策略记忆SM）；3）使用带加权奖励广播的GRPO进行策略优化，将稀疏的回合级奖励转化为更密集的步骤级训练信号。
AI.findings: 在逻辑游戏和TravelPlanner基准测试中，SEAF在规则发现和长程规划方面均优于提示基线、自动化智能体方法和纯GRPO方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将智能体自我进化形式化为结构化策略学习问题，提出知识提取与策略优化相结合的进化框架，以及加权奖励广播机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了无需外部监督即可让LLM智能体自主适应环境变化的实用框架，改善了长程规划任务的表现。

title: Turkey's Role in Critical Minerals Trade Under Geopolitical Risk: Evidence from Boron and Chromite Bilateral Flows (2000–2024)
affiliations: Istanbul Technical University

detail.title: Turkey's Role in Critical Minerals Trade Under Geopolitical Risk: Evidence from Boron and Chromite Bilateral Flows (2000–2024)
detail.abstract: Turkey holds approximately 73% of global proven boron reserves and consistently ranks among the world's top three chromite producers. Drawing on the BACI bilateral trade panel (V202601, 2000–2024), the Caldara–Iacoviello geopolitical risk (GPR) index, and CEPII gravity controls, this paper estimates the response of Turkey's bilateral exports across eleven HS6 codes — natural borates, refined borates, boric acids, chromite ore, and ferrochromium — to global and destination-specific GPR shocks. Pseudo-Poisson Maximum Likelihood gravity estimation with destination-year and destination-product fixed effects identifies four findings. First, raw chromite ore is robustly exposed to global GPR (elasticity ≈ −1.0, p < 0.001) with the effect transmitted principally through the China channel, which absorbs 42.6% of cumulative export value across the eleven HS6 codes. Second, the GPR–trade relationship operates through different sub-indices for raw and refined products: chromite ore responds to anticipatory threats (GPRT coefficient −1.25, p < 0.001) while ferrochromium responds to realized acts (GPRA coefficient −0.47, p < 0.01), an asymmetry that maps onto the operational structure of long-cycle raw-material logistics versus contract-cycle refined-product trade. Third, the chromite-ore–GPR relationship inverts in the post-2014 period, consistent with strategic stockpiling responses by Chinese and emerging-market buyers during elevated-risk episodes. Fourth, partner concentration is structural rather than GPR-driven — chromite ore HHI rose from 1,920 in 2000 to a peak of 8,385 in 2013, while ferrochromium HHI declined throughout. The contrast between Eti Maden's vertically integrated boron operations and the bifurcated chromium sector quantifies the policy stake: vertical integration into refined products operates as a geopolitical hedge.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2000-2024年贸易面板数据，估计了土耳其战略性矿产（硼及铬产品）出口对地缘政治风险（GPR）冲击的响应，发现铬矿出口对全球GPR弹性约为-1.0，且原材料与精炼产品对GPR不同子指标反应不对称，垂直整合可成为地缘政治对冲工具。
AI.research_question: 土耳其战略性矿产（硼和铬产品）的双边出口如何响应全球及目的地特定的地缘政治风险冲击？
AI.motivation: 土耳其拥有全球73%的硼储量和世界前三的铬矿产量，其战略性矿产出口在地缘政治风险下的表现对资源安全与产业政策至关重要，但相关实证研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引力模型（gravity model）、地缘政治风险（GPR）指数、供应链风险管理理论、垂直整合理论
AI.method: 伪泊松最大似然（PPML）引力估计，包含目的地-年份和目的地-产品固定效应；BACI双边贸易数据（2000-2024）、Caldara-Iacoviello GPR指数、CEPII引力控制变量。
AI.findings: （1）铬矿对全球GPR弹性约-1.0，主要通过中国渠道传导；（2）铬矿对威胁预期（GPRT）敏感，而铬铁对已发生行为（GPRA）敏感，反映原材料物流与合约产品贸易的不同操作结构；（3）2014年后铬矿-GPR关系反转，源于中国等新兴市场买家的战略囤货；（4）合作伙伴集中度是结构性的而非GPR驱动；（5）垂直整合到精炼产品可作为地缘政治对冲。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了GPR对原材料与精炼产品的差异化传导机制（威胁预期vs.已实现行为），并发现GPR-贸易关系在特定时期可能反转（战略性囤货效应）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其及其他资源国提供政策启示：垂直整合精炼产品可降低地缘政治风险暴露；为中国等进口国的战略储备行为提供了实证依据；为矿业企业供应链风险管理提供参考。

title: Handover-Risk-Cue-Assisted Discrete A3 Control for Low-Mobility Multi-Cell Networks
affiliations: Shenyang University of Technology, Shenyang University of Technology, Shenyang University of Technology, Shenyang University of Technology, Taylor's University, Shenyang University of Technology, Shenyang University of Technology, Shenyang University of Technology and Shenyang University of Technology

detail.title: Handover-Risk-Cue-Assisted Discrete A3 Control for Low-Mobility Multi-Cell Networks
detail.abstract: Adaptive A3 handover control in multi-cell networks must respond to degrading serving links while avoiding ping-pong instability. This paper presents a handover-risk-cue-assisted discrete A3 controller that augments the reinforcement-learning state with a history-conditioned handover-risk cue and jointly selects time-to-trigger (TTT) and handover margin (HOM) from a 63-action operator-configurable grid. The design also incorporates weak-coverage forced handover (WCFH) as a safeguard for persistently weak serving links that remain outside standard A3 activation. The framework is evaluated through an ns-3.38 simulation procedure over a 5 km×5 km multi-cell grid with 25 base stations and low-mobility trajectories at 1 m/s, 3 m/s, 6 m/s. Relative to a fixed-threshold A3 baseline, the safeguarded cue-assisted value controller reduces completed-event ping-pong handover and post-handover radio-link-failure rates, and improves average post-handover RSRP gain by about 3.9–5.0 dB in the 3 m/s and 6 m/s cases; the 1 m/s case is retained as a low-opportunity boundary. Additional comparisons with DDQN, D3QN, and categorical PPO show that the cue-assisted design provides favorable completed-event behavior in the evaluated discrete-action setting, while its effect depends on the DRL backbone and event denominator. Cue-provider analysis supports CatBoost as the integrated learned probabilistic cue interface, and trigger-level diagnostics show that WCFH shifts control exposure toward weak-coverage intervention opportunities. These results demonstrate a controlled and reproducible discrete A3 control framework for low-mobility multi-cell handover optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于切换风险线索辅助的离散A3切换控制器，通过强化学习状态增强和历史条件风险线索，在63动作空间中联合选择TTT和HOM，并引入弱覆盖强制切换机制。在ns-3仿真中，相比固定阈值基线，该框架在低移动性多小区网络中降低了乒乓切换和无线链路失败率，提升了切换后RSRP增益约3.9–5.0 dB。
AI.research_question: 如何在多小区网络中设计一种自适应A3切换控制方法，既能及时响应服务链路恶化，又能避免乒乓切换不稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统固定阈值的A3切换控制难以在切换响应及时性与乒乓切换稳定性之间取得良好平衡，尤其是在低移动性场景下，需要一种更智能、可调控的自适应切换控制框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习（RL）状态增强、历史条件切换风险线索（handover-risk cue）、离散A3控制器、弱覆盖强制切换（WCFH）、CatBoost概率线索接口
AI.method: 在ns-3.38仿真环境中，构建5 km×5 km多小区网格（25个基站），采用低移动性轨迹（1 m/s、3 m/s、6 m/s），将TTT和HOM离散化为63个动作，通过强化学习联合选择，并集成WCFH保护机制。与固定阈值基线及DDQN、D3QN、分类PPO等方法对比评估。
AI.findings: 1) 相比固定阈值基线，所提方法降低了已完成事件的乒乓切换率和切换后无线链路失败率；2) 在3 m/s和6 m/s场景下，平均切换后RSRP增益提升约3.9–5.0 dB；3) 与DDQN、D3QN、分类PPO相比，该线索辅助设计在离散动作设置下表现出更优的已完成事件行为；4) CatBoost作为集成学习概率线索接口表现支持良好；5) WCFH将控制暴露转向弱覆盖干预机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了切换风险线索增强的强化学习状态表示方法，将历史条件风险信号融入离散A3控制决策，为多小区切换优化提供了新的理论框架设计思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低移动性多小区网络提供了一种可控、可复现的离散A3切换优化控制框架，可有效降低乒乓切换和链路失败率，提升切换后信号质量，具有实际部署参考价值。

title: Hierarchical Laplacian Convolutional Neural Solver for Nonlinear Mechanical Response Prediction
affiliations: Central South University and Arizona State University (ASU) - School for Engineering of Matter, Transport, and Energy

detail.title: Hierarchical Laplacian Convolutional Neural Solver for Nonlinear Mechanical Response Prediction
detail.abstract: This paper presents a Hierarchical Laplacian Convolutional Neural Solver (HL-CNS), a physics-guided neural multigrid framework for predicting nonlinear mechanical responses. The proposed approach embeds the error-correction pathway of a multigrid V-cycle directly into a learnable neural architecture, while representing the underlying differential operator through a data-adaptive Laplacian kernel. Residual-based neural networks are used to model solution updates, replacing conventional iterative smoothers with learned corrections. The framework is evaluated on 2-D and 3-D thermal diffusion problems with temperature-dependent conductivity, as well as 3-D linear elasticity and bilinear elasto-plasticity. Across these benchmarks, HL-CNS achieves accurate and consistent predictions in both linear and nonlinear regimes, and compares favorably with representative neural architectures, including ResNet, FCN, U-Net, and DeepONet. In nonlinear elasto-plastic cases, HL-CNS reduces inference cost by several orders of magnitude relative to conventional finite-element solvers, as predictions are obtained through a single fixed-depth forward pass without requiring iterative constitutive updates. These results demonstrate that embedding multigrid-inspired hierarchical structure and residual-based correction into neural architecture provides an effective and scalable approach for surrogate modeling of complex PDE systems. The proposed framework is particularly well-suited for many-query scenarios, such as parametric analysis, uncertainty quantification, and real-time prediction, where fixed-cost inference is critical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层拉普拉斯卷积神经求解器（HL-CNS），这是一个物理引导的神经多重网格框架，用于预测非线性力学响应。该方法将多重网格V循环的误差校正路径嵌入可学习的神经架构中，并通过数据自适应拉普拉斯核表示底层微分算子。在二维和三维热扩散、线弹性及双线性弹塑性问题中，HL-CNS在线性和非线性领域均取得准确一致的预测结果，并在弹塑性案例中相比传统有限元求解器将推理成本降低了数个数量级。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种物理引导的神经架构，使其能够高效、准确地预测非线性力学响应（包括热扩散、线弹性和弹塑性问题）？
AI.motivation: 传统有限元求解器在弹塑性等非线性问题中计算成本极高，而现有神经网络代理模型在精度和泛化能力上仍存在不足。受多重网格方法高效性的启发，研究者希望将多重网格的层次化结构和误差校正思想嵌入神经网络，以构建兼具物理可解释性和计算效率的求解器。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 多重网格V-cycle理论（误差校正通路）；2) 拉普拉斯卷积核（数据自适应表示微分算子）；3) 残差神经网络（Residual-based neural networks，用于建模解更新替代传统迭代平滑器）；4) 物理引导的神经代理建模（Physics-guided neural surrogate modeling）。
AI.method: 提出HL-CNS框架，将多重网格V-cycle的误差校正通路嵌入可学习的神经架构，使用数据自适应拉普拉斯核表示微分算子，并通过残差神经网络建模解更新。在2-D/3-D热扩散（温度相关热导率）、3-D线弹性及双线性弹塑性问题上进行验证，与ResNet、FCN、U-Net、DeepONet等架构对比。
AI.findings: 1) HL-CNS在线性和非线性问题中均实现准确一致的预测，优于对比的神经架构；2) 在非线性弹塑性案例中，推理成本相比传统有限元求解器降低数个数量级（单次固定深度前向传播，无需迭代本构更新）；3) 嵌入多重网格启发的层次化结构和残差校正是一种有效且可扩展的复杂PDE系统代理建模方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将多重网格V-cycle的误差校正通路以可学习形式嵌入神经架构，为物理引导的神经求解器提供了新范式；2) 提出数据自适应拉普拉斯核表示微分算子，增强了网络对物理规律的表达能力；3) 将残差神经网络与多重网格层次化结构融合，拓展了神经代理建模的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为参数分析、不确定性量化和实时预测等需要固定成本推理的多查询场景提供了高效工具；2) 在非线性弹塑性问题中将推理成本降低数个数量级，有望替代传统有限元方法用于工程快速评估；3) 提出的框架具有可扩展性，可推广至其他复杂PDE系统。

title: A Wave-driven Dual-stream Transformer (WDT) model for long-term motion intelligent prediction of 15MW FOWTs under freak waves
affiliations: Tianjin University, Tianjin University, Tianjin University, Tianjin University, Tianjin University, Tianjin University, Tianjin University and Tianjin University

detail.title: A Wave-driven Dual-stream Transformer (WDT) model for long-term motion intelligent prediction of 15MW FOWTs under freak waves
detail.abstract: Accurate long-term response prediction of floating offshore wind turbines (FOWTs) under extreme wave conditions is critical for structural safety assessment, yet remains challenging due to the non-Gaussian, heavy-tailed characteristics induced by freak wave events. This study proposes the Wave-driven Dual-stream Transformer (WDT), an intelligent prediction framework that incorporates future wave surface elevation as anticipatory input. The model processes 60 s historical motion and wave records through a multi-scale CNN and dual Transformer encoder, while a dedicated wave encoder simultaneously encodes a 200 s future wave sequence. A cross-attention decoder fuses both representations, allowing each future time step to query historical states and retrieve dynamics relevant to forthcoming wave forcing. The model is trained on 36 simulation realizations of a 15 MW FOWT on the VolturnUS-S semi-submersible platform under combined turbulent wind and freak wave excitation, and evaluated on 4 independent held-out realizations. Results demonstrate global R² of 0.8789–0.9302 over a 200 s horizon, with freak wave region R² exceeding 0.91 in three of four test groups and inference time below 0.06 s. Under severe dual-channel noise conditions (k=0.15), global R² remains above 0.83, confirming robustness and computational efficiency for offshore wind engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 提出Wave-driven Dual-stream Transformer (WDT)模型，利用未来波浪高程信息预测浮式海上风机在极端波浪条件下的长期响应，在200秒预测窗口内实现高精度（R²达0.93）和强鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习模型融合未来波浪信息，实现浮式海上风机在极端波浪（畸形波）条件下准确的长期响应预测？
AI.motivation: 极端波浪条件下浮式海上风机的长期响应具有非高斯、重尾特征，传统方法难以准确预测，而准确的长期响应预测对结构安全评估至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wave-driven Dual-stream Transformer (WDT)；多尺度CNN；双Transformer编码器；交叉注意力解码器；未来波浪高程编码
AI.method: 基于36次15MW浮式风机在湍流风和畸形波激励下的仿真数据训练模型，在4次独立保留的仿真数据上评估，使用R²和噪声鲁棒性测试。
AI.findings: 200秒预测窗口内全局R²为0.8789-0.9302；畸形波区域R²超0.91；高噪声条件下(k=0.15)全局R²仍超0.83；推理时间低于0.06秒。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将未来波浪序列作为可学习的先验输入引入浮式风机响应预测，提出双流Transformer架构实现历史-未来信息的跨注意力融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为浮式海上风机在极端海况下的结构安全评估提供了一种高精度、强鲁棒且计算高效的智能预测方法，推理速度满足实时应用需求。

title: Multi-dimensional driving mechanisms and causal effects of urban heat island intensity in Chinese cities based on a block-LCZ framework
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Tianjin Chengjian University and Tianjin Chengjian University

detail.title: Multi-dimensional driving mechanisms and causal effects of urban heat island intensity in Chinese cities based on a block-LCZ framework
detail.abstract: As urbanization accelerates, the Urban Heat Island (UHI) effect continues to intensify, posing a serious threat to the human settlement environment and urban sustainable development. However, existing methods for quantifying Urban Heat Island Intensity (UHII) in multi-city studies struggle to balance the morphological heterogeneity within cities with cross-city comparability. Furthermore, analyses of driving mechanisms often rely on statistical correlations rather than causal inferences, limiting the effective translation of research findings into the basis for planning interventions. This study examines 150 Chinese cities of varying sizes, constructing a block-Local Climate Zone (LCZ) spatial analysis framework to quantify summer surface UHII. By integrating 22 multidimensional influencing factors, the study jointly employs XGBoost-SHAP machine learning and Double Machine Learning (DML) causal inference approaches to systematically analyze the driving mechanisms and mitigation strategies of UHII at both global and local scales. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) The average UHII across the 150 cities is 1.73°C, with megacities exhibiting the highest and most stable UHII; (2) The Green spaces and Water bodies Ratio (GWR) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) rank among the most important factors in both global and local models, while the local contribution of urban morphological factors increases significantly with city size; (3) The cooling effect of GWR is the most pronounced; Building Density (BD) exhibits a significant warming effect that is strongest in small cities; the causal direction of the Sky View Factor (SVF) reverses with city size—warming in megacities and cooling in small cities; (4) Machine learning and causal inference exhibit systematic discrepancies regarding variables such as Aggregation Index (AI) and Tree Height (TH), revealing the potential pitfalls of interpreting policy based solely on feature importance. The study’s findings provide empirical evidence at the causal level for formulating differentiated heat mitigation strategies tailored to cities of different sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文基于150个中国城市数据，构建街区-局地气候区空间分析框架，结合XGBoost-SHAP机器学习和双重机器学习因果推断方法，系统分析了城市规模差异下地表城市热岛强度的驱动机制与缓解策略，发现绿水和植被覆盖率降温效应最强，建筑密度增温效应在小城市最显著，天空视角因子的因果方向随城市规模发生逆转。
AI.research_question: 多城市研究中如何平衡城市内部形态异质性与跨城市可比性？不同规模城市地表城市热岛强度（UHII）的驱动机制和因果效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 城市化加速导致热岛效应加剧，威胁人居环境与可持续发展；现有量化方法难以兼顾城市内部异质性与跨城市可比性，且驱动机制分析多依赖统计相关而非因果推断，限制了研究成果向规划干预的转化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 局地气候区（LCZ）理论、城市热岛效应理论、城市形态与热环境相互作用理论
AI.method: 构建街区-LCZ空间分析框架量化150个中国城市夏季地表UHII；整合22个多维影响因素；联合运用XGBoost-SHAP机器学习（全局与局部特征重要性分析）和双重机器学习（Double Machine Learning）因果推断方法。
AI.findings: (1) 150个城市平均UHII为1.73°C，超大城市最高且最稳定；(2) 绿水和植被覆盖率（GWR）与归一化植被指数（NDVI）是全局和局部模型中最重要的因子，城市形态因子的局部贡献随城市规模显著增加；(3) GWR降温效应最强；建筑密度（BD）增温效应在小城市最显著；天空视角因子（SVF）的因果方向随城市规模逆转（超大城市中增温，小城市中降温）；(4) 机器学习和因果推断在聚集指数（AI）和树高（TH）等变量上存在系统性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了城市规模对热岛效应驱动机制的结构性调节作用，发现了天空视角因子因果方向随城市规模逆转的非线性机制，为城市形态与热环境关系的理论补充了因果层面的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同规模城市制定差异化热缓解策略提供了因果层面的实证依据；指出了仅依赖特征重要性（如SHAP）进行政策解释的潜在陷阱，强调了因果推断在规划决策中的必要性。

title: Paid Annual Leave and Part-Time Employment: A Cross-Country Analysis
affiliations: University of Granada, University of Girona - Department of Economics and University of Girona

detail.title: Paid Annual Leave and Part-Time Employment: A Cross-Country Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper examines how statutory paid annual leave influences overall employment and the distribution of work between part-time and full-time jobs. Using a search-and-matching model with two job types, the authors show that paid leave creates higher disruption costs for firms employing full-time workers, while benefiting workers through additional utility. As a result, paid leave increases the attractiveness of part-time jobs and shifts employment toward shorter-hour contracts. Using World Bank panel data from 2005–2019, the study finds strong evidence that more generous paid leave raises the share of part-time employment. However, its effect on aggregate employment is weak and statistically insignificant once fixed effects are included.

AI.tldr: 本文通过搜索匹配模型和跨国面板数据，发现法定带薪年假会提高兼职就业占比，但对总体就业影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 法定带薪年假如何影响总体就业以及全职与兼职工作之间的劳动分配？
AI.motivation: 带薪年假政策在全球范围内日益普及，但其对劳动力市场结构（尤其是兼职与全职就业分布）的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建包含两种工作类型（全职与兼职）的搜索匹配模型，分析带薪年假对企业的中断成本和工人效用的差异化影响。
AI.method: 理论模型（搜索匹配模型）+ 实证分析（2005–2019年世界银行面板数据，包含固定效应回归）。
AI.findings: 带薪年假使企业对全职员工产生更高的中断成本，同时增加工人效用，从而提升兼职岗位的吸引力，推动就业向短工时合同转移；面板数据证实带薪年假增加了兼职就业占比，但对总体就业影响微弱且不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将带薪休假制度纳入搜索匹配框架，揭示了休假政策通过"中断成本"渠道影响企业用工结构选择的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了带薪年假政策对就业结构影响的实证证据，提示需要关注休假制度可能带来的兼职就业扩张效应。

title: SMU-ARF: A state memory unit augmented recurrent forecaster for long-term prediction of dynamical systems
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Zhejiang University, Hefei University of Technology, Zhejiang University, Hefei University of Technology and Zhejiang University

detail.title: SMU-ARF: A state memory unit augmented recurrent forecaster for long-term prediction of dynamical systems
detail.abstract: Accurate long-term prediction of nonlinear, time-dependent partial differential equation (PDE) systems with complex boundary conditions remains challenging, as small errors can quickly amplify and destabilize forecasts. Numerical solvers suffer from discretization constraints, high computational cost, and cumulative long-horizon errors, while neural network models often struggle to maintain physical consistency, especially with sparse data. In this work, we introduce the state memory unit augmented recurrent forecaster (SMU-ARF), a memory-enhanced recurrent framework designed for stable and accurate spatiotemporal prediction in fluid dynamics. By maintaining both cell and hidden states, SMU-ARF effectively captures complex spatiotemporal dependencies while mitigating error accumulation. A one-shot dimensionality expansion strategy combined with boundary padding enables efficient treatment of complex boundaries and preserves physical fidelity. A hybrid training scheme that integrates teacher forcing for stable gradients with autoregressive prediction for deployment consistency improves convergence and generalization. Experiments on representative systems including two-dimensional harmonic oscillators, the two-dimensional Burgers equation, and unsteady wing flows demonstrate that SMU-ARF achieves longer prediction horizons, slower error growth, and higher physical consistency than competing baseline models, such as physics informed neural networks (PINNs), gated recurrent unit (GRU), predictive recurrent neural networks (PredRNNs), and convolutional gated recurrent unit (ConvGRU).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种状态记忆单元增强的循环预测器（SMU-ARF），通过记忆增强的循环框架、一次性维度扩展策略和混合训练方案，实现了对流体动力学中非线性、时变偏微分方程系统的稳定且准确的长期时空预测，在多个基准系统上优于PINNs、GRU、PredRNN和ConvGRU等基线模型。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持物理一致性的前提下，对具有复杂边界条件的非线性、时变偏微分方程系统实现准确的长时程预测？
AI.motivation: 传统数值求解器受离散化约束、计算成本高且存在累积长程误差；神经网络模型在稀疏数据下难以保持物理一致性。现有方法在长时程稳定预测方面均存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态记忆单元增强的循环神经网络（RNN）框架、教师强制与自回归预测相结合的混合训练策略、一次性维度扩展与边界填充技术。
AI.method: 提出SMU-ARF模型：(1) 采用记忆增强的循环架构，同时维护细胞状态和隐藏状态以捕捉复杂时空依赖并缓解误差累积；(2) 一次性维度扩展策略结合边界填充处理复杂边界；(3) 混合训练方案融合教师强制（稳定梯度）与自回归预测（部署一致性）。
AI.findings: 在二维谐振子、二维Burgers方程和非定常机翼流动三个代表性系统上，SMU-ARF实现了更长的预测时域、更慢的误差增长和更高的物理一致性，优于PINNs、GRU、PredRNN和ConvGRU等对比模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的记忆增强循环预测框架，有效解决了长时间序列预测中的误差累积问题，并为复杂边界条件下的物理场预测提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为流体动力学中的长期时空预测提供了一种高效、稳定且物理一致的实用工具，可应用于工程中的非定常流动预测等场景。

title: Is X-Minute City Accessibility Associated with Mode-Specific Travel Behavior? District-Level Evidence from Munich
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: Is X-Minute City Accessibility Associated with Mode-Specific Travel Behavior? District-Level Evidence from Munich
detail.abstract: The X-minute city is built on the idea that proximity to essential daily destinations should support more sustainable travel and improve urban livability, yet this behavioral claim has rarely been tested directly with observed mobility data at the city district level. This paper addresses that gap by providing the first empirical test of whether X-minute city accessibility conditions are associated with modal split across walking, cycling, public transport and car use in Munich’s 25 administrative districts. It does so using the city’s district-level travel survey data, allowing accessibility to be linked not just to where opportunities are located, but to how residents actually travel. Accessibility is measured using Geo Open Accessibility Tool indicators, including mean travel times and 15-minute reachability coverage across six destination categories. These measures are then combined with district-level modal sharesfrom the 2023 System of Representative Transport Surveys. Using Spearman rank correlations and population-weighted regression models, the paper shows that accessibility is strongly associated with walking and car use, with destination proximity alone explaining over 85% of the variance in both modes. Cycling shows a weaker but statistically significant relationship, while public transport shares are not significantly related to proximity-based accessibility to public transport stations, suggesting that network connectivity and service frequency are more important for that mode. Overall, the findings provide district-scale empirical evidence for the behavioral patterns of the X-minute city across transport modes, while showing that explanatory power differs substantially between them.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用慕尼黑25个行政区的实际出行调查数据，实证检验了X分钟城市可达性条件与不同交通方式（步行、骑行、公共交通、汽车）出行分担率之间的关系。研究发现，目的地可达性对步行和汽车出行解释力超过85%，对骑行影响较弱但显著，而对公共交通出行无显著影响，表明网络连通性和服务频率对公交模式更为重要。
AI.research_question: X分钟城市的可达性条件是否与不同交通方式（步行、骑行、公共交通、汽车）的出行分担率存在关联？
AI.motivation: X分钟城市理念被广泛认为能促进可持续出行和提升城市宜居性，但这一行为主张从未在城区层面的实际出行数据中得到直接实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: X分钟城市理论、可达性理论、出行行为理论、邻近性与模式选择理论
AI.method: 使用Geo Open Accessibility Tool计算六个目的地类别的平均出行时间和15分钟可达覆盖率；结合2023年代表性交通调查的区级出行分担率数据；采用Spearman秩相关和人口加权回归模型进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）可达性对步行和汽车出行分担率解释力极强（>85%方差）；（2）骑行与可达性关系较弱但统计显著；（3）公共交通出行分担率与基于邻近性的公交可达性无显著关系，网络连通性和服务频率更关键；（4）不同交通方式的可达性解释力存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在城市行政区层面使用实际出行数据直接验证X分钟城市的出行行为主张，揭示了不同交通方式对可达性敏感度的差异性，为X分钟城市理论提供了基于实证的行为证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了量化依据：推动步行和减少汽车使用可通过优化目的地邻近性实现，而提升公共交通分担率需关注网络连通性和服务频率而非仅邻近性。

title: Finance Minister Educational Quality and Economic Growth
affiliations: Essex Finance Centre, Essex Business School, University of Essex and Department of Economics

detail.title: Finance Minister Educational Quality and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine the impact of finance minister’s educational quality on economic growth, using a comprehensive dataset of 584 finance ministers from 33 countries, spanning the period from 1926 to 2015. We use formal education level, particularly the attainment of a PhD in economics, as a proxy for educational quality to assess how variation in finance minister’s education influences economic performance in advanced versus emerging/developing economies. In the empirical analysis we find that although emerging/developing economies have a disproportionately larger share of finance ministers with a PhD in economics, we find that the impact of finance minister’s educational quality is statistically significant only in advanced economies. We also find that the growth effects of advanced economic training are conditional on institutional quality, with weaker institutional environments substantially diminishing these benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文利用33个国家584位财政部长的面板数据（1926-2015年），发现财长教育质量（以经济学博士学位衡量）仅对发达经济体有显著增长效应，且该效应依赖于制度质量，在制度环境较弱时大幅减弱。
AI.research_question: 财政部长的教育质量如何影响经济增长？这种影响在发达经济体与新兴/发展中经济体之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注领导人特征对经济绩效的影响，但鲜有研究聚焦于"财长"这一关键经济决策者的教育背景，尤其是其经济学专业训练对宏观经济表现的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、制度经济学（制度质量调节人力资本回报）、领导人与经济增长的关系理论。
AI.method: 采用33个国家584位财长的面板数据（1926-2015年），以是否拥有经济学博士学位作为教育质量的代理变量，进行跨国实证回归分析，并引入制度质量的交互项。
AI.findings: 1）新兴/发展中经济体拥有经济学博士学位的财长比例反而更高；2）财长教育质量仅对发达经济体的经济增长有显著正向影响；3）该正向效应依赖于制度质量，弱制度环境会大幅削弱经济学训练的增长红利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"领导人特征—经济增长"的研究从一般国家领导人延伸到具体部门官员（财长），并揭示了制度质量对人力资本回报的调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示新兴/发展中经济体在选拔高学历财长时，需同步加强制度建设，否则高端经济学人才可能无法有效转化为经济绩效。

title: Spatial Justice and Failed Urban Transitions: Analyzing Push-Pull Dynamics Between Fayoum and New Fayoum, Egypt
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Spatial Justice and Failed Urban Transitions: Analyzing Push-Pull Dynamics Between Fayoum and New Fayoum, Egypt
detail.abstract: There are important spatial justice issues to consider in Egyptian territories, both in terms of allocating resources equitably and in harmonizing growth between existing cities and new cities. This study focuses on the paradox of New Fayoum that, despite homeland’s growing spatial pressures, it cannot attract long-term residents. The research relies on a mixture of data types, such as GIS-based land-use change analysis (from 2009 to 2023), demographic data and qualitative interviews, all of which are used in a comparative sense to analyze urban growth patterns and mobility changes. The results reflect a clear imbalance; Fayoum City continues to increase in density due to informal, necessity-oriented growth and conversion of agricultural lands, whereas New Fayoum grows, albeit physically, but relatively little socially. Rather than facilitating people moving to New Fayoum on a permanent basis, at least in most cases, the plan of migration to New Fayoum is a temporary solution for the stress and strain of living in a well-known historic city. This research provides a relational and socio-spatial interpretation of lack of success in urban transitions rather than just a failure of infrastructure. This study cuts across the boundaries of urban planning literature because it shows that, in addition to the physical dimension, a new city must be underpinned by a framework of spatial justice, urban entitlement and social anchoring for any successful urban expansion, a multi-dimensional framework rooted in theoretical constructs and data collected from Fayoum and New Fayoum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了埃及新法尤姆城市（New Fayoum）无法吸引长期居民的悖论，发现尽管存在空间压力，但该新城仅实现了物理增长而缺乏社会扎根，居民迁移更多是临时性策略而非永久性定居。
AI.research_question: 为什么新法尤姆城市在埃及面临日益增长的空间压力下，仍然无法吸引长期居民？
AI.motivation: 埃及存在重要的空间正义问题，包括资源公平分配以及现有城市与新城之间的增长协调。新法尤姆城市无法吸引长期居民这一悖论亟需解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间正义、城市权利（urban entitlement）、社会锚定（social anchoring）——一个多维度的社会空间分析框架。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：基于GIS的土地利用变化分析（2009-2023）、人口统计数据、定性访谈，采用比较分析方法分析城市增长模式和流动性变化。
AI.findings: 法尤姆市因非正规、需求导向的增长和农业用地转化而继续高密度化；新法尤姆虽有物理增长，但社会增长有限。居民迁往新法尤姆多为应对历史名城生活压力的临时方案，而非永久性迁移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了城市转型失败的关系性和社会空间解释，而非将其简单归因于基础设施失败；提出了成功城市扩张需以空间正义、城市权利和社会锚定为支撑的多维框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃及及其他发展中国家新区规划提供了超越物理基础设施建设的实践启示，强调社会扎根和空间正义在新区发展中的核心作用。

title: Compact urban growth and the segregation paradox in Oslo: From desegregation to ”flipped segregation”?
affiliations: University of Oslo

detail.title: Compact urban growth and the segregation paradox in Oslo: From desegregation to ”flipped segregation”?
detail.abstract: Despite rising social inequality, several studies across Europe and elsewhere report stable levels of socioeconomic segregation or even desegregation. This paradox is often linked to shifts in the social geography of cities such as gentrification. However, the mechanisms underlying such changes remain poorly understood. One underexplored factor is contemporary urban growth and housing supply, increasingly shaped by densification policies and marketoriented housing regimes. This paper examines the relationship between socioeconomic segregation and housing production in the Oslo region 2004-2022. Overall segregation between high- and low-status groups declined slightly toward the end of this period, and the spatial segregation pattern shifted considerably in parts of the region. The results unpack underlying drivers of the segregation paradox and suggest that market-rate housing production is associated with both reproduced and restructured socioeconomic segregation. First, new housing is associated with desegregation in neighbourhoods that had high concentrations of low socioeconomic status. Second, the process appears to be transitional, as new housing contributes to emerging trends of ”flipped segregation” – a shift in the inner city, from a dominance of concentrations of low to concentrations of high socioeconomic status. Third, densification is associated with intensified and expanded clusters of high socioeconomic status in inner suburbs, accompanied by increased concentration of low socioeconomic status in outer suburbs. The findings highlight the importance of housing supply dynamics when assessing drivers of both desegregation and vicious circles of reinforced segregation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2004-2022年奥斯陆地区社会经济隔离与住房生产的关系，发现市场导向的住房建设既带来一定程度的去隔离，又导致"翻转隔离"——高地位群体向内城聚集、低地位群体向外城迁移的新空间格局。
AI.research_question: 社会经济发展中，住房生产如何影响城市社会经济隔离的动态变化？
AI.motivation: 尽管社会不平等加剧，但许多研究发现社会经济隔离水平保持稳定甚至下降（"隔离悖论"），其背后机制尚不明确，特别是城市增长和住房供给（受密度化和市场化住房制度驱动）这一被忽视的因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市社会经济隔离理论、住房供给与城市增长机制、密度化与市场化住房制度理论、空间分异与翻转隔离理论。
AI.method: 以挪威奥斯陆地区2004-2022年为研究区域，分析社会经济隔离与住房生产的时空关系。
AI.findings: （1）高地位与低地位群体间的总体隔离在该时期末期略有下降；（2）市场导向的住房建设在低地位聚集区与去隔离相关；（3）这一过程具有过渡性，新住房导致内城出现"翻转隔离"——从低地位集中转向高地位集中；（4）密度化与内郊区高地位聚集的强化和扩展、外郊区低地位聚集的增加相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"隔离悖论"背后的住房供给驱动机制，提出"翻转隔离"概念，阐明了密度化和市场化住房制度如何同时产生去隔离和强化隔离的双重效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划与住房政策制定者提供启示：住房供给动态是理解城市隔离变化的关键变量，需警惕市场导向的住房建设可能导致的空间不平等重组而非真正的社会融合。

title: From proximity to access: Childcare enrollment and accessibility in Brazil
affiliations: Federal University of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From proximity to access: Childcare enrollment and accessibility in Brazil
detail.abstract: This study examines walking accessibility to daycare facilities for children aged 0–3 in Brazil using a nationwide Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA) approach. Accessibility is measured by combining teacher supply, child population demand, and Euclidean distance thresholds adjusted for network circuity. Using data from the 2022 Demographic Census and School Census for all 5,570 municipalities, the analysis relates accessibility to enrollment rates through compositional data analysis (α-transformation) and Geographically Weighted Regression. Results show that while proximity to facilities is associated with higher enrollment, improvements in service capacity generate substantially larger marginal effects than the mere expansion of spatial coverage. Accessibility effects vary substantially across municipalities and decline with higher levels of urbanization. A substantial share of the positive association between urbanization and enrollment is explained by accessibility, suggesting that urban advantages are largely associated with spatial conditions. At the same time, the weaker translation of accessibility into enrollment in more urbanized contexts indicates the presence of additional barriers not captured by spatial measures. These findings suggest that conventional distance-based accessibility measures may overestimate effective access when capacity constraints and local frictions are not considered. Accessibility emerges as a necessary but not sufficient condition for enrollment, highlighting the role of service capacity and contextual barriers in converting spatial access into actual use. Policies that expand coverage without addressing staffing constraints and local access conditions are therefore unlikely to achieve substantial gains in enrollment.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用全国两步移动搜索法（2SFCA）分析了巴西0-3岁儿童步行可达日托设施的可及性，发现服务能力对入园率的边际效应远大于空间覆盖范围，且可达性效应随城市化程度提高而减弱，表明空间可达性是入园的必要但非充分条件。
AI.research_question: 巴西0-3岁儿童步行可达日托设施的可及性如何影响入园率？空间可达性与服务能力哪个对入园率影响更大？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注学校可达性的空间维度，但忽视了服务容量约束和地方摩擦对实际入园的影响。巴西作为一个城市化程度高但日托服务供给不均的国家，为检验空间可达性与实际使用之间的差距提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两步移动搜索法（2SFCA）、成分数据分析（α-transformation）、地理加权回归（GWR）
AI.method: 利用2022年人口普查和学校普查数据，对巴西全部5,570个城市采用2SFCA法测量步行可达性，结合欧氏距离和网络迂回系数调整，通过成分数据分析和地理加权回归分析可达性与入园率的关系。
AI.findings: （1）设施邻近性与入园率正相关，但服务能力提升对入园率的边际效应远大于空间覆盖扩张；（2）可达性效应在不同城市间差异显著，且随城市化水平提高而递减；（3）城市化与入园率的正相关很大部分可由可达性解释；（4）城市化程度越高的地区，可达性向入园率的转化越弱，说明存在空间测量未捕捉的额外障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了空间可达性作为入园的必要但非充分条件，明确了服务容量和情境障碍在空间可及性转化为实际使用中的关键调节作用，修正了传统距离可达性测量可能高估有效可及性的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西及其他发展中国家日托设施规划提供政策启示：仅扩大空间覆盖而不解决师资配置和地方准入条件，难以实现入园率的实质提升；政策应优先关注服务能力建设和消除情境性障碍。

title: Examining the Effects of Housing Costs on the Housing Preferences of Teachers in the Cape Coast Metropolis, Ghana. ​
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Examining the Effects of Housing Costs on the Housing Preferences of Teachers in the Cape Coast Metropolis, Ghana. ​
detail.abstract: Teachers, a major stakeholder in the education sector, are significantly affected by high housing costs given their moderate-to-low incomes. However, there is a dearth of information in the housing literature regarding how housing costs affect teachers' residential preferences. This study examines the effects of housing costs on teachers’ ability to meet their housing needs in the Cape Coast Metropolis (CCM). A qualitative case study design was used. Homogeneous purposive and snowball sampling were used to recruit 30 senior high school teachers for in-depth interviews and five focus group discussions. Results from thematic analysis revealed four challenges teachers face in the housing market in CCM, including a lack of decent housing near school, high agent costs, high housing prices, and frequent conflicts with co-tenants. Furthermore, the results showed that high housing prices compel teachers to live in close and congested neighbourhoods, which are relatively cheaper. The proximity to school (congested neighbourhoods) affects preparation for work, causes noise pollution, and affects teachers’ emotional well-being. When teachers live far away from schools for better housing options, they sometimes skip classes and do not actively participate in extracurricular activities. The study contributes to the urban housing literature by providing the nexus between teachers’ income vulnerabilities and their housing preferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. It concludes that teachers’ income levels affect their housing preferences. This study recommends that the government and other educational stakeholders collaborate to develop affordable housing policy and frameworks anchored on addressing teachers’ housing needs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了住房成本如何影响加纳海岸角都市区高中教师的居住选择。通过定性案例分析，发现高住房成本迫使教师要么居住在拥挤的廉价社区（影响备课和情绪健康），要么住在远离学校的地方（导致缺课和减少课外活动参与）。研究揭示了教师收入脆弱性与住房偏好之间的关联，并呼吁政府制定针对教师群体的可负担住房政策。
AI.research_question: 住房成本如何影响教师的住房需求满足能力及其居住偏好？
AI.motivation: 住房文献中缺乏关于住房成本如何影响教师居住偏好的信息，而教师作为教育领域的主要利益相关者，其收入中等偏低，受高住房成本影响显著。
AI.theoretical_framework: 收入脆弱性与住房偏好之间的关联理论；城市住房理论。
AI.method: 定性案例研究设计；采用同质目的性抽样和滚雪球抽样招募30名高中教师进行深度访谈和5次焦点小组讨论；主题分析法分析数据。
AI.findings: 教师面临四大住房挑战：缺乏学校附近体面住房、高中介费、高房价、频繁与合租者冲突；高房价迫使教师居住在拥挤社区（靠近学校但影响备课、造成噪音污染、损害情绪健康）；教师为更好住房选项住得远时，会缺课且不积极参与课外活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为撒哈拉以南非洲的城市住房文献提供了教师收入脆弱性与住房偏好之间关联的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政府及教育利益相关者合作，制定以解决教师住房需求为核心的可负担住房政策与框架。

title: How Can Cities Build Innovation Capabilities? An Analytical Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Brazilian School of Public and Business Administration at the Getulio Vargas Foundation and Queensland University of Technology

detail.title: How Can Cities Build Innovation Capabilities? An Analytical Framework
detail.abstract: This article develops a novel analytical framework for evaluating the innovation capabilities of cities. This framework not only identifies strategies to enhance the delivery of urban services but also underscores the importance of accumulating innovation capabilities in cities through learning mechanisms to implement innovative activities. The paper begins by highlighting the increasing significance of innovation for public services, but lacking a robust conceptualization of innovation capabilities. Thus, we aim to address this gap by examining how cities can build innovation capabilities. The paper first provides a conceptual definition of innovation capability in the context of cities, then illustrates how cities can amass innovation capabilities through various learning mechanisms to progress from a lower to a higher level of capability. Finally, the paper applies the framework to the urban transportation sector to analyse innovations in Brazil's bus systems in Rio de Janeiro and Curitiba. By bridging firm-level capability frameworks to city-scale innovation, we advance the understanding of how cities can navigate technological transitions to deliver better public services. This research contributes by developing a framework to help scholars and policymakers understand how to build city-level innovation capabilities through different learning mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个分析城市创新能力的框架，通过定义城市层面的创新能力、阐明学习机制如何帮助城市从低到高积累创新能力，并应用于巴西里约热内卢和库里蒂巴的公交系统创新案例，为城市如何通过不同学习机制建设创新能力提供了理论和实践指导。
AI.research_question: 城市如何构建和积累创新能力？
AI.motivation: 创新对公共服务日益重要，但缺乏对城市创新能力的系统性概念化，现有研究多聚焦企业层面，缺少城市尺度的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将企业层面的创新能力框架延伸至城市层面；学习机制理论（城市通过不同学习机制从低水平向高水平创新能力演进）。
AI.method: 概念框架构建 + 案例研究（巴西里约热内卢和库里蒂巴的公交系统创新）。
AI.findings: 城市可通过不同的学习机制积累创新能力，实现从低水平到高水平创新能力的跃迁；该框架成功解释了巴西两个城市公交系统的创新差异与演进路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业级创新能力框架拓展到城市尺度，提出了城市创新能力的概念定义和演进机制，弥补了城市创新研究中的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和城市管理者提供了系统性的分析工具，帮助理解和设计如何通过不同学习机制建设城市创新能力，从而提升公共服务质量。

title: Modeling and Numerical Simulation of Oolitic Deposits in Green Sand Casting
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Wuhan Institute of Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Modeling and Numerical Simulation of Oolitic Deposits in Green Sand Casting
detail.abstract: The reuse of foundry silica sand is essential for sustainability in sand casting, yet its quality degrades due to bentonite oolitization during repeated thermal cycles. This study establishes a mathematical model to predict the cumulative oolitic content in green sand based on experimental data, enabling quantitative analysis of oolitization. The model integrates second-order reaction kinetics, thermodynamic equilibrium described by logistic functions, and linear corrections for seacoal content. Coupled with temperature field simulations using InteCAST CAE, the model successfully predicts the spatial distribution of oolitic content in sand molds. Validation against production-line measurements from a ductile iron crankcase casting shows excellent agreement, with errors below 2%. The proposed approach provides a reliable tool for precise quality control and efficient reuse of molding sand, contributing to reduced waste and improved foundry economics.

AI.tldr: 本研究建立了基于反应动力学和热力学平衡的数学模型，结合铸造CAE温度场仿真，成功预测旧砂中累积的“橄榄石”（oolitic）含量，误差低于2%，为铸造砂的循环利用提供了精准质控工具。
AI.research_question: 如何建立数学模型定量预测反复热循环作用下湿型砂中膨润土橄榄石化（oolitization）的累积含量？
AI.motivation: 铸造硅砂的循环利用对可持续铸造至关重要，但反复热循环会导致膨润土发生橄榄石化，使砂子质量下降。现有研究缺乏对橄榄石化累积含量的定量预测模型，难以实现精准的砂质量控制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二级反应动力学、热力学平衡（Logistic函数描述）、煤粉含量的线性修正、铸造CAE温度场仿真（InteCAST）
AI.method: 基于实验数据建立橄榄石化累积含量的数学模型（反应动力学+热力学平衡+煤粉线性修正），耦合InteCAST CAE温度场仿真预测砂型中橄榄石含量的空间分布，并通过球墨铸铁曲轴箱铸件的生产线实测数据验证模型。
AI.findings: 模型成功预测了砂型中橄榄石含量的空间分布；生产线实测验证显示误差低于2%，模型精度高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将二级反应动力学与Logistic热力学平衡相结合，构建了橄榄石化累积含量的定量预测模型，为铸造砂退化机理研究提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为铸造厂提供了精准的砂质量控制工具，可减少废砂排放、提高旧砂回用效率、降低生产成本，促进铸造行业的可持续发展。

title: Ensuring Employee Status for Gig Workers: A Critical Analysis of the Rajasthan Act & Way Forward Author: Mr. Oaishik Bhattacharya (MPP Cohort: 2023-25)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Ensuring Employee Status for Gig Workers: A Critical Analysis of the Rajasthan Act & Way Forward Author: Mr. Oaishik Bhattacharya (MPP Cohort: 2023-25)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No, my reseaerch has not be influenced in any form.

detail.abstract: India has emerged as one of the leading countries for gig-platform workers, with a predicted potential of employing over 2.35 crore people by 2035. However, given the precarious nature of their employment, and the algorithmic bias of platforms that hinder prospects of meaningful employment, there is a need for reforms that empower and uplift the gig workers. The Rajasthan Platform-Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023, is a tepid attempt to address the problems that plague the workforce. This article is a critical analysis of the lacunas and the contradictions with the Rajasthan Act. It evaluates the pain points of workers employed in the gig economy and through tools provided by design thinking talks about ensuring employee status for gig workers and proposes solutions for the same

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了《2023年拉贾斯坦邦平台零工工人（登记与福利）法案》的缺陷与矛盾，结合设计思维工具，探讨如何为零工经济工人确立雇员身份并提出解决方案。
AI.research_question: 拉贾斯坦邦零工工人福利法案存在哪些缺陷与矛盾？如何通过设计思维为零工工人确立雇员身份并改善其困境？
AI.motivation: 印度零工工人数量庞大且处境 precarious（不稳定），平台算法偏见阻碍其获得有意义的就业机会，现有法案（拉贾斯坦邦法案）虽试图改革但效果有限，亟需更有效的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计思维（Design Thinking）方法论、零工经济与平台劳动研究、劳动法中的雇员身份认定理论
AI.method: 批判性法律分析（对法案进行文本与逻辑剖析）、设计思维工具应用（用于提出解决方案）
AI.findings: 拉贾斯坦邦法案存在诸多疏漏与内在矛盾，未能真正解决零工工人的核心痛点（如缺乏雇员身份、算法不公等）；借助设计思维可提出更有效的改革方案，帮助确立零工工人的雇员地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 将设计思维引入零工工人权益保障的政策分析领域，拓展了劳动法研究的方法论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他国家的零工工人福利政策改革提供具体的批判性视角和可操作的解决方案建议。

title: Measuring the structural, neighbourhood socio-demographic, andenvironmental prices of real estate: a novel econometric-ensemblemachine learning approach
affiliations: Wuhan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Wuhan University, Wuhan University and Wuhan University

detail.title: Measuring the structural, neighbourhood socio-demographic, andenvironmental prices of real estate: a novel econometric-ensemblemachine learning approach

keywords.keywords: Real estate price predictionStacked ensembleMachine learningCobb-Douglas functionHeterogeneity analysisHedonic pricing model

detail.abstract: This research develops a novel stacked machine learning framework for house price prediction by integrating three distinct categories of predictive variables: structural attributes,neighbourhood socio-demographic characteristics, and environmental factors.We first construct separate predictive models for each category using gradient boosting machines, then combine them through a Cobb-Douglas production function to form a stacked ensemble model. This approach allows us to estimate the elasticity coefficients or relative contributions of each variable category relative to the total housing prices. The contributions of structural, social, and environmental prices to the total price are 66.3%, 30.7%, and 3.0%, respectively. We further clustered houses using three distinct sub-categories of housing value to conduct a heterogeneity analysis of the impact of housing characteristics on housing prices. Through a data-driven process, we classified houses into structural-dominant homes, social-dominant properties, and environmental-dominant neighborhoods. Green space has a significant impact on housing prices for structural-dominant luxury homes and social-dominant middle-class properties, but a weaker correlation with environmental-dominant disadvantaged neighborhoods, implying that urban green space planning needs to consider housing heterogeneity. Our model combines the high accuracy of machine learning with the interpretability of traditional econometric methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种堆叠机器学习框架，通过Cobb-Douglas生产函数整合结构属性、社区社会人口特征和环境因素三类变量来预测房价，发现结构、社会和环境对房价的贡献分别为66.3%、30.7%和3.0%，并基于住房异质性进行了聚类分析。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个兼具高预测精度和可解释性的房价预测模型，并量化不同类别变量（结构、社会、环境）对房价的相对贡献及其异质性效应？
AI.motivation: 现有房价预测模型要么侧重预测精度（如黑箱机器学习模型）而缺乏可解释性，要么侧重经济解释（如特征价格模型）而预测能力有限。此外，不同类型房价影响因素的相对贡献及其在不同住房类型中的异质性效应尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 梯度提升机（GBM）、堆叠集成学习、Cobb-Douglas生产函数、特征价格理论
AI.method: 首先分别对结构、社会人口、环境三类变量构建独立的GBM预测模型，然后通过Cobb-Douglas生产函数进行堆叠集成，最后基于三个子类住房价值进行聚类异质性分析。
AI.findings: 结构、社会和环境对房价的贡献分别为66.3%、30.7%和3.0%；住房可聚类为结构主导型、社会主导型和环境主导型三类；绿地空间对结构主导型豪宅和社会主导型中产住房影响显著，但对环境主导型弱势社区影响较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Cobb-Douglas生产函数引入机器学习堆叠框架，实现了高精度与可解释性的统一；揭示了不同类别变量对房价的弹性贡献及其异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划提供了差异化绿地空间布局依据——需考虑住房异质性；为房地产估价提供了兼具精度与解释力的新方法。

title: Valorisation of iron ore alkaline effluent into hydroxycancrinite zeolite for multi-metal ion adsorption: a response surface methodology study
affiliations: Curtin University, Curtin University, Curtin University and Curtin University

detail.title: Valorisation of iron ore alkaline effluent into hydroxycancrinite zeolite for multi-metal ion adsorption: a response surface methodology study
detail.abstract: This study presents the application of Box-Behnken response surface methodology statistical design to optimising the adsorption behaviour of cobalt, copper, nickel, zinc, and magnesium ions from an aqueous medium using hydroxycancrinite zeolite produced from alkaline effluent derived from iron ore upgrading. The influence of process parameters, including time, pH, and adsorbent dosage, on the adsorption process of the said metal ions was investigated and found to be significant. The pH and adsorbent dosage were all observed to be the most significant factors influencing the adsorption efficiency of all metal ions, as determined by analysis of variance (ANOVA). Second-order terms and binary interactions were also significant for most ions. The statistical models developed for each metal ion were highly significant, with R² values exceeding 0.98, indicating a strong agreement between the predicted and experimental data. Optimised conditions yielded adsorbent efficiencies exceeding 98% for Cu²⁺, Co²⁺, Ni²⁺, and Mg²⁺, and above 84% for Zn²⁺. FESEM-EDS analysis revealed clear morphological transitions after adsorption, characterised by smoother particle surfaces and pore infilling, confirming effective metal binding. Overall, the study demonstrates that hydroxycancrinite zeolite, derived from alkaline effluent from leaching of iron ore, is an efficient and sustainable adsorbent for multi-metal removal from aqueous solutions, providing a viable pathway for waste-to-resource utilisation in the hydrometallurgical processing of low-grade iron ore.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Box-Behnken响应面法优化羟基钙霞石沸石对水溶液中Co、Cu、Ni、Zn、Mg离子的吸附过程，在优化条件下除Zn²⁺外去除率均超98%，证实该沸石是一种高效可持续的多金属吸附剂，实现了铁矿石加工碱性废液向资源的转化。
AI.research_question: 如何利用响应面法优化羟基钙霞石沸石对多种金属离子的吸附性能，以及探究工艺参数对吸附效率的影响？
AI.motivation: 铁矿石加工产生大量碱性废液，既造成环境负担又浪费潜在资源。本研究旨在将碱性废液转化为羟基钙霞石沸石吸附剂，并系统优化其对多种重金属离子的吸附条件，实现“废物变资源”的可持续水处理路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Box-Behnken响应面法（RSM）；方差分析（ANOVA）；吸附过程动力学与机理（吸附剂表面形态变化与金属结合效应）
AI.method: 通过Box-Behnken响应面法设计实验，考察时间、pH和吸附剂用量三个因素对Co²⁺、Cu²⁺、Ni²⁺、Zn²⁺、Mg²⁺吸附效率的影响，利用ANOVA分析显著性，并用FESEM-EDS表征吸附前后沸石表面形态变化。
AI.findings: pH和吸附剂用量是对所有金属离子吸附效率最显著的因素；各金属离子的统计模型R²均超过0.98，预测值与实验值高度吻合；优化条件下Cu²⁺、Co²⁺、Ni²⁺、Mg²⁺去除率超98%，Zn²⁺超84%；FESEM-EDS显示吸附后颗粒表面更加平滑、孔隙被填充，证实了金属的有效结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统验证了Box-Behnken响应面法在多金属离子竞争吸附体系中的适用性，揭示了工艺参数（尤其是pH和吸附剂用量）对多金属吸附效率的非线性影响及交互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种将铁矿石加工碱性废液转化为高效多金属吸附剂的可行方案，实现了废物资源化利用；优化后的工艺参数可为实际工业含重金属废水处理提供借鉴。

title: The Long Shadow of a Sudden River
affiliations: KU Leuven

detail.title: The Long Shadow of a Sudden River
detail.abstract: In 1134, a storm created the Zwin, a river connecting Bruges to the North Sea. By 1500, it had silted up and become unnavigable. I exploit this natural experiment to show that whilst open, the Zwin more than tripled Bruges’s population. To measure its long-term shadow, I develop a dynamic quantitative spatial model incorporating merchants and Malthusian dynamics, and build a retrieval-augmented generation large language model to extract merchant data from 120 qualitative historical sources. The model shows that the Zwin altered the distribution of economic activity not just in Bruges, but across the Low Countries, both when navigable and for hundreds of years after. ​

AI.tldr: 本文利用13世纪Zwin运河的自然实验，结合动态定量空间模型和基于大语言模型的商人数据提取方法，论证了该运河在通航期间使布鲁日人口增长三倍以上，并对低地国家经济活动分布产生了持续数百年的长期影响。
AI.research_question: 自然地理冲击（Zwin运河的开通与淤塞）如何影响中世纪布鲁日及低地国家的经济活动分布，这种影响在短期和长期（数百年后）有何不同？
AI.motivation: 地理禀赋对经济活动分布的长期影响是空间经济学的重要议题，但缺乏外生冲击的因果识别。Zwin运河作为一种自然实验（因风暴形成、因淤塞消失），为识别地理冲击的短期与长期效应提供了独特机会。
