AI.theoretical_framework: 动态定量空间模型（Dynamic Quantitative Spatial Model）结合马尔萨斯人口动力学（Malthusian Dynamics），纳入商人（merchants）作为关键经济主体，以刻画贸易通道变化对人口和空间均衡的影响。
AI.method: (1) 自然实验方法：利用Zwin运河开通与淤塞的外生性进行因果识别；(2) 动态定量空间模型：包含商人和马尔萨斯人口机制；(3) 检索增强生成大语言模型（RAG-LLM）：从120个定性历史文献中提取商人数据。
AI.findings: (1) Zwin运河通航期间使布鲁日人口增加超过两倍（more than tripled）；(2) 运河不仅影响了布鲁日，还重塑了整个低地国家的经济活动空间分布；(3) 这种影响在运河淤塞后仍持续了数百年（long-term shadow）。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 为地理冲击的长期效应提供了因果证据，证明了"路径依赖"在经济地理中的持久性；(2) 扩展了动态空间模型，将马尔萨斯机制与商人行为整合；(3) 展示了自然实验方法在前现代经济史研究中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为理解基础设施投资（如港口、运河）的短期和长期回报提供了历史证据；(2) 为政策制定者评估地理工程（如航道疏浚）的多百年影响提供了分析框架；(3) 展示了LLM结合RAG在历史数据提取中的实用方法。

title: Heuristic-Based Covariance Initialization for RLS Identification: A New IAED Metric Applied to Aerospace Pressure Control Systems
affiliations: Instituto Politecnico Nacional

detail.title: Heuristic-Based Covariance Initialization for RLS Identification: A New IAED Metric Applied to Aerospace Pressure Control Systems
detail.abstract: AbstractThe convergence speed and transient stability of the identification of Recursive Least Squares (RLS) are highly sensitive to the initial state of the covariance matrix ($P_0$). Traditional tuning methods rely on empirical trial-and-error, which often results in suboptimal performance or numerical instability in high-precision aerospace applications. This paper proposes a systematic initialization strategy based on a heuristic search (Random Mutation Hill Climbing) to optimize the scaling parameters of $P_0$. A novel performance metric, the Integral of the Absolute Error and its Derivative (IAED), is introduced to simultaneously penalize slow convergence and oscillatory behavior in the parameter estimation process. The methodology was validated on an experimental pressure control testbed, emulating the dynamics of aircraft fuel systems. The findings suggest that the IAED-based heuristic strategy provides a robust and repeatable framework for the identification of safety-critical pressure systems, ensuring faster stability in the "More Electric Aircraft" (MEA) architectural context.highlights  A novel initialization strategy for RLS via Random Mutation Hill Climbing (RMHC).Introduction of the Integral of the Absolute Error and its Derivative metric to penalize both estimation error and parameter oscillations.Theoretical theorems establishing the existence of a global optimal tuning for the covariance matrix.Identification of optimal covariance regions to ensure high-precision pressure control. Experimental validation on a testbed emulating More Electric Aircraft (MEA) dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对递归最小二乘（RLS）协方差矩阵初始状态敏感性问题，提出基于随机变异爬山法的启发式初始化策略，并引入新的性能指标（IAED）来同时惩罚收敛慢和参数振荡。在模拟飞机燃油系统的压力控制实验平台上验证，该方法在"多电飞机"背景下实现了更快、更稳定的参数辨识。
AI.research_question: 如何系统地优化RLS算法中协方差矩阵的初始缩放参数，以提高高精度航空航天应用中参数辨识的收敛速度和暂态稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统RLS的协方差矩阵初始化依赖经验试错法，在航空航太高精度应用中常导致性能次优或数值不稳定，缺乏系统化的初始化策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 递归最小二乘（RLS）理论；随机变异爬山法（RMHC）启发式搜索；积分绝对误差及其导数（IAED）性能指标；协方差矩阵全局最优调谐存在性定理。
AI.method: 提出基于随机变异爬山法（RMHC）的启发式搜索策略来优化RLS协方差矩阵初始缩放参数；设计IAED指标（积分绝对误差及其导数）以同时惩罚估计误差和参数振荡；在模拟飞机燃油系统动力学的压力控制实验平台上进行验证。
AI.findings: IAED启发的启发式策略为安全关键型压力系统的辨识提供了鲁棒且可重复的框架；在"多电飞机"架构下确保了更快的稳定性；通过理论定理证明了协方差矩阵全局最优调谐的存在性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了协方差矩阵全局最优调谐存在性的理论定理；引入IAED指标作为同时评估收敛速度和参数振荡的综合性能度量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为RLS在航空航天等高精度安全关键系统中的应用提供了系统化的初始化策略，替代了传统的经验试错法；在模拟飞机燃油系统的实验中验证了方法的有效性和可重复性。

title: Land Prices Near Nuclear Power Plants: Evidence from the Fukushima Accident
affiliations: Kyushu University and Kyushu University

detail.title: Land Prices Near Nuclear Power Plants: Evidence from the Fukushima Accident
detail.abstract: The 2011 Fukushima nuclear accident may have had not only direct impacts through radioactive contamination in Japan, but also indirect economic effects on areas surrounding other nuclear power plants where no accident occurred. Using real estate transaction data from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's Real Estate Information Library, this study conducts a difference-in-differences analysis based on a hedonic approach. The results indicate that land prices in areas surrounding nuclear power plants declined by approximately 6.2%–7.1% after the accident. A municipality-level approximation suggests that the associated land value loss amounts to approximately 3.44 trillion yen. Additional analyses further suggest that the decline in land prices cannot be fully explained by the policy shock associated with reactor shutdowns, and that the information shock caused by the accident may have changed people’s subjective perceptions of nuclear risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本房地产交易数据，采用双重差分法和特征价格模型，发现2011年福岛核事故导致未发生事故的核电站周边地价下降约6.2%-7.1%，土地价值损失约3.44万亿日元，且地价下跌不能完全由反应堆停运的政策冲击解释，而更多源于人们对核风险主观认知的变化。
AI.research_question: 福岛核事故是否对未发生事故的其他核电站周边土地价格产生了间接经济影响？这种影响的程度和机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 核事故不仅造成直接的放射性污染，还可能通过改变人们对核风险的认知，对未发生事故地区的经济产生间接影响。量化这种间接影响对理解核能外部性和制定相关政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征价格模型（Hedonic pricing model）；双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）；风险认知理论（Risk perception theory）。
AI.method: 基于日本国土交通省房地产信息库的交易数据，采用特征价格模型框架下的双重差分方法进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）福岛核事故后，其他核电站周边地价下降约6.2%-7.1%；2）全日本因核事故导致的土地价值损失约3.44万亿日元；3）地价下跌不能完全由反应堆停运的政策冲击解释；4）信息冲击改变了人们对核风险的主观认知。
AI.theory_contributions: 将核事故的间接经济影响与风险认知变化联系起来，拓展了灾害经济学和风险感知理论在核能领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为核能政策的成本收益评估提供了间接经济损失的量化依据，提示政策制定者需重视核事故对公众风险感知的长期影响。

title: Robust Probabilistic Electricity Load Forecasting using DeepAR Architecture and TensorFlow Probability
affiliations: Omdurman Islamic University

detail.title: Robust Probabilistic Electricity Load Forecasting using DeepAR Architecture and TensorFlow Probability
detail.abstract: The variability of modern electricity demand, driven by the integration of renewable energy sources and dynamic consumer behaviors, poses significant challenges for power grid stability. Traditional point-forecasting models fail to quantify the inherent uncertainty in load trajectories, leading to suboptimal resource allocation and increased risks of blackout events. This research proposes a highly robust probabilist ic forecasting framework utilizin g the DeepAR (Autoregressive Recurrent Netwo rks) architecture combined with TensorFlow Probability. By mapping historical sequential data (168-hour windows) and deterministic future covariates (hour, day of the week, month) into a unified latent space via Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) cells, the model parameterizes an independent Gaussian distribution for each future time step across a 24-hour horizon. The methodology ensures strict chronological data separation to prevent leakage. Performance evaluations on the AEP hourly consumption dataset reveal the superiority of the probabilist ic approach, achieving precise median expectations (P50) alongside reliable 90% confidence matrices (P10 to P90). The framework's efficacy is rigorously quantified usin g Negative Log-Likelihood and Custom Quantile Losses, providing grid operators with mathematically bounded uncertainty estimations critical for safe industrial operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于DeepAR架构的概率预测框架，利用LSTM和TensorFlow Probability对电力负荷进行24小时概率预测，在AEP数据集上验证了其相比点预测的优越性，为电网调度提供了量化不确定性估计。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够量化电力负荷预测不确定性的概率预测框架，以提升电网运行的稳健性和安全性？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源并网与动态消费行为导致电力需求波动加剧，传统点预测模型无法量化不确定性，导致资源分配次优、停电风险增加。
AI.theoretical_framework: DeepAR（自回归循环网络）架构、LSTM长短期记忆网络、TensorFlow Probability概率编程、独立高斯分布参数化、负对数似然与分位数损失函数。
AI.method: 以168小时历史窗口序列与确定性未来协变量（小时、星期、月份）作为输入，通过LSTM编码到统一潜在空间，为每个未来时间步（24小时）参数化独立高斯分布；严格按时间顺序划分数据防止信息泄露；使用负对数似然和自定义分位数损失评估模型性能。
AI.findings: 在AEP小时级电力消费数据集上，概率预测方法在中位数期望（P50）上表现优异，同时生成了可靠的90%置信矩阵（P10至P90），为电网运营商提供了有界的不确定性估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DeepAR架构与TensorFlow Probability相结合，构建了端到端的概率负荷预测框架；验证了LSTM在时序概率建模中的有效性；提供了基于负对数似然和分位数损失的严格评估范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电网调度提供带有数学边界的不确定性估计，提升工业运行安全性；帮助优化资源配置、降低停电风险；方法具有良好的鲁棒性和可迁移性。

title: Urban Exclusion and Gendered Labour Market Penalties: Evidence from Informal Settlements in Kenya's Cities

detail.title: Urban Exclusion and Gendered Labour Market Penalties: Evidence from Informal Settlements in Kenya's Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved secondary data analysis and did not require formal ethics approval. All data used are publicly available and anonymized.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Urbanisation in sub-Saharan Africa has accelerated at an unprecedented pace, yet physical proximity to economic centres has not translated into labour market inclusion for millions of urban residents. This paper examines how residence in informal settlements shapes gendered labour market outcomes in Kenya's cities using nationally representative data from the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey (17,618 working-age urban adults) and a multidimensional, UN-Habitat-aligned measure of housing deprivation. Estimating linear probability models with gender interaction terms and city fixed effects, the study documents a persistent "urban exclusion penalty." Women residing in informal settlements are 8.4 percentage points less likely to be employed and 10.6 percentage points less likely to hold formal jobs relative to comparable women in formal neighbourhoods; men face smaller, largely statistically insignificant penalties. Each additional child under five is associated with a 6.8 percentage point employment penalty for women and no corresponding association for men, demonstrating how care burdens compound spatial disadvantage. Paradoxically, men in informal settlements exhibit higher household asset ownership (β = +0.325, p < 0.01), consistent with gendered occupational sorting into settlement-adjacent informal labour markets. These findings challenge the assumption that urban proximity guarantees economic inclusion and reveal informal settlement residence as a structure of gendered economic exclusion, not a transitional housing condition. Effective policy responses require integrated, gender-responsive frameworks combining livelihood infrastructure, publicly subsidised childcare, and anti-discrimination labour market programming.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2022年肯尼亚人口健康调查数据，研究非正规住区居住如何通过性别差异影响城市劳动力市场结果，发现女性面临显著的"城市排斥惩罚"，而非正规住区并非过渡性住房条件，而是性别化经济排斥的结构。
AI.research_question: 非正规住区居住如何通过性别差异影响撒哈拉以南非洲城市居民的劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲城市化加速，但物理 proximity 并未转化为劳动力市场包容，非正规住区居住对劳动力市场结果的性别化影响尚不清楚，挑战"城市 proximity 自动带来经济包容"的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市排斥惩罚理论、性别化经济排斥理论、多维住房剥夺指标（联合国人居署对齐）、照顾负担与空间劣势的叠加效应。
AI.method: 使用2022年肯尼亚人口健康调查数据（17,618名工作年龄城市成年人），构建多维住房剥夺指标，估计含性别交互项和城市固定效应的线性概率模型。
AI.findings: 1) 非正规住区女性就业概率低8.4个百分点，获得正式工作概率低10.6个百分点；男性惩罚较小且统计不显著。2) 每多一个5岁以下孩子，女性就业惩罚6.8个百分点，男性无显著关联。3) 非正规住区男性家庭资产拥有率更高（β=+0.325），表明存在性别化职业分流向住区邻近的非正规劳动力市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战"城市 proximity 保证经济包容"的传统假设，揭示非正规住区居住是性别化经济排斥的结构性因素而非过渡性住房条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议包括：结合生计基础设施、公共补贴托育服务和反歧视劳动力市场项目的综合性、性别回应型政策框架。

title:
ZelDB: A Cybersecurity-Native AI Database Architecture
Evidence, Memory, Attack Paths, and Defensive Action

detail.title:
ZelDB: A Cybersecurity-Native AI Database Architecture
Evidence, Memory, Attack Paths, and Defensive Action
detail.abstract: ZelDB introduces an integrated cybersecurity-native AI database architecture in which security objects, evidence, AI memory, attack paths, blast-radius simulations, policies, encryption context, incident replay, and defensive-action provenance are native database concepts. Its core data primitive, the CyberCell, represents assets, identities, incidents, policies, evidence, AI memories, and actions with built-in risk, trust, confidence, policy, evidence, encryption, graph, timeline, and action-eligibility metadata. ZelQL exposes security-native database operations such as TRACE, REPLAY, VERIFY, SIMULATE, WHY, and QUARANTINE. ZelDB does not claim to invent graph analytics, immutable ledgers, vector search, SIEMs, or AI memory in isolation; rather, it claims a unified database architecture for adversarial, AI-driven cybersecurity operations.

AI.tldr: ZelDB提出了一种原生集成了网络安全的AI数据库架构，将安全对象、证据、AI记忆、攻击路径、爆炸半径模拟、策略、加密上下文、事件回放和防御行动溯源作为数据库原生概念，并以CyberCell为数据基本单元，通过ZelQL提供安全原生数据库操作。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种统一的、原生集成网络安全的AI数据库架构，以支持对抗性、AI驱动的网络安全运营？
AI.motivation: 现有技术（图分析、不可变账本、向量搜索、SIEM、AI记忆等）各自独立发展，缺乏统一的数据库架构来整合网络安全运营中的安全对象、证据、AI记忆、攻击路径等核心要素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原生网络安全AI数据库架构理论，以CyberCell为核心数据原语，内置风险、信任、置信度、策略、证据、加密、图、时间线和行动资格等元数据。
AI.method: 提出ZelDB架构设计，定义CyberCell数据原语和ZelQL安全原生数据库操作语言。
AI.findings: ZelDB通过统一的数据库架构，将安全对象、证据、AI记忆、攻击路径、爆炸半径模拟、策略、加密上下文、事件回放和防御行动溯源等概念原生集成，并通过ZelQL提供TRACE、REPLAY、VERIFY、SIMULATE、WHY、QUARANTINE等安全原生操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新型的网络安全原生AI数据库架构理论，将安全运营的核心概念作为数据库的一等公民，超越了传统将安全功能作为附加层的做法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全运营提供了一种统一的数据库解决方案，支持攻击路径追踪、事件回放、策略验证、爆炸半径模拟等关键操作，有助于提升AI驱动的网络安全防御能力。

title: Human Resource Management Practices in the Indian Textile Industry: A Case Study of KG Denim Limited, Coimbatore
affiliations: Avinashilingam Institute for Home Science and Higher Education for Women

detail.title: Human Resource Management Practices in the Indian Textile Industry: A Case Study of KG Denim Limited, Coimbatore
detail.abstract: The Indian textile and denim industry represents one of the most labour-intensive and economically significant sectors, contributing approximately 28% of total organised manufacturing employment. This paper examines the Human Resource Management (HRM) practices within KG Denim Limited, a vertically integrated denim fabric manufacturer headquartered in Mettupalayam, Coimbatore. Through primary data collection via structured observation and supervisory interviews, and secondary data from company records, HR manuals, and industry databases, this study analyses recruitment and selection procedures, training and development initiatives, wage administration, workplace health and safety policies, and the strategic deployment of the Automha Automated Warehouse Management System. Additionally, the paper evaluates the organisational impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on HR operations and business continuity. The findings reveal that KG Denim employs a hybrid recruitment model combining internal promotions, referral networks, and digital platforms; maintains rigorous training programmes aligned with production HRM in Indian Textile Industry: A Case Study of KG Denim Limited Journal of Business Administration Research | 2 deadlines; and enforces comprehensive safety and compliance frameworks. The study concludes with implications for HR strategy optimisation in capital-intensive textile enterprises and recommendations for post-pandemic workforce resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文以KG Denim Limited为案例，系统分析了印度纺织丹宁行业的人力资源管理实践，涵盖招聘、培训、薪酬、健康安全及自动化仓储系统，并评估了新冠疫情对HR运营的影响。研究发现该企业采用混合招聘模式、严格的培训体系和完善的安全合规框架，最后提出了HR战略优化建议。
AI.research_question: KG Denim Limited的人力资源管理实践（包括招聘选拔、培训发展、薪酬管理、工作场所健康安全以及自动化仓储系统的战略部署）是如何运作的？新冠疫情对组织HR运营和业务连续性产生了哪些影响？
AI.motivation: 印度纺织丹宁行业是劳动密集型且经济意义重大的部门，占组织化制造业总就业的28%。然而对该行业具体企业的HRM实践缺乏深入的案例研究，尤其是COVID-19大流行背景下的HR运营韧性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理（HRM）理论与实践，涉及招聘选拔、培训发展、薪酬管理、职业健康安全（OHS）以及战略人力资源部署等核心模块。
AI.method: 定性案例研究。一手数据通过结构化观察和主管访谈收集；二手数据来源于公司记录、HR手册和行业数据库。
AI.findings: (1) KG Denim采用混合招聘模式（内部晋升+推荐网络+数字化平台）；(2) 维持与生产截止日期对齐的严格培训计划；(3) 执行全面的安全与合规框架；(4) 部署了Automha自动化仓储管理系统；(5) 新冠疫情对HR运营和业务连续性产生了显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本密集型纺织企业的HRM实践提供了系统性案例证据，揭示了混合招聘模式、培训与生产协同机制以及自动化系统在HR战略中的整合方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度纺织丹宁行业及其他资本密集型制造企业的HR战略优化提供了实践参考，特别是在后疫情时代提升劳动力韧性的具体建议。

title: Linear Bayes Methods for Prediction-Powered Inference
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and University of South Florida

detail.title: Linear Bayes Methods for Prediction-Powered Inference
detail.abstract: We give a unified framework for inference under partial information: incomplete priors, expensive labels, informative selection, or censoring. Four traditions-Goldstein-Wooff Bayes Linear (BL), Zrnić-Candès Cross-PPI, Datta-Polson IPW-PPI, and the Berliner-Hill predictive estimator-are shown to be instances of a single generalised control-variate (GCV) estimator combining a baseline with a labelled-data rectifier through an optimal shrinkage factor. We prove (i) all four minimise asymptotic variance via the same covariance-over-variance ratio, computed in closed form for each; (ii) BL and Cross-PPI share an identical Kalman-gain structure, differing only in effective precision; (iii) the Berliner-Hill estimator equals the BL adjusted expectation under the uniform A n predictive prior, via the martingale posterior framework; (iv) Horvitz-Thompson, Hájek, IPCW, and importance sampling are the same reweighting principle in different notations. We establish the variance ordering Var[ βOLS ] ⪰ Var[ βBL ] ⪰ Var[ βCPPI ] ⪰ V * in the Gaussian-linear case. Simulations isolate the rectifier-bias mechanism, show that OLS coverage degrades sharply when MAR fails while IPW-PPI with the data-generating propensity stays near nominal, and contrast Kaplan-Meier with Berliner-Hill in the survival tail. Real-data analyses on NCCTG lung cancer and birth weight exhibit both the algebraic identities and the practical limits of inverse-probability weighting in small labelled samples with heavy-tailed propensities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一推理框架，将四种部分信息推断传统（贝叶斯线性、交叉PPI、逆概率加权PPI和柏林纳-希尔预测估计量）统一为广义控制变量估计量，证明它们共享相同的最优收缩因子，并揭示了方差排序和偏差机制。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一框架来解释部分信息条件下的多种推断方法，并揭示它们之间的数学等价关系与性能差异？
AI.motivation: 部分信息（不完全先验、昂贵标签、选择性标注、删失）在统计推断中普遍存在，但现有四种方法（BL、Cross-PPI、IPW-PPI、Berliner-Hill）看似独立发展，缺乏统一的数学框架来比较和整合它们。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义控制变量估计量（GCV）、卡尔曼增益结构、鞅后验框架、逆概率加权原理。
AI.method: 理论推导证明四种方法共享相同的最优收缩因子（协方差/方差比）；通过模拟实验隔离校正器偏差机制；在NCCTG肺癌数据和出生体重数据上进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (i)四种方法均通过相同的协方差/方差比最小化渐近方差；(ii)BL和Cross-PPI共享相同的卡尔曼增益结构，仅有效精度不同；(iii)Berliner-Hill估计量等于均匀An预测先验下的BL调整期望；(iv)Horvitz-Thompson、Hájek、IPCW和重要性采样是同一重加权原则的不同记法；方差排序为OLS ≥ BL ≥ Cross-PPI ≥ V*；IPW-PPI在MAR违反时仍保持接近名义覆盖。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了部分信息推断的统一数学框架，揭示了四种看似独立方法的内在等价关系，提供了完整的方差排序理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者在不同部分信息条件下选择最优推断方法提供了理论指导；揭示了逆概率加权在小样本重尾倾向下的实践局限性。

title: The Neurophysiology of Persistent Interruption: Allostatic Load, Cognitive Fragmentation, and the Pathological Normalization of Continuous Availability

detail.title: The Neurophysiology of Persistent Interruption: Allostatic Load, Cognitive Fragmentation, and the Pathological Normalization of Continuous Availability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that could have influenced the content, analysis, or conclusions of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical and literature-based analysis that did not involve human participants, patient data, clinical intervention, or identifiable personal information. Formal ethics committee approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Chronic interruption environments generate a form of allostatic overload driven not by stimulus intensity but by the inability to achieve complete deactivation of anticipatory and executive systems. Notifications, messaging platforms, and permanent digital accessibility produce conditions under which cognitive closure becomes physiologically unstable, resulting in persistent low-grade activation associated with attentional degradation, sleep disruption, executive dysfunction, and burnout. This paper integrates stress physiology, allostatic load theory, attentional fragmentation research, and occupational burnout literature to argue that continuous interruptibility constitutes a biologically significant environmental stressor whose systemic effects remain underestimated.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了持续中断环境（如通知、即时通讯和永久数字可达性）通过阻碍认知系统的完全关闭，产生一种异稳态负荷，进而导致注意力下降、睡眠障碍、执行功能受损和职业倦怠等系统性健康问题。
AI.research_question: 持续中断环境如何通过异稳态负荷机制对个体的认知功能和生理健康产生系统性影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究低估了持续可中断性作为生物学意义上环境应激源的系统性影响，作者试图整合跨学科证据来阐明这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 应激生理学、异稳态负荷理论、注意力碎片化研究、职业倦怠文献
AI.method: 理论整合与跨学科文献综述
AI.findings: 持续中断环境导致的异稳态负荷并非由刺激强度驱动，而是由预期系统和执行系统无法完全失活所致；这种持续的轻度激活与注意力退化、睡眠中断、执行功能障碍和倦怠相关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 将异稳态负荷理论从传统的高强度刺激范式拓展到低强度但持续性的中断环境领域，揭示了"无法完成认知闭合"作为应激源的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字环境设计、工作场所政策和个人数字卫生实践提供了生理学层面的理论依据，提示需要重新评估持续可中断性的健康代价。

title: CMH - Beyond the Lyapunov Wall: Extending the Predictive Horizon of Computational Macrohistory

detail.title: CMH - Beyond the Lyapunov Wall: Extending the Predictive Horizon of Computational Macrohistory
detail.abstract:
The Computational Macrohistory (CMH) framework, as developed in the preceding papers of this series, operates within a temporal horizon of roughly five to fifteen years for quantitative probabilistic forecasts. This constraint is not a technological artefact to be overcome with faster computation or larger datasets: it is a structural consequence of chaotic dynamics formalised in Axioms A5 and A7 of the CMH axiomatic system, and known in the broader literature on dynamical systems as the Lyapunov Wall. The present paper asks whether, and to what extent, mathematical strategies exist that can push this horizon further without abandoning the epistemological rigour on which CMH is founded.
A central claim of this paper is that the question of horizon extension cannot be answered without first specifying what kind of prediction is being considered. We distinguish three levels of the CMH prediction space: event prediction (the trajectory-level forecast of system state at a future time, subject to the full force of the Lyapunov Wall); regime probability (the probability that the system will be operating in a given dynamical regime over a future interval, subject to a substantially slower decay); and spectral structure persistence (the identification of invariant or near-invariant cyclic structures in the system's dynamics, whose predictive content is not subject to exponential decay but to linear phase uncertainty and structural stability constraints). The five methodological strategies surveyed in this paper operate at different levels of this hierarchy, and the comparison is meaningful only when the level is held constant.
We survey five candidate approaches — Ensemble Methods, Slow Manifold theory combined with Critical Slowing Down indicators, Analog Forecasting, Reservoir Computing, and Koopman Operator theory implemented through Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) — organising them into three methodological classes: uncertainty propagation strategies, regime detection strategies, and spectral decomposition strategies. We identify the Koopman Operator / DMD framework as the most promising candidate for integration with CMH at the level of spectral structure persistence, owing to its natural connection with the ergodicity assumption formalised in CMH Axiom A2, its compatibility with the panel structure of historical datasets, and its capacity to produce empirically falsifiable predictions about persistent cyclic structures.
The paper concludes with a description of the historical datasets most suited to a first empirical test of Koopman-CMH, including explicit criteria for dataset selection, and an announcement of the companion paper that will develop the full mathematical treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了计算宏观历史（CMH）框架的预测时间地平线为何受限（Lyapunov墙），并区分了三个预测层次（事件预测、制度概率、谱结构持久性）。通过比较五种方法论，发现Koopman算子/DMD框架最有潜力在谱结构层次上扩展预测地平线，且与CMH公理体系兼容。
AI.research_question: 在不放弃CMH认识论严谨性的前提下，是否存在可进一步推展预测时间地平线的数学策略？
AI.motivation: CMH框架的量化概率预测存在约5-15年的时间地平线限制（Lyapunov墙），这是混沌动力学的结构性结果而非技术局限。本文旨在寻找超越这一限制的数学策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: CMH公理体系（Axioms A5, A7, A2）；Lyapunov墙理论；混沌动力系统理论；Koopman算子理论；动态模态分解（DMD）。
AI.method: 综述五种方法：集成方法（Ensemble Methods）、慢流形理论+临界慢化指标、类比预测（Analog Forecasting）、储层计算（Reservoir Computing）、Koopman算子/DMD。将其归为三类：不确定性传播策略、制度检测策略、谱分解策略。
AI.findings: Koopman算子/DMD框架是最有希望与CMH整合的候选方案，原因是：与CMH公理A2的遍历性假设自然衔接、与历史数据的面板结构兼容、能生成关于持久循环结构的可证伪预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了CMH预测空间的三个层次（事件预测、制度概率、谱结构持久性），并论证不同策略在不同层次上的有效性不同，为混沌历史预测提供了更精细的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CMH框架识别了最适合进行实证检验的历史数据集及选择标准，并预告了后续将进行完整数学处理的配套论文。

title:
Constraint Productisation Theory (CPT v1.2) 
A Formal Axiom System for Pressure, Constraint, and the Governance of Productisation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Constraint Productisation Theory (CPT v1.2) 
A Formal Axiom System for Pressure, Constraint, and the Governance of Productisation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the content of this work. The research is conducted under the Institute of Productisation framework development program.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or experimental subjects. It is a formal theoretical and systems-based research paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was developed under the Institute of Productisation, Lagos, as part of its foundational research program in Constraint Productisation Theory (CPT).

detail.abstract:
This paper formalises the axiomatic foundation of Productisation Studies: Constraint Productisation Theory (CPT v1.2) as a consistent, axiom-complete, governance-ready logical system. The existing canon of Productisation Studies-the canonical chain, the Stability Ratio, the Law of Relocated Constraint, the PKG engineering specification, and the three institutional mandates-rests on foundational claims about the nature of pressure, constraint, and productisation that have until now been stated in natural language. This paper formalises those claims as a consistent, axiom-complete, governance-ready logical system. 
CPT v1.2 defines four primitive ontological terms (Pressure, Constraint, Product, System), establishes seven core axioms, specifies six consistency rules, declares six non-contradiction constraints, and derives four theorems. The system demonstrates that: (1) Productisation is formally equivalent to constraint stabilisation under pressure invariance; (2) the Law of Relocated Constraint is a derivable consequence of the Conservation of Constraint Axiom; (3) the SR ≥ 1 institutional mandate follows directly from the Entropy Bound Theorem applied to AI-scale amplification conditions; and (4) the three-layer taxonomy of Framework, Methodology, and SOP is a natural partition of the constraint maturity spectrum defined by the axioms. 
The paper additionally clarifies a critical conceptual question for the discipline: the distinction between a framework, a methodology, and a standard operating procedure (SOP) as outputs at different stages of constraint maturity within the canonical chain. This clarification resolves common misapplication of the discipline's vocabulary and establishes the SOP as a fully productised constraint artifact-the terminal output of the CPT pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文正式化了产品化研究的公理基础——约束产品化理论（CPT v1.2），将其构建为一个一致、公理完备且可治理的逻辑系统，明确了产品化等同于约束在压力不变下的稳定化，并澄清了框架、方法论与标准操作规程（SOP）之间的概念区分。
AI.research_question: 如何将产品化研究领域的核心主张形式化为一个一致、公理完备、可治理的逻辑系统？以及如何从理论上区分框架、方法论与SOP这三个核心概念？
AI.motivation: 产品化研究现有的经典论断（如规范链、稳定性比率、约束重定位定律等）此前仅以自然语言表述，缺乏严格的逻辑基础，容易导致概念误用与理论不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 约束产品化理论（Constraint Productisation Theory, CPT v1.2），包含四个基本本体论术语（压力、约束、产品、系统）、七条核心公理、六条一致性规则、六条非矛盾约束，以及四条推导定理。
AI.method: 公理化方法：通过定义基础术语、建立公理体系、规定一致性与非矛盾约束，推导出定理，构建完整的逻辑演绎系统。
AI.findings: (1) 产品化在形式上等价于压力不变下的约束稳定化；(2) 约束重定位定律可以从约束守恒公理推导得出；(3) SR≥1的制度要求可从熵界定理在AI规模放大条件下的应用推导得出；(4) 框架、方法论、SOP的三层分类是公理所定义的约束成熟度谱系的自然划分。
AI.theory_contributions: 为产品化研究提供了形式化的公理基础，将自然语言断言提升为可推理、可验证的逻辑系统；从理论上严格区分了框架、方法论与SOP，将SOP确立为完全产品化的约束人工制品。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产品化研究与治理实践提供了严谨的逻辑基础，有助于避免概念误用，并为AI规模放大条件下的制度设计提供了理论依据。

title: Gender Discrimination in Child Health Investment: Evidence from Umbilical Cord Blood Stem Cell Banking in China
affiliations: HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong and The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Gender Discrimination in Child Health Investment: Evidence from Umbilical Cord Blood Stem Cell Banking in China

declarations.ethicsApproval: Yes, approved by the authors' institutional review board.

detail.abstract: This study examines gender discrimination in high-stakes child health investment, specifically umbilical cord blood banking in Shandong, China. Results show significant favoritism toward boys, influenced by socioeconomic factors—higher GDP and education reduce bias, while illiteracy and son preference increase it. The one-child policy relaxation did not diminish discrimination. A survey of 5,168 postpartum women reveals that female's higher household income contribution, household head status, having a son, or residing with own parents increases infant girls' banking enrollment. Parental enrollment decisions are primarily driven by perceptions of sons' future old-age support, not medical needs. Findings support a collective household bargaining model.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于中国山东5,168名产后妇女的数据，考察了脐带血储存这一高风险儿童健康投资中的性别歧视。研究发现明显的男孩偏好，受社会经济因素影响：高GDP和教育水平减轻偏见，而文盲率和儿子偏好加剧歧视。独生子女政策放松并未减少歧视。女性更高的家庭收入贡献、户主身份、有儿子或与父母同住会增加女孩的储存率。父母的决策主要受儿子未来养老支持的认知驱动，而非医疗需求。结果支持集体家庭议价模型。
AI.research_question: 在高风险的儿童健康投资（脐带血储存）中，是否存在性别歧视？其决定因素和背后的家庭决策机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注一般性儿童健康投资中的性别歧视，但针对高风险、高成本的健康投资（如脐带血储存）中的性别偏好研究不足。此外，作者希望揭示家庭内部决策机制——是统一偏好模型还是集体议价模型更能解释性别歧视现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体家庭议价模型：家庭决策不是由单一效用函数决定，而是家庭成员（特别是父母）通过议价共同决定资源配置。此外，结合了儿子偏好理论（son preference）和养老支持动机，将父母对儿子未来赡养能力的预期作为关键解释变量。
AI.method: 基于中国山东省5,168名产后妇女的问卷调查数据，采用回归分析等计量方法，考察脐带血储存决策中的性别差异及其影响因素，并检验集体议价模型的相关假设。
AI.findings: （1）脐带血储存中存在显著的男孩偏好；（2）高GDP和教育水平降低歧视，文盲率和儿子偏好加剧歧视；（3）独生子女政策放松未减少歧视；（4）女性家庭议价能力（收入贡献高、户主身份、有儿子、与父母同住）增加女孩的储存率；（5）父母决策主要受儿子未来养老支持预期驱动，而非医学需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并支持了集体家庭议价模型在解释儿童健康投资中性别歧视的适用性，挑战了传统统一家庭偏好模型；揭示了"养老支持预期"而非"医学需求"是性别歧视背后的核心机制，深化了对家庭内部资源分配决策逻辑的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了减少儿童健康投资中性别歧视的政策靶点：提高女性家庭议价能力（如提升女性教育、就业和经济独立）、降低文盲率、改善养老保障体系以减少对儿子养老的依赖；提醒 policymakers 独生子女政策放松本身并不足以消除性别歧视，需要配套的社会政策干预。

title: Local-Variance Vega: Interfaces and Green Synthesis

detail.title: Local-Variance Vega: Interfaces and Green Synthesis
detail.abstract:
Local-volatility vega maps display two recurrent geometries: sharp interface-supported structures for barriers and autocallables, and dense regularised portfolios for Asian, lookback and other path-dependent claims. This paper gives a single source-space explanation. The object is the projected local-variance source qX, defined by δVX[h] = ⟨qX, h⟩, and for the admissible products considered here it decomposes as
qX = q Σ X + q ac X ,
where q Σ X is a finite-order distribution on contractual interfaces and q ac X ∈ L 2 is the diffuse continuation-region component. Vanilla weights generate sources through a causal Green synthesis operator H, so weak vega replication is Hw = qX. We prove exact distributional synthesis of q Σ X by wΣ = P qΣ X, including point terms at interface intersections. The diffuse component is a compact inverse problem and is recovered by Tikhonov regularisation, with residual convergence, weight convergence, Picard solvability and noisy-data rates stated separately. The result is a hybrid hedging algorithm with adjoint, Green-identity, Picard and weak-convergence diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合对冲算法，将局部波动率vega映射分解为合同界面上的有限阶分布成分和连续区域中的扩散成分，分别通过精确分布合成和Tikhonov正则化恢复，并提供了多种诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 局部波动率vega映射中两种常见几何结构（障碍/自动赎回型产品的尖锐界面结构，以及亚式/回望等路径依赖型产品的密集正则化组合）背后的单一源空间解释是什么？如何实现有效的vega对冲？
AI.motivation: 局部波动率vega映射呈现出两种反复出现的几何结构，但缺乏统一的解释框架；同时，vega对冲需要处理界面上的奇异成分和连续区域的扩散成分，现有方法难以兼顾两者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投影局部方差源qX的分解理论，将源分解为合同界面上的有限阶分布qΣX和L2空间中的扩散成分qacX；通过因果格林合成算子H建立vega复制方程；利用分布合成理论处理界面成分，利用Tikhonov正则化处理扩散成分。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值算法设计：将源分解为界面分布成分和扩散成分；对界面成分采用精确分布合成（含界面交点处的点项）；对扩散成分采用Tikhonov正则化求解紧致逆问题；提出混合对冲算法，包含伴随算子、格林恒等式、Picard准则和弱收敛诊断。
AI.findings: 局部波动率vega映射的两种几何结构可统一归因于源分解：界面结构来自qΣX（有限阶分布），密集正则化结构来自qacX（L2扩散成分）；所提出的混合对冲算法能够同时处理这两类成分，并提供了残差收敛、权重收敛、Picard可解性和含噪数据速率等理论保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 给出了局部波动率vega映射两种几何结构的统一源空间解释；建立了界面分布成分的精确分布合成理论（含交点点项）；证明了扩散成分的Tikhonov正则化恢复的收敛性和可解性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种实用的混合vega对冲算法，包含多种诊断工具（伴随算子、格林恒等式、Picard准则、弱收敛诊断），能够同时处理奇异界面产品和路径依赖型产品的对冲需求。

title: When the Tool Breaks: Product Liability and the Legal AI Vendor
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: When the Tool Breaks: Product Liability and the Legal AI Vendor
detail.abstract: In April 2026, the Sixth Circuit removed appointed counsel from an indigent defendant's appeal and denied Criminal Justice Act compensation after the attorney admitted that CoCounsel, Thomson Reuters's artificial intelligence (AI) legal research platform, fabricated quotations and misrepresented case holdings. The sanctioned attorney lost his fee. The defendant lost continuity of appellate counsel. Thomson Reuters, which had marketed CoCounsel with affirmative representations of reliability and whose platform generated the fabricated output, was not named in any proceeding. This asymmetry is the subject of this Article. This Article proposes the Architectural Defect Doctrine: a framework applying strict products liability to legal AI vendors whose deliberate choice to deploy stochastic generative architecture for high-stakes legal research tasks constitutes a design defect when a feasible zerofabrication alternative exists. Three independent theories support the doctrine. First, commercial legal AI tools are products under the Restatement (Third) of Torts: Products Liability under the Jeppesen mass-production-for-professional-reliance line and Garcia v. Character Technologies, Inc. Second, vendors' affirmative marketing representations regarding reliability create express warranty obligations under the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) § 2-313 that disclaimers in terms of service cannot defeat under § 2-316(1). Third, the failure to warn theory operates independently: a vendor who knows its product's documented hallucination rates and markets it as reliable has not adequately warned the professional users on whom it relies for revenue. An attorney's failure to verify AI output is comparative fault under the Daly framework, not a superseding cause that extinguishes vendor liability. The learned intermediary defense fails where vendor marketing actively suppressed the attorney's risk assessment. This Article predicts a Farris-pattern verdict within five years and provides the doctrinal framework for that case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"架构缺陷原则"，主张对法律AI供应商适用严格产品责任。当供应商明知生成式AI会产生"零造"（hallucination）却仍将其用于高风险法律研究任务时，构成设计缺陷。文章从产品责任、明示担保、未尽警示义务三个独立理论论证供应商应承担责任，并预测五年内将出现类似Farris案的判决。
AI.research_question: 当AI法律研究平台（如CoCounsel）生成虚假引注和错误判例时，应如何分配法律责任？为什么AI供应商未被追责，而仅由使用该AI的律师承担后果？
AI.motivation: 2026年第六巡回上诉法院的案例中，公设辩护人因使用CoCounsel生成虚假法律引注被剥夺律师费并移除案件，但开发该AI的Thomson Reuters未承担任何责任。这种责任不对称暴露了现有法律框架的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 严格产品责任（Restatement (Third) of Torts: Products Liability，Jeppesen案及Garcia v. Character Technologies案）；2. UCC § 2-313明示担保及§ 2-316(1)免责条款无效规则；3. 未尽警示义务理论（known hallucination rates + marketing as reliable = inadequate warning）。
AI.method: doctrinal legal analysis（法律教义分析），结合既有判例法（Jeppesen、Garcia、Daly、Farris等）进行类推推理和理论建构。
AI.findings: 1. 商业法律AI工具符合"产品"定义（可类推Jeppesen及Garcia案）；2. 供应商的可靠性营销构成UCC明示担保，EULA中的免责条款不能排除；3. 供应商已知幻觉率却未充分警示，构成未尽警示义务；4. 律师未验证AI输出属于比较过失（comparative fault）而非替代原因（superseding cause）；5.  learned intermediary defense因供应商营销压制了律师的风险评估而不适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"Architectural Defect Doctrine"（架构缺陷原则），将生成式AI的"随机生成架构"本身定性为设计缺陷，为AI产品责任提供了新的理论框架。整合并拓展了产品责任、担保法和侵权法三个独立理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来五年内可能出现的针对法律AI供应商的消费者诉讼（如Farris模式判决）提供完整的教义框架；为法院、立法者和律师在处理AI生成错误时的责任分配提供可操作的分析工具；促使AI供应商在产品设计和警示义务方面做出改进。

title: Symbolic Governance Risk: Ideology, Disavowal, and the Antifragile Design of Institutional Governance

detail.title: Symbolic Governance Risk: Ideology, Disavowal, and the Antifragile Design of Institutional Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, personal, or institutional relationships that could be perceived as influencing this study. The paper is a conceptual contribution developed independently and has not been commissioned, sponsored, or reviewed by any organization referenced in its analysis, including the regulatory bodies (FCA, PRA, FSB) and governance institutions (IIA, COSO, ISO) whose frameworks the paper discusses. The author has no consulting, advisory, employment, or equity relationships with any entity in the governance, risk, compliance, or audit industries that would constitute a conflict of interest with the arguments advanced.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a purely conceptual and theoretical contribution. It does not involve human participants, animal subjects, patient data, personal data, identifiable case material, or any form of empirical fieldwork requiring ethical review. No primary data were collected; all referenced cases (Enron, Wells Fargo, Boeing, Theranos) are drawn exclusively from publicly available sources such as regulatory filings, congressional reports, and published investigative accounts.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author without institutional, governmental, or private financial support.

detail.abstract: Mainstream governance scholarship and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks operate within a procedural rationalism that conceptualizes organizations as coordination systems whose dysfunctions can be corrected through better controls, sharper incentives, and more granular disclosure. This paper argues that this paradigm is theoretically incomplete in ways that contribute to the persistent anomaly of governance failure under apparent governance adequacy. Drawing on Slavoj Žižek's synthesis of Lacanian psychoanalysis, ideology critique, and Hegelian dialectics, the paper develops the construct of symbolic governance risk (SGR), defined as the risk arising from systematic divergence between an organization's formal governance architecture and the unconscious symbolic structures that actually regulate authority, legitimacy, and behavioral compliance. The paper proposes a typology of four symbolic governance pathologies (interpassive compliance, fetishistic disavowal, performative transparency, and ideological overidentification), distinguishes SGR from adjacent constructs in behavioral ethics, institutional theory, and culture-risk regulation, and offers an operationalization map linking each pathology to observable proxies. Six programmatic research conjectures are advanced, with a fully developed research design for the latency conjecture. The paper integrates the framework with Nassim Taleb's antifragility theory through a triangulation argument: Taleb identifies what is fragile in volatility-suppressing governance, and Žižek explains why organizations persist in fragile designs despite knowing better. The Žižekian apparatus is thus not redundant with Talebian prescription but indispensable as its diagnostic of resistance. The paper concludes with implications for antifragile governance design, illustrated through a worked reading of the risk appetite statement as a canonical governance artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文批判主流治理理论及GRC框架的程序理性主义局限，引入Žižek的拉康精神分析、意识形态批判与黑格尔辩证法，构建"符号治理风险"（SGR）概念，提出四种符号治理病理类型，并通过与Taleb的反脆弱理论三角论证，解释组织为何明知脆弱却坚持维持表面有效的治理设计。
AI.research_question: 为什么在治理体系看似完备的情况下，治理失败仍然持续出现？如何从符号维度和无意识结构理解并解释这一持续存在的治理异常（anomaly）？
AI.motivation: 主流治理学术与GRC框架基于程序理性主义，将组织视为可被控制和纠正的协调系统，但这一范式在理论上存在根本性局限——它无法解释"治理充分但治理失败"的持续悖论。本文旨在通过精神分析视角填补这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: Žižek对拉康精神分析（无意识、符号秩序）、意识形态批判（意识形态幻想、犬儒主义）与黑格尔辩证法（否定性、对抗）的综合；Nassim Taleb的反脆弱理论（抗脆弱性 vs. 压制波动性的脆弱结构）。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析：提出概念（SGR）→ 构建类型学（四种病理）→ 区分邻近构念 → 提供操作化映射 → 提出六个纲领性研究猜想（含潜伏猜想的完整研究设计）→ 三角论证与反脆弱理论整合 → 通过风险偏好陈述的文本解读进行实践说明。
AI.findings: 识别出四种符号治理病理：1）互替性合规（interpassive compliance）——让别人替自己履行合规仪式；2）拜物教式否认（fetishistic disavowal）——"我知道这没用，但……"式的知行断裂；3）表演性透明（performative transparency）——为展示而披露，反而遮蔽真实风险；4）意识形态过度认同（ideological overidentification）——对治理话语的狂热投射反而暴露其空洞。论证了Žižek框架对Taleb反脆弱理论具有诊断互补性而非冗余：Taleb指出脆弱的"什么"，Žižek解释"为什么"组织明知脆弱仍坚持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将精神分析引入治理研究，提出"符号治理风险"（SGR）这一原创概念，弥补程序理性主义范式对治理失败的无解释缺口；2）构建系统的四种病理类型学，丰富了治理理论的风险谱系；3）通过三角论证揭示Žižek与Taleb理论的内在互补机制，为批判治理研究与实证治理研究的对话提供桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为GRC从业者提供了识别"表面治理有效"陷阱的诊断工具（四种病理的观测指标）；2）为监管者设计更有效的披露与合规制度提供了避开表演性/仪式化陷阱的理论依据；3）通过风险偏好声明的批判性解读，展示如何从符号维度重新审视和优化组织治理文本与架构。

title: ItôFormer: Augmenting Stochastic Validity in Financial-centric Deep Neural Networks

detail.title: ItôFormer: Augmenting Stochastic Validity in Financial-centric Deep Neural Networks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
This study proposes ItôFormer, a finance-native transformer architecture rooted in Itô Calculus[1], that enforces stochastic validity within attention-based[2] sequence models. Unlike standard calculus, which deals with smooth and predictable functions; Itô's Lemma extends the chain rule to account for the non-zero quadratic variation of random processes encountered in stochastic differential equations[3]. 

      While transformers have achieved state-of-the-art results in NLP and vision, our previous work has shown that vanilla architectures do not map cleanly onto financial time series, which are inherently stochastic and non-stationary[4, 5]. These limitations arise from mismatched design assumptions, such as deterministic sequence mappings, lack of variance modeling, and weak treatment of temporal causality. 

      To address this gap, ItôFormer integrates domain specific inductive biases inspired by stochastic calculus: quadratic variation-aware attention, martingale consistency constraints, and no-arbitrage penalties for options and rates. We evaluate ItôFormer across equities, fixed income, derivatives, and commodities, benchmarking against leading transformer variants from our previous works, such as: PatchTST, iTransformer, Crossformer, Autoformer, Fedformer, Informer, TimesNet, and TimeXer. Our results demonstrate that ItôFormer reduces forecast error, improves hedging stability, and enforces structural consistency absent from prior architectures. For an in depth comparison between each of the afformentioned architectures, see: "Tokenization and Transformer Architectures for Cross-Asset Allocation: Controlled Ablation in Financial Time Series[4].

AI.tldr: 本文提出ItôFormer，一种基于伊藤微积分的金融原生Transformer架构，通过引入二次变分感知注意力、鞅一致性约束和无套利惩罚等随机微积分归纳偏置，显著优于多种主流Transformer变体，在股票、固定收益、衍生品和大宗商品领域降低了预测误差并提高了对冲稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个金融原生（finance-native）的Transformer架构，使其能够有效处理金融时间序列固有的随机性和非平稳性？
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer架构在自然语言处理和视觉领域表现优异，但其确定性序列映射、缺乏方差建模以及对时间因果关系的弱处理等设计假设，与金融时间序列的随机和非平稳特性不匹配，导致在金融领域的表现不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊藤微积分（Itô Calculus）、伊藤引理（Itô's Lemma）、随机微分方程（SDE）、二次变分（Quadratic Variation）、鞅（Martingale）、无套利原则（No-Arbitrage）。
AI.method: 提出ItôFormer架构，集成三种随机微积分启发的归纳偏置：（1）二次变分感知注意力（quadratic variation-aware attention），（2）鞅一致性约束（martingale consistency constraints），（3）期权和利率的无套利惩罚（no-arbitrage penalties）。在股票、固定收益、衍生品和大宗商品等多资产类别上，与PatchTST、iTransformer、Crossformer、Autoformer、Fedformer、Informer、TimesNet、TimeXer等基线模型进行全面对比。
AI.findings: ItôFormer在多个资产类别上降低了预测误差，提高了对冲稳定性，并强化了结构一致性，显著优于现有Transformer变体。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将伊藤微积分与注意力机制系统性地结合，为金融时间序列建模提供了严格的随机微积分理论支撑，弥合了深度学习架构与金融数学之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个金融原生Transformer架构，能够有效降低金融时间序列的预测误差、提升对冲策略的稳定性，并确保输出满足无套利等金融核心约束，适用于股票、固定收益、衍生品和大宗商品等多资产类别的实际金融应用。

title: The Hidden Microstructure of Shared Balance Concentrated Liquidity: A Master Equation for the Dust Ledger and Propagation of Chaos
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Hidden Microstructure of Shared Balance Concentrated Liquidity: A Master Equation for the Dust Ledger and Propagation of Chaos
detail.abstract: The geometric residual identified in the prior paper takes a richer form once a concentrated liquidity manager retains it in a depositor-keyed dust ledger shared across multiple pools. The residual is no longer isolated to its own rebalance, but becomes a hidden state coupling the portfolio’s pools. This paper derives the closed-form law governing that state. Theorem 1 (the Master Equation) gives the exact per-event jump law on any pool, induced by the V3 mint geometry at rebalance, and recovers the prior result in the single-pool swap-free corner. Proposition 1 promotes the prior paper’s Connector Rule conjecture to a sign-keyed correlation under explicit V3-mechanical assumptions, while Theorem 2 generalises zero-swap extinction to a per-token mass-conservation identity across multi-pool rebalances, with a donor/absorber partition under heterogeneous arrival. On the homogeneous hub-spoke topology, Proposition 2 establishes a conditional propagation-of-chaos limit under uniform-in-N hub mixing, and Proposition 3 identifies the limiting one-spoke marginal as a binary atom-mixture whose mass and shape are determined by the slippage law of the in-pool swap correction. The half-normal mixture obtained under symmetric Gaussian slippage is a narrow corollary. The empirical anchor spans roughly 34,500 rebalance events over the V6 through V9 evolution of a PM contract family on Aerodrome Slipstream (Base) under one operator, with per-event predictions matching on-chain dust credits at median ratio 1.0000 throughout. Contract-level verification reproduces the closed form against unmodified Aerodrome Slipstream and Uniswap V3 infrastructure to bit-exact tolerance. The asymptotic factorisation and atom-mixture form are empirically consistent with V9-realistic asymmetric heavy-tailed slippage at the kernel level; the heterogeneous per-spoke V9 marginal is left as an open extension problem, and cross-operator replication remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了集中流动性管理器在多池共享的存入者密钥粉尘账本中保留的几何残差，推导出该残差的闭式主方程，证明了连接器规则猜想，并给出了多池再平衡下的逐代币质量守恒恒等式。在均匀中心辐射拓扑下，建立了条件传播混沌极限，识别出极限单支边际为二元原子混合分布。实证基于Aerodrome Slipstream (Base)上约34,500次再平衡事件，验证了理论预测与链上粉尘记账的中位数比值为1.0000。
AI.research_question: 集中流动性管理器在多池共享的粉尘账本中，几何残差如何从单池孤立状态演变为多池耦合的隐藏状态？其闭式律是什么？
AI.motivation: 先前论文中识别的几何残差在集中流动性管理器将其保留在多池共享的存入者密钥粉尘账本后呈现出更丰富的形式。残差不再局限于自身的再平衡，而成为耦合投资组合中各池的隐藏状态，需要推导其闭式律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何残差闭式律；V3铸币几何的逐事件跳跃律；符号键控相关性；逐代币质量守恒恒等式；捐赠/吸收分区；条件传播混沌极限；二元原子混合分布；半正态混合分布。
AI.method: 理论推导（定理1-2、命题1-3）与实证验证。实证基于Aerodrome Slipstream (Base)上约34,500次再平衡事件（V6至V9合约演化），进行逐事件预测并与链上粉尘记账对比，以及合约级验证（对未修改的Aerodrome Slipstream和Uniswap V3基础设施进行位精确容差验证）。
AI.findings: 定理1（主方程）给出了V3铸币几何在再平衡时诱导的精确逐事件跳跃律，并在单池无交换角点恢复了先前结果。命题1将先前的连接器规则猜想提升为显式V3力学假设下的符号键控相关性。定理2将零交换消光推广为跨多池再平衡的逐代币质量守恒恒等式，并给出了异构到达下的捐赠/吸收分区。命题2在均匀中心辐射拓扑下建立了条件传播混沌极限。命题3识别出极限单支边际为二元原子混合分布，其质量与形状由池内交换校正的滑点律决定。对称高斯滑点下的半正态混合分布是窄推论。实证中逐事件预测与链上粉尘记账的中位数比值为1.0000，合约级验证达到位精确容差。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 推导了多池共享粉尘账本下几何残差的闭式主方程（定理1）；2. 将连接器规则猜想提升为符号键控相关性命题（命题1）；3. 将零交换消光推广为逐代币质量守恒恒等式（定理2）；4. 在均匀中心辐射拓扑下建立条件传播混沌极限（命题2）；5. 识别极限单支边际为二元原子混合分布（命题3）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 实证验证了理论预测与链上粉尘记账的中位数比值为1.0000；2. 合约级验证在未修改的Aerodrome Slipstream和Uniswap V3基础设施上达到位精确容差；3. 为集中流动性管理器的多池粉尘管理提供了理论指导。

title: Governance Friction in Psychology Workforce Development
affiliations: James Cook University - College of Business, Law and Governance,

detail.title: Governance Friction in Psychology Workforce Development
detail.abstract: Australia faces a persistent psychology workforce bottleneck: thousands of capable graduates are unable to progress into practice each year despite rising demand for mental health care. This paper argues that the bottleneck is not primarily a funding or policy‑lag problem, but a governance problem. Using the Governance Friction Analysis (GFA) framework, the paper maps how misalignment between regulators, universities, employers, and policymakers produces governance compression, drift, fragmentation and regulatory conservatism across the education‑to‑registration pipeline. Drawing on accreditation documents, workforce modelling, comparative analysis of other health professions, and sector reports, the paper shows how rigid, university‑centric training structures function as a systemic bottleneck that limits access, underutilises public investment, and exacerbates regional undersupply. It then applies a qualitative likelihood–impact risk matrix to compare the governance risks of the status quo with three reform scenarios: a Provisional‑Plus employment‑integrated pathway, stackable micro‑credentialled postgraduate models, and an integrated five‑year pathway to general registration. The analysis concludes that adaptive, employer‑integrated and tiered pathways can preserve public safety while significantly reducing workforce undersupply, improving system sustainability, and strengthening equity and legitimacy. The paper situates the Psychology Board of Australia’s 2026 higher degree redesign proposals within this governance framework and identifies residual governance gaps that must be addressed if pathway reform is to achieve its intended impact.

AI.tldr: 澳大利亚心理学劳动力瓶颈本质是治理问题，而非资金或政策滞后问题。通过治理摩擦分析框架，论文揭示了教育到注册流程中监管者、大学、雇主和政策制定者之间的错位，并提出了三种改革方案，其中适应性、雇主整合和分层路径能在保障公共安全的同时有效缓解劳动力短缺。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚心理学劳动力瓶颈的根本原因是什么？以及如何通过治理改革来缓解这一瓶颈？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚面临心理学劳动力持续短缺：每年大量合格的毕业生无法进入实践领域，而心理健康护理需求却在上升。作者认为这一瓶颈主要不是资金或政策滞后问题，而是治理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理摩擦分析（Governance Friction Analysis, GFA）框架
AI.method: 1) 认证文件分析；2) 劳动力建模；3) 与其他健康专业的比较分析；4) 行业报告分析；5) 定性的可能性-影响风险矩阵（对比现状与三种改革情景）
AI.findings:
1. 治理错位导致了治理压缩、漂移、碎片化和监管保守主义；
2. 僵化、以大学为中心的教育培训结构是系统性瓶颈；
3. 三种改革方案中，适应性、雇主整合和分层路径（如五年制综合路径、可堆叠微证书等）能在保障公共安全的同时显著减少劳动力短缺、提升系统可持续性、增强公平性和合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理摩擦分析（GFA）框架应用于心理学劳动力规划领域，揭示了治理错位如何产生系统性的劳动力瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出了三种具体的改革情景（Provisional-Plus就业整合路径、可堆叠微证书研究生模式、五年制综合注册路径），为政策制定者提供了可操作的改革选项；
2. 将澳大利亚心理学委员会2026年高等教育学位重新设计方案纳入治理框架进行分析，识别了需要弥补的治理缺口；
3. 为其他面临类似劳动力瓶颈的健康专业提供了治理改革的分析范例。

title: The Consumer Emotional Elevation Pathway (CEEP, pronounced "Keep"): Why Governance, Not Better Design, Inverts the AI Dark Side

detail.title: The Consumer Emotional Elevation Pathway (CEEP, pronounced "Keep"): Why Governance, Not Better Design, Inverts the AI Dark Side

detail.abstract: The literature on AI-enabled personalisation in consumer markets has documented its dark side at length. Studies have catalogued dilemmas in profiling, navigation, nudging, and retention; demonstrated psychologically real betrayal mechanisms in consumer–virtual-assistant relationships; and produced structured taxonomies of factors driving consumer emotional deterioration. What this body of work has not done is specify the architectural conditions under which the same personalisation produces emotional elevation rather than deterioration. The dark side has been diagnosed; the structural answer has not been named. This paper proposes that answer. It introduces the Consumer Emotional Elevation Pathway (CEEP, pronounced “Keep”) as the architectural inverse of the Consumer Emotional Deterioration Pathway (CEDP), and shows that the two pathways share their first two stages — closeness from personalisation, dependence from closeness — and diverge at a third stage governed by the presence or absence of a specified AI governance architecture. The Agent Resource Management framework (ARM) supplies the operational specification; the Added Intelligence and Autonomy Integrity Rights Standard (AIAIRS) supplies the normative content. Under governed personalisation, expectations are calibrated to accountable operation, minor failures are absorbed without betrayal perception, and the consumer–AI relationship deepens into trust resilience and informed advocacy. The paper systematically addresses every critical point raised by the deterioration literature — twelve dark-side factors, four-stage journey dilemmas, and the betrayal micro-mechanism — and shows how each is structurally answered under ARM/AIAIRS rather than tactically patched. A central observation runs through the architecture: we now live in a transparency-enabled era in which inspectable reasoning, AI-auditing-AI, and structural counter-recommendation are computationally feasible for the first time, making CEEP not merely a wishful imposition but the natural fit for the conditions under which added intelligence operates. The contribution is offered in two readings: a marketing reading that completes the customer-journey literature with its missing pathway, and a governance reading that demonstrates ARM/AIAIRS at the consumer interface. The paper closes with a testable empirical hypothesis suitable as a research-design seed for doctoral and post-doctoral work, and with an inspectable Vn-trail of its own production.

AI.tldr: 本文提出消费者情感提升路径（CEEP），作为AI个性化消费者情感恶化路径（CEDP）的结构性逆命题。CEEP与CEDP在前两个阶段（个性化→亲近→依赖）共享，但在第三阶段因AI治理架构（ARM/AIAIRS）的存在与否而分叉：有治理的个性化会产生信任韧性和知情倡导，而非背叛感知。研究系统回应了已有文献的12个暗面因素、四阶段困境和背叛微观机制。
AI.research_question: AI个性化在何种架构条件下会产生消费者情感提升而非情感恶化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已充分记录AI个性化在消费者市场中的"暗面"（如困境、背叛机制、情感恶化因素），但尚未指明同一个性化过程在何种架构条件下能产生情感提升。暗面已被诊断，结构性答案尚未被命名。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者情感提升路径（CEEP）；消费者情感恶化路径（CEDP）；代理资源管理架构（ARM）；增强智能与自主完整性权利标准（AIAIRS）
AI.method: 结构性理论构建，系统回应已有实证文献中的12个暗面因素、四阶段旅程困境和背叛微观机制，展示ARM/AIAIRS如何从结构上而非策略修补地回答这些问题。
AI.findings: 在有AI治理架构（ARM/AIAIRS）的个性化中，消费者预期被校准到可问责的操作，小故障被吸收而不产生背叛感知，消费者-AI关系深化为信任韧性和知情倡导。CEEP并非一厢情愿的强加，而是透明可审查时代下的自然适配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 完成顾客旅程文献中缺失的情感提升路径；2. 为消费者情感恶化文献的每个关键点提供结构性回答；3. 论证CEEP是透明度时代计算可行条件下的自然适配而非理想化强加。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI个性化系统提供ARM/AIAIRS治理架构的操作规范和规范性内容；2. 提供可检验的实证假设，可作为博士和博士后研究设计的种子；3. 展示在消费者界面实施AI治理的具体方式。

title: Response Conductance and Decision Distance: A Cross-Domain Theory of Endpoint Loss

detail.title: Response Conductance and Decision Distance: A Cross-Domain Theory of Endpoint Loss
detail.abstract:
Endpoint loss arises when a system’s actions track signals other than the ones that capture what its principals or beneficiaries value. We introduce Response Conductance Theory (RCT) as a response-conversion framework: information becomes system-relevant only when it changes action, and harm depends on the joint presence of optimization pressure , proxy-endpoint divergence , proxy response dominance , weak guardrails , and exposure , combined through a domain-specific aggregation function . Decision Distance Theory (DDT) is the institutional special case, where  depends on price, exit, and voice,  on intermediary objectives, and the removal test identifies whether an entity raises .
We test the framework at three layers.
Institutional scoreboard. Across 22 domain-outcome pairs spanning six independent families, removal-test-satisfying proxies predicted the correct direction in 13 of 13 preregistered tests; within-country panel evidence in tax administration (), healthcare (), and judicial enforcement (, rising to  at lag 5) confirms direction; orthogonal-shock tests (24/24) show that GDP-controlled estimates over-attenuate.
Catalog tests. Blinded rater replications on 27 institutional and 15 AI alignment cases reject any universal multiplicative score , but reject it in different ways — institutional severity is dominated by  (pooled LOO ); AI severity is dominated by  (pooled LOO ).
Boundary tests. The universal-curve form is rejected; cross-country  averages do not predict ; expert protocols for conductance ratios fail (three attempts, all ); the discriminator cell required to distinguish plain Goodhart from RCT is empty in both catalogs.
The catalog evidence supports a universal component grammar — each component is jointly relevant across domains — but rejects a fixed multiplicative aggregation; identification of  is reserved for decision-level data where each component can be measured independently of realized loss. Systems optimize what they can hear.

AI.tldr: 本文提出响应传导理论（RCT）和决策距离理论（DDT），解释系统行为偏离真实目标时产生的端点损失，并通过三层次（制度计分板、目录测试、边界测试）22个领域数据验证了框架的有效性。核心发现：系统优化其能听到的指标，而非真正重要的目标。
AI.research_question: 当系统追踪的信号与其所服务主体的真实价值不一致时，端点损失如何产生？如何系统性地识别并衡量这种损失？
AI.motivation: 现有理论未能系统解释为何系统（如政府机构、AI系统）在追踪代理指标时会产生不可预期的负面后果，缺乏统一的框架来识别和度量这种"优化了错误目标"导致的损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 响应传导理论（RCT）：信息只有当改变行动时才与系统相关，端点损失由优化压力、代理-终端偏离、代理响应主导性、弱护栏和暴露五个要素共同决定。决策距离理论（DDT）：RCT的制度特例，依赖价格、退出和声音三个机制。
AI.method: 三层次实证检验：（1）制度计分板——22个领域对、13项预注册测试、国家内面板数据分析、正交冲击检验；（2）目录测试——27个制度案例与15个AI对齐案例的盲审复制；（3）边界测试——跨国家均值、专家协议等边界条件检验。
AI.findings: （1）去除测试满足的代理变量在13/13预注册测试中预测了正确方向；（2）制度案例中优化压力主导损失，AI案例中代理-终端偏离主导损失；（3）存在通用组件语法但拒绝固定乘法聚合；（4）系统的识别必须基于决策层面数据，各组件需独立于实际损失测量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的RCT/DDT框架，将Goodhart效应、代理问题和制度失灵纳入统一理论体系；识别了端点损失的五个核心要素及其领域特定的聚合函数；揭示了制度与AI场景中损失主导因素的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计（税收、医疗、司法）和AI对齐提供了诊断端点损失的操作化工具（去除测试、正交冲击检验）；警告GDP控制估计会过度衰减真实效应；为系统设计者提供了"系统优化其能听到的指标"的实践原则。

title: Operational Grammar: Why AI Fails Without Structural Syntax in High-Stakes Service Systems
affiliations: Hoopoe Holding Ltd.

detail.title: Operational Grammar: Why AI Fails Without Structural Syntax in High-Stakes Service Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with healthcare service organizations. No specific clinic, patient, vendor, product, proprietary dataset, or commercial technology is evaluated in this manuscript. The author declares no additional financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the conceptual argument.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this manuscript is a conceptual, theory-building article. It does not involve patients, human participants, patient-level data, clinical records, case studies, or proprietary institutional data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This manuscript is not a clinical trial and does not report clinical intervention data.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly deployed in organizations as a remedy for inefficiency, fragmentation, administrative burden, and decision complexity. Yet many AI implementations fail to produce organizational intelligence, especially in high-stakes service systems where clinical judgment, patient communication, regulatory duties, billing, scheduling, commercial pressure, and human vulnerability intersect. Existing explanations usually point to poor data quality, weak integration, employee resistance, insufficient training, unclear use cases, or immature vendors. These explanations are important, but they do not fully explain why apparently functional AI tools can increase ambiguity rather than reduce it. This article argues that many AI failures are architectural before they are technological. AI systems require an underlying operational grammar: the organizational syntax through which data meanings, decision rights, feedback pathways, accountability mechanisms, and ethical constraints translate machine outputs into coherent and reviewable action. Without such grammar, AI does not create intelligence; it accelerates whatever fragmentation already exists. The article develops a five-layer theory of operational grammar comprising semantic grammar, decision grammar, feedback grammar, accountability grammar, and ethical grammar. It positions healthcare clinics as a stress-test environment because clinics expose the collision between automation, professional judgment, trust, compliance, and revenue logic. The article contributes to AI governance, organizational learning, health technology adoption, and service-system design by shifting the adoption question from "What can AI automate?" to "What structural syntax must exist before automation can become accountable intelligence?" The article is conceptual and does not report clinical data, patient cases, proprietary vendor performance, or empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，许多AI在组织中的失败并非技术问题，而是架构问题——缺乏一种"操作语法"（operational grammar），即把机器输出转化为可理解、可问责行动的组织句法。作者构建了包含语义、决策、反馈、问责和伦理五个层次的语法理论，并以医疗诊所作为压力测试环境，指出如果缺乏这种底层语法，AI不会创造智能，反而会加速既有的碎片化。
AI.research_question: 为什么在组织中部署的功能上看似正常的AI工具，非但没有减少模糊性，反而增加了模糊性？在AI能够产生可问责的智能之前，必须具备怎样的结构性语法？
AI.motivation: 现有对AI失败的解释（数据质量差、集成不足、员工抵触等）未能充分解释一个关键现象：功能正常的AI反而增加了组织中的歧义和混乱。本文试图从架构层面而非技术层面解释这一悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五层操作语法理论：（1）语义语法（semantic grammar）——数据含义的界定与共享；（2）决策语法（decision grammar）——决策权与决策规则的分配；（3）反馈语法（feedback grammar）——信息回路的路径与频率；（4）问责语法（accountability grammar）——责任归属与追溯机制；（5）伦理语法（ethical grammar）——伦理约束与价值边界。
AI.method: 概念性研究（conceptual paper），不涉及临床数据、患者案例、供应商绩效或实证检验。
AI.findings: AI失败的关键原因在于组织缺乏"操作语法"这一底层架构；AI不是创造组织的智能，而是放大组织已有的碎片化；在以医疗诊所为代表的高风险服务系统中，自动化、专业判断、信任、合规与营收逻辑之间的碰撞，使得操作语法缺失的问题尤为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 对AI治理理论、组织学习理论、健康技术采纳理论以及服务系统设计理论做出了贡献——将AI采纳的核心问题从"AI能自动化什么"转向"在自动化产生可问责的智能之前，必须存在怎样的结构性句法"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在部署AI之前提供了一套架构检查框架（五层语法），帮助识别和构建支撑AI有效运行的组织条件，避免在缺乏底层句法的情况下盲目部署AI而加速混乱。

title: AI Capital, Energy, and Labor as Binding Constraints: A Non-Predictive Cognitive Framework
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI Capital, Energy, and Labor as Binding Constraints: A Non-Predictive Cognitive Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently without any organizational bias or commercial influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based entirely on the analysis of publicly available, aggregated data and open-source intelligence (OSINT). It does not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It is a self-funded independent study.

detail.abstract: Current AI infrastructure expansion is encountering three hard constraints: capital, energy, and supply chains. Based on open-source intelligence (OSINT) as of May 2026, this report proposes a non-predictive, structured cognitive framework. We define a three-constraint system (C-capital, E-energy, S-supply chain), a three-state machine (Expansion / Audit / Restructuring), and an operational signal board with decision filters. The core conclusion: the global AI system has entered the Audit State — ROI is beginning to be forcibly accounted for, and constraints are becoming explicit. The 73.4% decline in high-exposure entry-level job postings is defined as the “entry fracture rate,” not a macro-collapse indicator. This framework offers no investment advice or point forecasts of inflection points. Its sole purpose is to help decision-makers reduce the probability of making major errors under high uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个非预测性的结构化认知框架，用于分析AI基础设施扩张面临的资本、能源和供应链三大硬约束，并诊断全球AI系统已进入"审计状态"——ROI开始被强制核算，约束变得显性化。
AI.research_question: 当前AI基础设施扩张面临的硬约束有哪些？全球AI系统处于什么状态？如何帮助决策者在高度不确定性下减少重大错误概率？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施扩张正遭遇资本、能源和供应链的三重硬约束，传统预测方法在高度不确定性下容易出错，需要一个非预测性的结构化框架来帮助决策者降低失误概率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三约束系统（C-资本、E-能源、S-供应链）；三状态机（扩张/审计/重组）；带有决策过滤器的运营信号板。
AI.method: 基于截至2026年5月的开源情报（OSINT）分析，构建结构化认知框架。
AI.findings: 全球AI系统已进入"审计状态"——ROI开始被强制核算，约束变得显性化；高暴露入门级职位发布下降了73.4%，被定义为"入门断裂率"而非宏观崩溃指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个非预测性的三约束-三状态认知框架，将AI扩张约束系统化、可操作化；提出了"入门断裂率"概念，为劳动力市场变化提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供了一个减少重大错误概率的操作框架，不提供投资建议或拐点预测，专注于在高度不确定性下降低决策风险。

title: Rules of the Game: Title IX, Sex-separated Sports, and Statutory Limits
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Rules of the Game: Title IX, Sex-separated Sports, and Statutory Limits
detail.abstract:
This Article analyzes the Supreme Court’s review of West Virginia v. B.P.J., which asks whether Title IX prohibits States from limiting female athletic teams to biological females. Contrary to the Fourth Circuit’s decision, Title IX’s text, structure, and implementing regulations expressly authorize sex-separated athletics based on biological sex as a means of ensuring equal athletic opportunity for women and girls.

The statute is not a pure nondiscrimination command like Title VII. It pairs a general prohibition on sex discrimination with specific provisions preserving sex-segregated programs, particularly in competitive sports. Extending Bostock v. Clayton County to override these structural features misreads both statutes. The Article further argues that categorical biological-sex eligibility rules satisfy intermediate scrutiny under the Equal Protection Clause, given the zero-sum nature of athletics, administrability concerns, and enduring physiological differences between the sexes.

A close review of the oral argument indicates the Supreme Court is likely to reverse, restoring coherence to Title IX and respecting decades of congressional and administrative acquiescence in sex-based athletic categories.

AI.tldr: 本文分析最高法院在West Virginia v. B.P.J.案中的审查，认为第九条允许基于生物性别的体育分类，并预测最高法院将推翻第四巡回法院的判决，恢复第九条在女子体育中的原意。
AI.research_question: 第九条是否禁止各州将女子运动队限制为生物学女性？生物学性别资格规则是否符合平等保护条款？
AI.motivation: 第四巡回法院的裁决与第九条原文、结构和实施条例相冲突，需要澄清第九条在女子体育性别分类问题上的法律解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第九条文本解释、结构解释、Bostock案判例分析、中级审查标准（intermediate scrutiny）、平等保护条款分析。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、判例法分析、口头辩论审查、行政法规解读。
AI.findings: 第九条并非像第七条那样的纯粹非歧视命令，而是将一般性性别歧视禁令与允许性别隔离项目的具体规定（特别是竞技体育）相结合；将Bostock案扩展到推翻这些结构性特征是对两部法律的误读；基于生物学性别的分类规则满足中级审查标准；最高法院很可能推翻第四巡回法院的判决。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了第九条与第七条的区分，指出第九条具有特殊的结构性特征（允许性别隔离项目），不能简单套用Bostock案的逻辑；为基于生物性别的体育资格规则提供了中级审查标准下的合宪性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院提供法律分析支持，为教育机构和体育组织提供第九条合规指引，维护女子体育的公平竞争环境。

title: A closed-loop deterministic scheduling mechanism for existing 485 devices requiring no modification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A closed-loop deterministic scheduling mechanism for existing 485 devices requiring no modification
detail.abstract: To address the issue of unbounded control latency in existing Modbus solutions for legacy Industrial 485 devices—caused by the disconnect between link scheduling and business-logic closed-loop control under the strict constraints of “no hardware or firmware modifications”—this paper proposes a determinism-enhancing mechanism that tightly integrates the link layer with the business layer. This mechanism integrates the entire process—from “command issuance to device execution and feedback verification”—into a unified scheduling framework. Through dynamic time slot allocation, it establishes a derivable, rigid upper bound on latency for the control loop, thereby fundamentally suppressing false positives caused by loop timeouts. Based on network theory, we derived the end-to-end latency upper bound under strict priority scheduling and developed a corrected model by incorporating the electromagnetic and concurrency characteristics of industrial environments. Implemented on the Cortex-M4 platform and validated in both laboratory and industrial field settings, the results demonstrate that under normal operating conditions, the control loop misclassification rate is below 0.5%, and end-to-end control latency is consistently maintained between 60 and 100 ms. This provides a viable solution for the highly reliable centralized management of existing equipment in small and medium-sized enterprises.

AI.tldr: 针对现有Modbus解决方案中链接调度与业务闭环控制脱节导致的控制延迟无上界问题，本文提出一种紧耦合链路层与业务层的确定性增强机制，通过动态时隙分配为控制回路建立可推导的刚性延迟上界，在Cortex-M4平台上实现并验证，控制环路误判率低于0.5%，端到端延迟稳定在60-100ms之间。
AI.research_question: 如何在"不修改硬件或固件"的严格约束下，解决传统工业485设备Modbus方案中链接调度与业务闭环控制脱节所导致的控制延迟无上界问题？
AI.motivation: 现有的Modbus解决方案存在链接调度与业务逻辑闭环控制之间的脱节，导致控制延迟无法确定上界，在工业环境中容易因回路超时引发误报，影响系统可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络理论的严格优先级调度端到端延迟上界推导模型，并结合工业环境电磁特性和并发特性进行修正。
AI.method: 提出链路层与业务层紧耦合的确定性增强机制，将"命令下发→设备执行→反馈验证"全过程纳入统一调度框架，通过动态时隙分配建立延迟刚性上界。在Cortex-M4平台上实现，并在实验室和工业现场进行验证。
AI.findings: 正常工况下控制环路误判率低于0.5%，端到端控制延迟稳定保持在60-100ms之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 推导了严格优先级调度下的端到端延迟上界，并建立了结合工业环境电磁和并发特性的修正模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业现有设备的高可靠集中管理提供了一种可行方案，无需修改硬件或固件即可实现控制延迟的可确定性。

title: Automation, Employment and the Algorithmic Gap
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Automation, Employment and the Algorithmic Gap

declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) is redefining the relationship between productivity, employment, and income distribution on a global scale. This paper examines the structural dilemma between microeconomic efficiency driven by automation and its implications for macroeconomic sustainability and social cohesion. Using an interdisciplinary approach that combines economics, technology, and social theory, the concept of the "algorithmic gap" is introduced, defined as the growing divergence between actors who successfully integrate AI as a capability-enhancing tool and those who are displaced from the productive system.

      The study analyzes the evolution of technological impact on labor, the automation paradox in terms of aggregate demand, and the vulnerability of emerging economies, with a specific focus on Argentina. It also explores the contemporary debate between universal income and the dignity of work, highlighting the economic, institutional, and cultural limitations of purely redistributive models. 

      Finally, the paper proposes a strategic framework distinguishing between a destructive model of AI adoption, focused on labor substitution, and an intelligent model centered on human capability augmentation. It concludes that the core challenge is not technological, but political, organizational, and cultural, and that the future of work will depend on how incentives are designed to integrate AI into inclusive and sustainable productive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI在微观效率与宏观可持续性之间的结构性矛盾，提出"算法鸿沟"概念，区分了破坏性AI采纳模式（替代劳动）与智能AI采纳模式（增强人类能力），并认为核心挑战在于政治、组织和文化层面的制度设计。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的自动化在微观经济效率与宏观经济可持续性、社会凝聚力之间存在怎样的结构性困境？如何设计AI的采纳模式以实现包容性发展？
AI.motivation: 随着AI快速发展，全球范围内生产力、就业与收入分配的关系正在被重塑，亟需理解自动化带来的微观效率与宏观可持续性之间的张力，并探索可行的政策路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: "算法鸿沟"（Algorithmic Gap）概念，即成功将AI作为能力增强工具的参与者与被排除在生产体系之外的参与者之间的日益扩大的分歧；自动化悖论（aggregate demand层面）；效率与可持续性的结构性张力。
AI.method: 跨学科研究方法，结合经济学、技术科学和社会理论，对阿根廷等新兴经济体的案例分析。
AI.findings: 存在两种AI采纳模式：破坏性模型（以劳动替代为核心）与智能模型（以人类能力增强为核心）。纯再分配模型在经济学、制度和文化层面存在局限。核心挑战不在技术层面，而在于政治、组织和文化层面的激励设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"算法鸿沟"这一新概念，用以描述AI时代不同群体在生产力体系中的分化；区分了AI采纳的破坏性与智能两种模型，为理解技术变革的社会后果提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了区分AI采纳模式的战略框架，指出应避免纯替代型AI应用，转向以人类能力增强为核心的包容性生产体系；对阿根廷等新兴经济体具有政策启示意义。

title: Strategic Stockpiling of Critical Minerals as Public Policy A Bibliometric Mapping of the Evidence Base, Research Fronts, and Policy Narratives
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Strategic Stockpiling of Critical Minerals as Public Policy A Bibliometric Mapping of the Evidence Base, Research Fronts, and Policy Narratives
detail.abstract: Governments are revisiting strategic mineral stockpiles as a policy response to critical material supply risks, yet academic insights on this tool remain fragmented. This study maps and analyzes the thematic evolution of 44 peer-reviewed articles on strategic stockpiling of critical minerals using bibliometric techniques. The literature forms distinct research clusters and shows a shift from viewing stockpiles mainly as defense logistics in the Cold War era to framing them as instruments of supply-chain resilience for the clean energy transition. Across the corpus, stockpiling is most often presented as a complementary strategy - one element of a broader policy toolkit alongside supply diversification, recycling, and material substitution. Across the selected literature, governance and design features, especially clear mandates, release rules, transparency, and coordination with industry, are repeatedly identified as central to stockpile performance. At the same time, limited real-world evaluation means the evidence base remains thin on how well stockpiles mitigate supply disruptions or price shocks in practice. The findings provide a structured overview of scholarly knowledge on mineral stockpiles and distill policy-relevant lessons to inform the design of strategic stockpiling programs amid growing critical mineral demand.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量方法系统梳理了44篇关于关键矿产战略储备的同行评审论文，发现该领域研究从冷战时期的国防后勤视角转向清洁能源转型背景下的供应链韧性工具，且储备多被视为补充性策略。研究强调治理与设计特征（如明确授权、释放规则、透明度和行业协调）对储备绩效至关重要，但缺乏足够的实证评估证据。
AI.research_question: 关于关键矿产战略储备的学术文献是如何演变的？该领域形成了哪些研究主题集群？储备作为政策工具的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 各国政府正在重新审视战略矿产储备政策以应对关键材料供应风险，但学术界对此工具的认识仍然是碎片化的，缺乏系统性的整合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学分析、供应链韧性理论、战略储备治理与设计理论
AI.method: 对44篇关于关键矿产战略储备的同行评审论文进行文献计量分析，绘制主题演化图谱。
AI.findings: 1) 文献形成多个研究集群；2) 研究视角从冷战时期的国防后勤转向清洁能源转型的供应链韧性；3) 储备多被视为供应链多元化、回收和材料替代等政策的补充策略；4) 治理和设计特征（明确授权、释放规则、透明度、行业协调）对储备绩效至关重要；5) 缺乏对储备缓解供应中断或价格冲击效果的现实世界评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了关键矿产战略储备的碎片化学术知识，揭示了该领域的主题演化轨迹，为后续研究提供了结构化的文献基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计战略储备计划提供了治理与设计方面的政策启示，包括明确授权、释放规则、透明度和行业协调等关键要素。

title: Port Capacity Purchase Games for Public Peering at Internet Exchange Points
affiliations: Yale University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute

detail.title: Port Capacity Purchase Games for Public Peering at Internet Exchange Points

keywords.keywords: Internet exchange pointInternet service providerpublic peeringport capacity purchase

detail.abstract: ﻿Internet Service Providers (ISPs) purchase ports at a public switch within an Internet Exchange Point (IXP) to facilitate efficient traffic exchange with other ISPs at that IXP. The cost of purchasing a port is determined by its capacity, and this capacity impacts the Quality of Service (QoS) of the traffic that the ISP exchanges through the IXP. ISPs also have the option to exchange traffic outside of the IXP using transit providers, possibly incurring transit service fees and higher latency compared to exchanging traffic via an IXP. In this work, we model the port capacity purchase by ISPs as a non-cooperative game where the individual ISPs decide unilaterally what port capacity to purchase at an IXP, while ISP pairs decide bilaterally on the amount of traffic to exchange through the IXP. The game is analyzed by comparing the worst cost at equilibrium to the social optimum (the ratio known as Price of Anarchy) under two scenarios: (I) when transit option is unavailable, and (II) transit options are available for the ISPs. When transit option is unavailable, we show that in most real-world scenarios, the Price of Anarchy (𝑃 𝑜𝐴) for the game is upper bounded by 2. On the other hand, when the ISPs can utilize transit services, the PoA values are still bounded by a small value, and no worse than 8. Simulation studies demonstrate the impact of the per-unit port purchase (leasing) price and switch delay functions on the equilibrium performance; in all scenarios simulated, the social cost at equilibrium was found to be very close to the optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文构建非合作博弈模型，研究互联网服务提供商（ISP）在互联网交换点（IXP）购买端口容量的决策问题，分析在有无替代传输选项两种场景下的均衡效率（无政府状态价格PoA），发现PoA上界较小（无传输选项时≤2，有传输选项时≤8），仿真表明均衡社会成本接近最优。
AI.research_question: 在网络互联交换点（IXP）中，当ISP独立决策端口容量购买且成对协商交换流量时，均衡结果的效率如何？在有无传输替代选项两种情形下，无政府状态价格（Price of Anarchy）的上界是多少？
AI.motivation: 现实中ISP在IXP端口容量采购决策是分散化、非合作进行的，这种个体理性行为可能导致整体效率损失。需要量化这种效率损失程度，并探究传输服务可用性对均衡效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非合作博弈论；无政府状态价格（Price of Anarchy）；社会最优与纳什均衡的比较分析。
AI.method: 建立非合作博弈模型（ISP决定端口容量，ISP对决定经IXP交换的流量），分别在无传输选项和有传输选项两种场景下推导PoA理论上界，并通过仿真实验验证均衡表现。
AI.findings: （1）无传输选项时，大多数真实场景下PoA上界≤2；（2）有传输选项时，PoA上界≤8；（3）仿真显示所有场景中均衡社会成本均非常接近最优值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将IXP端口容量购买问题形式化为非合作博弈，给出了PoA的严格理论边界，拓展了网络互联经济学中关于分散化决策效率的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IXP的治理和政策制定提供理论依据：即使ISP个体独立决策，在常见条件下均衡效率损失有限；同时为ISP在端口容量采购与传输服务之间的权衡提供决策参考。

title: AdaScheduler: an SLO-aware LLM inference scheduling algorithm without output length prediction
affiliations: Southwest Minzu University, Southwest Minzu University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Southwest Minzu University, Southwest Minzu University, Southwest Minzu University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: AdaScheduler: an SLO-aware LLM inference scheduling algorithm without output length prediction
detail.abstract: With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), a new generation of interactive artificial intelligence applications has emerged, such as code generation and online classification. These applications demand different job completion times (JCTs) for LLM inference (referred to as latency-sensitive (LS) requests), while some other applications such as document summary, may only require the LLM inference system to provide best-effort services (referred as best-effort (BE) requests). To enhance the user experience, the LLM scheduling for hybrid scenarios with hybrid LS and BE requests should be carefully considered. Most LLM scheduling algorithms for hybrid requests require a pre-estimation of the output token length of each request, which is extremely challenging in achieving accurate predictions. Therefore, this paper studies the scheduling algorithms that do not require predicting the output length and proposes AdaScheduler, an adaptive hybrid LLM serving system that optimizes the JCT SLO attainment ratio and system throughput. Specifically, AdaScheduler mainly consists of two parts, one is the priority-based scheduling that sets priorities for the hybrid requests, which determines the scheduling order in a coarse-grained manner. The other is lookahead dynamic batching, which calculates GPU memory usage in subsequent iterations based on task information and resource status, and determines the batch size and scheduling order in a more fine-grained manner. Besides, to reduce the computational overhead and the overhead of KV cache movement, the priorities are recalculated and the batch is formed only after each batch has executed a predetermined number of iterations. The evaluation results show that AdaScheduler significantly outperforms the baselines, achieving up to a 154.5% increase in SLO attainment ratio and a 53.04% improvement in system throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaScheduler，一种无需预测输出长度的自适应混合LLM服务系统，通过优先级调度和前瞻动态批处理优化延迟敏感与尽力而为请求的JCT SLO达标率和系统吞吐量。
AI.research_question: 如何在无需预知输出token长度的情况下，优化混合LS和BE请求的LLM推理调度，以提高SLO达标率和系统吞吐量？
AI.motivation: 现有LLM调度算法大多需要预估计输出token长度，而这在实际中极难准确预测。因此需要一种不依赖输出长度预测的调度方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优先级调度（粗粒度）与前瞻动态批处理（细粒度）相结合的双层调度框架。
AI.method: 提出AdaScheduler系统：1）基于优先级的粗粒度调度，为混合请求设置优先级；2）前瞻动态批处理，根据任务信息和资源状态计算后续迭代的GPU内存使用，以细粒度方式确定批大小和调度顺序。为降低计算开销和KV缓存移动开销，在每批执行预定迭代次数后才重新计算优先级和形成批次。
AI.findings: AdaScheduler相比基线方法，SLO达标率提升最高达154.5%，系统吞吐量提升53.04%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种无需输出长度预测的混合请求调度理论框架，将粗粒度优先级调度与细粒度前瞻动态批处理有机结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接部署的LLM服务系统调度方案，显著提升实际场景中混合工作负载下的服务质量和系统效率。

title: Embedding demand-responsive transport for mobility regeneration: A comparative study of urban and peri-urban cases
affiliations: Hanyang University, Hanyang University, Hanyang University, Hanyang University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Hanyang University

detail.title: Embedding demand-responsive transport for mobility regeneration: A comparative study of urban and peri-urban cases
